jobs.title: Vi skal møte fremtiden med dristighet og glede
jobs.description:
Ringstabekk skole har siden oppstarten i 1972 vært opptatt av å være en lærende organisasjon i stadig utvikling. Tverrfaglige, problembaserte arbeidsformer som prosjektarbeid, storyline, PBL-metoden, simuleringer og entreprenørskap står sentralt i hverdagen vår.Lærerne er organisert i tverrfaglige team som samarbeider tett om elevenes sosiale og faglige utvikling i et helhetlig perspektiv. Et lærerteam på 4-5 lærere har ansvaret for opplæringen til en storklasse på 60-75 elever. Skoleåret er delt inn i 6 perioder, der hver av periodene har et overordnet tverrfaglig tema.Våre pedagoger har høy grad av pedagogisk og didaktisk bevissthet, et ønske om å utvikle seg selv sammen med kollegaer og et stort hjerte for alle typer elever.For mer informasjon om skolen, se skolens hjemmeside: www.ringstabekk.netVi trenger en lærer i 100% vikariat det neste året som kan undervise i kroppsøving og matematikk, både ordinær opplæring og spesialundervisning i matematikk. 

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sørge for et trygt, godt og inkluderende læringsmiljø
  • Planlegge og lede elevenes læring
  • Analysere og følge opp elevenes læringsprogresjon
  • Bidra til godt samarbeid med foreldre
  • Delta og bidra i et lærende fellesskap på skolen
  • Samarbeide med andre faginstanser
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Godkjent undervisningskompetanse for ansettelse i grunnskolen og formell utdanning i undervisningsfagene
  • Er du søker fra land utenfor Skandinavia, må du ha bestått norskprøve B2 skriftlig og muntlig
  • Tydelig og trygg klasseleder som bidrar til inkludering og gode læringsbetingelser
  • Interesse for, og erfaring med, digitale læringsverktøy for å fremme elevers læring
  • Du er opptatt av, og har erfaring med, tverrfaglige, problembaserte læringsformer
  • Spesialpedagogisk erfaring er en fordel
Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som

  • er god på å bygge relasjoner
  • har et raust og romslig elevsyn
  • er god til å kommunisere og samarbeide
  • er utviklingsorientert og kaostolerant
Vi tilbyr
  • Veiledningsprogram for nyutdannede lærere
  • Pliktig innskudd i Statens Pensjonskasse
Gyldig politiattest iht. §17-11 i Opplæringsloven må fremlegges før tiltredelseKontaktinformasjonHans-Marius Christensen, Rektor, 40613731 ArbeidsstedPeiks vei 1 1356 Bekkestua Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Bærum kommune Referansenr.: 5206746411 Stillingsprosent: 100% Vikariat Startdato: 01.01.2027 Sluttdato: 31.12.2027 Søknadsfrist: 29.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. Hos oss kan du bli med og sette spor. 

 

Etter søknadsfristens utløp vil det utarbeides offentlig søkerliste. Ber du om å bli unntatt fra denne listen, må det grunngis i søknadsportalen. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, jfr §11. Hvis ditt ønske ikke imøtekommes, vil du få mulighet til å trekke søknaden før offentliggjøring.

 

Før ansettelse i Bærum kommune skal identitet dokumenteres og oppholdstillatelse være gyldig.

jobs.title: Tilkallingsvikarar - reinhald
jobs.description:
Bemanningssenteret søker tilkallingsvikarar til oppdrag i Hospitaldrift Reinhald. Aktuelle kandidatar vil bli tilsett via Bemanningssenteret, men vil gå vakter ved Hospitaldrift Reinhald.Hospitaldrift er ei av avdelingane i Drift/teknisk Divisjon i Helse Bergen HF, og leverer ikkje-medisinske tenester og produkt til føretaket. Hospitaldrift har 8 einingar og ca. 750 medarbeidarar. Hospitaldrift Reinhald er ei av einingane. Hospitaldrift Reinhald har som oppgåve å utføre dei reinhaldsoppgåvene som Haukeland universitetssjukehus har behov for. Eininga er delt i sju seksjonar og har ca. 350 tilsette. Hovudoppgåvene er regelmessig reinhald, hovudreingjering, smittevask og vask/reiing av senger. I reinhaldsseksjonane våre vil du få jobbe med eit spesielt reinhald, kor hygiene er viktig. Du får spesialopplæring innan sjukehusreinhald og blir ei viktig brikke for å skape trivsel og tryggleik for våre pasientar og tilsette.Tilkallingsvikarane våre vil kunne få opplæring i fleire einingar og vere ein viktig ressurs i sjukehuset si daglege drift. Vi søker deg som likar variasjon i oppgåvene, og samtidig er god til å følge gjeldande rutinar for god kvalitet i arbeidet. Hovudarbeidstida er 07-15, men vi har også mange vakter på ettermiddag/kveld med variabel start- og slutt tid.

Arbeidsoppgåver
  • Arbeidoppgåver vil hovudsakleg vere utføring av regelmessig reinhald, smittevask samt andre reinhaldsoppgåver
  • Vi treng vikarar både til dagvakter og seinvakter, kvardagar og helg
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Vi søker etter personar med interesse for og gjerne erfaring frå reinhaldsfaget, til dømes gjennom arbeid ved helseinstitusjon, i hotell- og sørvisnæringa eller frå kurs- og konferansedrift
  • Det vil bli stilt krav til gode norskkunnskapar
  • Det er ikkje krav til fagbrev, men søkarar med dette er også av interesse
  • Full opplæring vil bli gitt i forhold til arbeidsoppgåvene
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Sørvisinnstilt, fleksibel og kvalitetsbevisst
  • Gode samarbeidsevner
  • Kunne jobbe både i team og sjølvstendig
  • Ansvarsbevisst, strukturert og punktleg
  • Kunne utføre og trivast med eit arbeid som til tider kan vere fysisk krevande
Vi tilbyr
  • Løn i samsvar med gjeldande overreinskomst
  • Kurs- og utviklingsmoglegheiter
  • Bedriftsidrettslag
  • Ein veldriven organisasjon med eit godt arbeidsmiljø

 

Vi oppfordrar alle søkarar til å nytte Vitnemålsportalen for å laste opp verifiserte vitnemål og karakterutskrifter, der det er mogleg. Har du utdanning frå utlandet, legg ved godkjenning frå Direktoratet for høgare utdanning og kompetanse.

KontaktinformasjonCathrine Fauske-Haferkamp, Seksjonsleiar, 99426755 ArbeidsstadHaukelandsveien 22 5021 Bergen Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgivar: Helse Bergen HF Referansenr.: 5213321462 Stillingsprosent: 0% Anna Søknadsfrist: 07.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helse Bergen, Haukeland universitetssjukehus, har nærare14.000 tilsette som har som mål å gi best mogleg helsehjelp til pasientane våre, og rett opplæring til pasientar og pårørande. Kvart år behandlar vi over 900.000 pasientar og bidreg i utdanninga av fleire tusen helsearbeidarar. Forsking og innovasjon er og viktige oppgåver i sjukehuset. Les meir på www.helse-bergen.no eller facebook. Helse Vest skal så langt som råd avspegle mangfaldet i befolkninga.  Vi ønsker å rekruttere medarbeidarar uavhengig av kjønn med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjonar, livserfaring og perspektiv for å bidra i spesialisthelsetenesta.

jobs.title: Grunnskolelærer - vikar
jobs.description:
Vil du gjøre en forskjell i barns hverdag og være med på å skape et trygt og inkluderende læringsmiljø?

Ved Saltstraumen skole er det behov for 2 grunnskolelærer i 100 % stilling. Tiltredelse er snarest og t.o.m. 31.03.2027,  med mulighet for fast tilsetting.  

Lønn etter avtale der ekstra godtgjøring vil bli gitt. 

Vi søker deg som er fleksibel, løsningsorientert og en trygg person med god relasjonskompetanse.

Vi verdsetter godt humør og et godt arbeidsmiljø.

Søknadene vil bli behandlet fortløpende.

Personalet er aktivt og utviklingsorientert og arbeider målrettet og strukturert med de utfordringer skolen står overfor.

Skolen har et flott uteområde, samt god nærhet til turer og uteskoleaktiviteter i både skog og fjære.

 

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

Undervisning på ulike trinn. 

Kvalifikasjoner
  • Det stilles krav om utdanning som grunnskolelærer/allmennlærer eller annen relevant pedagogisk utdanning, gjerne med undervisningskompetanse i matematikk. 
  • Lærerstudenter og andre som har erfaring fra jobb i skole er også velkommen til å søke.
  • Det er fint om du har erfaring fra skole, men ikke et krav.
Personlige egenskaper

Vi søker deg som:

  • Har et positivt elevsyn.
  • Har god relasjonskompetanse.
  • Kan jobbe selvstendig.
  • Er pålitelig.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner.
  • Er fleksibel.
  • Har «elevens beste» som grunnleggende holdning.

Det vil ved tilsetting bli lagt vekt på personlig egnethet og motivasjon for stillingen .

Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull og variert arbeidshverdag.
  • Et godt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø.
  • Tett samarbeid med faglig sterke kolleger.
  • Lønn og arbeidsvilkår i henhold til gjeldende tariffavtaler.
Annet

Aktuelle søkere vil bli invitert til intervju.

Søkere må benytte elektronisk søknadsskjema.

Dokumentasjon på utdanning og praksis legges ved søknaden. 

Før tiltredelse må politiattest av ny dato forevises jf. Opplæringsloven § 17-11. (Skal ikke vedlegges søknaden.)

Arbeidsplassene i Bodø kommune skal preges av mangfold, og våre ansatte skal gjenspeile byens befolkning. Vi oppfordrer alle som er kvalifisert til å søke jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn.

Fast ansatte i Bodø kommune med fortrinnsrett som overtallig, avklart omplasseringskandidat på bakgrunn av helse eller som ønsker å øke sin stillingsandel oppfordres til å søke. 

Bodø kommune legger vekt på å tilrettelegge arbeidsforholdene dersom du har behov for det.

Vi gjør oppmerksom på at søkere kan føres opp på offentlig søkerliste iht. Offentlighetsloven § 25 selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Dette blir du i så fall varslet om.

For alle stillinger gjelder de regler som går fram av lover, reglement og gjeldende tariffavtale. Ved første gangs ansettelse i kommunen gjelder en prøvetid på 6 måneder.

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20.

Har du spørsmål?

Kontakt gjerne rektor Malin Svemo Seivåg på tlf. 75 55 79 01/ 48183184, eller e-post Malin Therese Svemo Seivåg Malin.Therese.Seivag@bodo.kommune.no

Søknad, CV og vedlegg sendes via lenke på denne siden. Har du spørsmål om elektronisk utfylling av CV kan Jobbnorge kontaktes på tlf. 75 54 22 20. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bodø er den ultimate kombinasjonen av kultur og natur, lokalisert midt mellom storslåtte naturperler i regionen rundt. Vi er uredde, har trua, er gode på samhandling og utvikler nye og smarte løsninger.

Våre medarbeidere får det til å skje. En jobb i kommunen er en jobb med mening, hvor det du gjør betyr noe for innbyggerne – og gjør Bodø til et godt sted å leve.

jobs.title: Kontaktperson FACT Ung
jobs.description:
Ønsker du å gjøre en forskjell for sårbar ungdom? Da er dette muligheten for deg!Vi søker etter en positiv og faglig engasjert kontaktperson med særlig fokus på recovery. 

Origo Askøy - livsmestring, psykisk helse og rus, tilbyr hjelp til innbyggere i alle aldre. Vi gir hjelp til personer med psykiske helseplager, rus, utfordringer i foreldrerollen. Vi tilbyr oppfølging individuelt og i gruppe, jobber tverrfaglig, deltar i systemarbeid i kommunen. Origo Askøy består av to avdelinger, en for barn/unge, og en for voksne/eldre. Denne stillingen er knyttet til vårt FACT Ung-team som er organisert under avdeling barn og unge. Vi skal snart flytte til nye lokaler sentralt i Kleppestø, en kort båttur fra Bergen. 

FACT Ung teamet i Askøy kommune jobber etter Flexible Assertive Community Treatment (FACT) modellen. Teamet består av fagpersoner med bred erfaring innen psykisk helsearbeid med barn, unge og voksne, familie- og rusarbeid og forebyggende arbeid og inkludering. Vi tilbyr hjelp til barn og unge mellom 12 – 24 år og deres familier. Teamet er tverrfaglig sammensatt og består av familieveileder, IPS jobbspesialist, erfaringskonsulent, barnevernspedagog, musikkterapeut, spesialsykepleier, psykolog og vernepleier, arbeids- og utdanningsveileder.Nå mangler teamet en recoveryorientert kontaktperson. Vi samarbeider tett med Barne- og ungdomspsykiatrisk poliklinikk (BUP Øyane) og Avdeling for rusmedisin (AFR) og samarbeider også tett med DPS. Vi jobber helhetlig og fleksibelt med støtte og behandling til ungdom/unge voksne med moderate til alvorlige utfordringer på flere livsområder, for eksempel psykisk helse, rus, skole, arbeid, fritid, sosialt, samspill i familie. Vi jobber med ungdommene over tid og møter dem gjerne der de oppholder seg i hverdagen. I FACT Ung vil du få mulighet til å arbeide kreativt og fleksibelt. Vi er arenafleksible, noe som gir mulighet for å jobbe ute i «feltet».    

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Egen portefølje og oppfølging av ungdommer i FACT Ung
  • Drive og delta på gruppeaktivitet med fokus på mestring
  • Delta og bidra aktivt på drøftinger i FACT Ung-team 
  • Ha en recoveryorientert tilnærming 
  • Gjennomføre fleksibel oppfølging på de arena som er aktuelle
  • Samhandling med interne og eksterne samarbeidsparter, samt frivilling sektor
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Minimum 3 årig helse- og sosialfaglig utdanning
  • Gode norskkunnskaper muntlig og skriftlig 
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med ungdommer med sammensatte utfordringer
  • Ønsket med videreutdanning innen rus eller psykisk helse
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest må fremlegges ved tiltredelse
Vi ser etter deg som
  • har god relasjonskompetanse med evne til å skape tillit
  • evner å tenke recoveryorientert med fokus på ungdommens ressurser
  • har interesse til å finne kreative løsninger for å nå målgruppen
  • er robust og trygg til å stå i utfordringer over tid
  • er proaktiv, fleksibel og evner å jobbe både selvstendig og i team
  • har gode evner til samarbeid, både internt og eksternt
  • bidrar til et godt og trygt arbeidsmiljø

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver
  • Mulighet til å følge pasienter over tid
  • Godt kollegafellesskap
  • Kurs og kompetanseheving
  • Et engasjerende og godt arbeidsmiljø som vektlegger faglig og personlig utvikling 
  • Mulighet til å bidra i utviklingsarbeid 
  • Arbeidstid på dagtid, noe kveldsarbeid kan forekomme
  • Kort reisevei fra Bergen 
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk
  • Gode pensjonsordninger
  • Fri gruppelivs- og ulykkesforsikring

Generelle opplysninger: I henhold til offentlighetsloven §25, 2. ledd kan opplysninger om søkeren bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har anmodet om å ikke bli oppført på søkerlisten. Dersom ønsket ikke etterkommes, vil søkeren bli varslet om dette før søkerliste utarbeides.

Eventuelle vitnemål og attester skal legges inn som vedlegg til søknaden.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Raus – interessert – modig - kompetent

Askøy kommune er med våre rundt 30.000 innbyggere og 2000 medarbeidere en av de største kommunene og arbeidsplassene i Vestland fylke. Askøy ligger nordvest for Bergen, og det tar kun 15 minutter å kjøre fra Bergen sentrum til kommunesenteret Kleppestø. Det er også enkelt å reise kollektivt med hurtigbåt eller buss.

Sammen jobber vi for å gi øyens innbyggere et godt bomiljø med gode helse- og velferdstjenester, oppvekst- og utdanningsmuligheter, og kultur- og fritidstilbud.

For at vi skal kunne løse oppgavene våre best mulig trenger vi medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, bakgrunn, erfaring og perspektiver. Vi ser på mangfold som en styrke, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke.

jobs.title: Vikariat som allmennlege
jobs.description:
Jeg søker en engasjert fastlegevikar i 60 % stilling, med oppstart i mars (grunnet mitt phD-løp). Vikariatet har en antatt varighet på minst 6 år.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Norsk autorisasjon som lege, og fullført LIS1 (turnustjeneste)

  • Erfaring fra allmennmedisin

  • Evne og vilje til å jobbe selvstendig med pasientbehandling

  • Gjerne interesse for geriatri og indremedisinske problemstillinger, siden dette utgjør en stor del av listen

  • Må beherske skandinavisk språk på høyt nivå

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Pasientkontakt og konsultasjoner

  • Håndtering av innboks, herunder kontakt med kommune, e-konsultasjoner og NAV o.l.

  • Faste driftsutgifter utover basistilskudd er beregnet til ca. 17 000 kr/mnd ved 60 % stilling alene, eller ca. 23 800 kr/mnd dersom man i tillegg jobber 20 % på min kollegas liste i tillegg.

  • Ved ønske kan mine vakter på legevakten overtas

Vi tilbyr

  • Parkeringsplass tilgjengelig

  • Du blir en del av et etablert fagmiljø med en kollega som er spesialist i allmennmedisin, samt to helsesekretærer

  • Gode muligheter for inntjening da listen har mye geriatri og kvinnehelse - altså gode taksbruk muligheter.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Hafrsfjord legesenter holder til i Madlakrossen 25 i Stavanger. Vi er i dag to fastleger, begge spesialister i allmennmedisin, samt to helsesekretærer. Legesenteret har to veldig stabile lister og er en indremedisinsk preget praksis.

jobs.title: Truckförare med erfarenhet av skjutstativtruck!

För dig som kandidat innebär det en aktör som backar dig, oavsett var i karriären du är och vill vara. Vi vill vara tryggheten i en snabb värld. Vi stöttar, utmanar och frågar hur det går. Helt naturligt, tycker vi. jobs.title: Platform QA Chapter Lead (all genders)
jobs.description:
As Platform QA Chapter Lead on the Platform side at JustPlay, you’ll lead and scale quality assurance for our core app experience - the foundation that powers our games, live operations, and player rewards. Working closely with Engineering, you’ll ensure the platform runs seamlessly across devices, regions, and releases, setting the standard for quality, reliability, and user experience.

You'll split your time between hands-on QA work and leading the QA engineers in the QA chapter: helping them grow in their craft, spreading good practice, and raising the bar for quality across the teams you work with. A key part of this role will be driving smarter, more scalable testing approaches, including AI-driven testing and automation.

 
 

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the full QA lifecycle for JustPlay’s app and platform features - from test planning and execution to reporting and defect management.

  • Foster a strong quality culture across teams by embedding QA best practices early and tying quality goals to product velocity and platform reliability.

  • Drive innovation through AI-driven testing and predictive approaches to identify risks earlier, improve coverage, and reduce manual effort.

  • Partner with development, design, and product teams to integrate QA best practices early in the release cycle.

  • Design and maintain comprehensive test plans and automated suites for key user flows (login, payments, live events, notifications, etc.).

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the QA team - setting up clear processes, code quality standards, and testing frameworks.

  • Implement automation and regression testing strategies using tools such as Maestro, Espresso, XCTest, Appium, or similar frameworks.

  • Use contract testing (e.g., Pact) to validate backend and service integrations.

  • Apply performance and reliability testing across mobile platforms to ensure smooth user experiences.

Job Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA for mobile apps or platforms, including at least 2 years leading teams.

  • Proven ability to design scalable QA processes in fast-paced, development-heavy environments.

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks, regression testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with mobile debugging tools (Android Studio, Xcode) and network analysis tools like Charles.

  • Strong understanding of how to build a quality-first mindset across engineering and product teams.

  • Interest in or experience with AI-assisted testing and new QA technologies.

  • Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a user-first mindset.

  • Familiarity with project and documentation tools such as Jira and Notion.

Nice to have

  • Experience in backend integration testing and API monitoring.

  • Experience with contract testing frameworks such as Pact.

Job Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers

  • Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work

  • Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply

  • Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution

  • State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed

  • A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it

  • Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations

  • Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment.

Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.

 

About us

Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.

Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.

With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.

Everyone's welcome here
At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.
We hire based on skills, potential, and how you work. Your age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background don't come into it. If you don't meet every requirement in this ad, apply anyway. We know great candidates don’t always tick every box and some of our best hires didn't either. We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.description:
We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

About Us

ClearBank is a technology‑enabled, fully regulated bank providing cloud‑based banking and payments infrastructure to financial institutions. We operate at scale in a highly regulated environment, where trust, resilience and security are critical.

Our engineering organisation is focused on enabling frequent, reliable change while maintaining strong controls. We believe quality is not a gate at the end of delivery, but something designed in from the very start.

Role Purpose

This is a senior leadership role accountable for the strategy, design, build, operation and ongoing resilience of ClearBank’s payments and cards platforms.

The VP of Payments & Cards will lead multiple engineering teams responsible for real-time, scheme-connected payments and cards systems across the UK, Europe, and future international markets. This requires deep experience working close to the infrastructure that moves money. Ideally, this will include direct integration with major payment schemes or rails, such as FPS, Bacs or CHAPS in the UK, SEPA payment schemes in Europe, or ACH and Fedwire in the US. jobs.title: Control & Estimation Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

Responsibilities

  • Literature review: Survey existing approaches to disturbance estimation and adaptive control

  • Algorithm implementation: Develop and implement the selected estimation and compensation algorithms within our simulation environment.

  • Performance evaluation: Assess and compare the performance and robustness of the developed methods against classical baselines.

  • Embedded constraints: Ensure the solutions are compatible with real-time execution and the computational limits of onboard hardware.

  • Documentation: Document all work performed, including methodologies, results and conclusions.

  • Flight test participation: Actively take part in flight test sessions to validate the developed algorithms in operational conditions, and contribute to their real-time deployment.

Candidates Requirements

  • Educational background: Strong academic record in automatic control, applied mathematics, or a related field. Knowledge of state estimation (Kalman filtering, observers) and nonlinear or adaptive control is a strong plus.

  • Technical skills: Solid understanding of control theory fundamentals and proficiency in Python or C++ is a plus. Experience with drones is a major plus.

  • Mindset: You are curious to learn, autonomous, rigorous and able to take initiative.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment.

This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware.

 

Responsibilities

  • Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification.

  • MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs.

  • Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink.

  • BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces.

  • High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision.

  • EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads.

  • Prototype-to-Production: Take motor-controller PCBAs through revision discipline, DFM, and qualification - closing the loop on field returns.

  • Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation.

  • Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary.

  • Design Authority & Mentorship: Set the bar via design-decision records and reference designs. Mentor 1–2 junior engineers.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or equivalent.

  • Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design: gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets.

  • Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification): ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms.

  • Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium).

  • Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug.

  • Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed.

  • Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership.

  • English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes.

jobs.description:
Inside Sales Manager (m/w/d) – Nachunternehmer

Du hast Biss, Hunger auf Erfolg und willst Deals closen, statt nur über Leads zu reden? Dann ist das hier dein Spielfeld.

Cosuno ist die größte Plattform, auf der Auftraggeber im Bau ihre Projekte ausschreiben und Handwerksbetriebe neue Aufträge finden. Der Nachunternehmer-Bereich ist unser am schnellsten wachsender Bereich, und 2027 wollen wir den Umsatz verdoppeln. Dafür suchen wir Closer, keine Verwalter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Full Cycle: vom ersten Call über die Demo bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag

  • Warme Leads statt Kaltakquise: Du rufst Handwerksbetriebe an, die bereits auf Cosuno registriert sind.

  • Direkt mit Entscheidern: Am Telefon hast du Inhaber und Geschäftsführer, keine Einkaufsabteilungen. Das heißt kurze Entscheidungswege und schnelle Abschlüsse.

  • Demos & Verhandlung: Du zeigst Betrieben, welche Aufträge auf sie warten, und bringst den Deal über die Ziellinie.

  • Pipeline: Du hältst deine Opportunities in Salesforce sauber und auf Closing-Kurs.

Dein Setup

  • Jeden Morgen schlägt dir die KI deine besten Leads vor.

  • Nach der Demo erstellt die KI eine persönliche Potenzialanalyse für deinen Kunden.

  • Was kein Gespräch ist, automatisieren wir laufend. Deine Zeit steckst du in Calls, Demos und Abschlüsse.

  • Was dich schneller macht, bauen wir mit dir ein. Deine Ideen zählen.

Woran wir dich messen

  • Umsatz gegen dein Monatsziel – das ist die Zahl, die zählt.

  • Aktivität und Qualität: Calls, Demos, Conversion

  • Entwicklung: wie schnell du Feedback umsetzt und dich anpasst

  • Team: was du teilst und wie du andere besser machst

Das alles siehst du transparent im täglichen Team-Ranking.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Vertrieb, idealerweise B2B und Full Cycle

  • Du kannst belegen, dass du deine Ziele konstant übertriffst, also über 100 %.

  • Closing-Mindset: Für dich zählt der Abschluss, nicht der Prozess.

  • Du überzeugst am Telefon, per Mail und in der Demo.

  • Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich, verstehst Prozesse und hast Lust, sie mit zu automatisieren.

  • Du lernst schnell, nimmst Feedback an und willst jeden Monat besser werden.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2); Englisch ist ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision, jeden Monat ausgezahlt (optional: sechsstellig bei Zielerreichung)

  • Ein klarer Karrierepfad: vom Inside Sales Manager über Senior bis zum Account Executive oder Teamlead, mit Fast Track für Overperformer

  • Onboarding und Coaching durch die Top-Performer im Team

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team in einem Markt, der gerade erst digital wird

Warum wir?

  • Gestalte ein Produkt mit echtem Impact: Wir lösen reale Probleme in einer der größten Industrien Europas – der Bauwirtschaft.

  • Performance-Kultur: Ungedeckelte Provision, transparente Regeln und 100 % Eigenverantwortung für deinen Erfolg.

  • Flexibilität: Arbeite remote oder in unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain.

  • Team-Spirit: Internationales, dynamisches Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt.

  • Wachstum: Regelmäßiges Feedback, 1:1s und Entwicklungsgespräche – wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickelst.

  • Erfolge feiern: Ob Firmenevents oder Teamevents – wir gewinnen und feiern gemeinsam.

We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.

Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

  • Add new datapoints, screens, trends and reports, and tune alarms so operators trust the system

  • Keep documentation current - as-built drawings, tag lists, change records - and uphold change control

  • Act as the technical counterpart to contractors and vendors, and support qualification and audits with system evidence

Your Qualifications

  • One of two equivalent qualification paths: a completed apprenticeship as an Electronics Technician for Automation Technology plus further training as a state-certified technician (Techniker), or comparable - or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering or a related field, or comparable

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with industrial SCADA and PLC systems in a production environment - commissioning, operating or supporting, not only design

  • Solid experience with Siemens S7 PLCs (TIA Portal / Step 7) - going online, reading and modifying logic, diagnosing faults on a running plant; experience with comparable PLC platforms is also welcome

  • Strong SCADA engineering skills - ideally Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum, but experience with another platform (e.g. WinCC, PCS 7, Ignition, Aveva, Zenon) plus the willingness to grow into WinCC OA is just as welcome

  • Practical experience with loop checks, instrument calibration and signal troubleshooting, and with reading P&IDs, loop diagrams and I/O lists

  • A structured, disciplined approach to documentation and change control, and the confidence to say no to a change that compromises safety or system integrity

  • Good command of English; German is a strong advantage given the site, suppliers and local contractors

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry
jobs.description:
ABOUT BEAMERY

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

  • Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

  • Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

  • Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the opportunity at Beamery

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Beamery's Data Foundry end to end. The Data Foundry is our proprietary data platform, powering existing and emerging product lines including our Talent CRM and Workforce Suite. Through this, we provide data-as-a-service to customers through channels such as MCP/API. This is an emerging commercial channel. Its core capabilities span the data models, taxonomies and integrations that underpin talent and workforce decisions across our platform.

The Senior Product Manager, Data Foundry will treat data both as infrastructure embedded within our products and as a product that customers buy in its own right. Beyond internal embedding and direct commercial sales, the platform is open — customers and partners can build on top of it through MCP and API access. You will work with product leadership to set the strategy, agree what the platform provides internally, decide what becomes customer-facing, and define how the platform opens up for customer and partner innovation.

You will work at the centre of the platform, creating a balance between two essential initiatives. On one side, you serve the Talent CRM and Workforce Suite product managers as your customers, agreeing the data contracts they build on. On the other, you partner with the data science, data engineering and integrations engineering leads to turn those needs into delivery.

What you will be doing

Ownership and strategy

  • Own the Data Foundry vision, strategy and roadmap, framing each item as a bet with a clear driver, aligned to overall strategic objectives

  • Ensure alignment of Data Foundry strategy to Beamery's AI strategy, reflecting the shift from providing AI assistants to providing AI access through MCP and API channels.

  • Decide what Data Foundry provides as internal infrastructure and what is packaged and sold as a customer-facing product.

  • Make and defend build versus buy decisions across integrations, analytics, AI and taxonomy capabilities.

Discovery and commercial impact

  • Discover and validate what external customers want from data-as-a-service, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to drive adoption with clear GTM and enablement plans

  • Build the case for Data Foundry as a new commercial channel, defining and proving the standalone commercial model alongside its role as platform foundation, quantify the value it unlocks for specific customers and deals, and measure success against value and usage metrics.

Partnership and delivery

  • Lead your team to deliver solutions our customers can’t imagine working without and that deliver measurable customer and business outcomes

  • Agree and maintain the data contracts with the CRM and Workforce Suite product managers, treating them as internal customers with real commitments.

  • Prioritise across data science, data engineering and integrations engineering, translating tribe needs into a clear and deliverable plan.

Communication & alignment

  • Communicate transparently and create alignment between peers and leadership on priorities, trade offs and progress

  • Manage customer and sales expectations through well managed structured cadences

Data governance and trust

  • Own how workforce data is governed, secured and access-controlled as it is exposed through APIs and MCP, meeting or exceeding enterprise privacy and compliance expectations.

  • Ensure the outputs of Data Foundry's models are measurable and explainable, so customers and internal teams can trust and act on the results.

What we are looking for

  • A product manager with a minimum 6 years experience in complex technical, data or AI products, a significant portion of which should be in enterprise B2B SaaS.

  • Strong grasp of data platforms, APIs and integrations, comfortable making architecture-adjacent decisions while collaborating with and holding priorities with engineering and data science leads.

  • Experience handling sensitive or regulated data, with a clear view of governance, security and privacy.

  • An analytical thinker who uses data to find opportunities, confidently prioritise and measure success, balancing between competing tribe roadmaps and internal customers.

  • Commercially fluent, experience with 0-1 product stages, shaping early product with new go to market motions, able to connect product decisions to revenue, cost and customer ROI.

  • A clear communicator who builds trust across product, data science and engineering, and who is comfortable taking a position and explaining the reasoning.

  • Experienced owning and delivering AI capabilities, with a keen interest in how AI is reshaping the talent and workforce space, and in giving customers trusted, explainable access to their data.

Beamery is for Everybody. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to us. We acknowledge the challenges in our industry and strive to develop an inclusive culture where everybody can contribute. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, religion, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, race, national origin, age, disability status, or caregiver status. jobs.title: Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA
jobs.description:
Chief Medical Officer, UK/I & EMEA

The Role

Lyrebird is reshaping how clinical documentation happens across the NHS and in Ireland, and we’re looking for a Chief Medical Officer to be the senior clinical voice of the business. Reporting to the CEO, you’ll make sure everything we build, deploy and sell is clinically safe, evidence-based and genuinely useful to clinicians and patients. You’ll own our clinical safety and governance framework, including DCB0129 and oversight of the Clinical Safety Officer function. You’ll shape the product roadmap alongside Product and Engineering, build the evidence base that NHS and HSE buyers need, and act as a trusted peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and ICB leaders.

This role suits a practising or recently practising doctor who has led at a senior level in the NHS and knows digital health from the inside. You’re comfortable moving between a board presentation, a hazard log and a conversation with engineers in the same afternoon. You’ll enjoy the pace of a high-growth company, but you’ll never trade safety for speed. You believe clinical AI should be held to the same standards as the rest of medicine, and you want to be the person who proves it can be.

About Us

Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians’ most time-consuming tasks.

Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. In the UK, that includes NHS trusts across Cheshire and Merseyside, Alder Hey Children’s, and the South West London Acute Provider Collaborative, one of the largest ambient AI deployments in the country. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead Lyrebird’s clinical safety management system for the UK and Ireland, ensuring DCB0129 compliance, supporting customers with DCB0160, and providing senior oversight of our Clinical Safety Officers.

  • Bring the clinical voice into the product roadmap, defining UK- and Ireland-specific workflows and leading clinical validation of new models, features and specialty templates before release.

  • Own clinical incident management and chair our clinical governance and safety committee, reporting to the leadership team and board.

  • Advise on the regulatory landscape, including MHRA medical device regulation, NHS England guidance on ambient voice technology, DTAC, and the EU AI Act for Ireland.

  • Design and deliver a clinical evidence strategy, running evaluations and real-world studies with NHS and academic partners, publishing the results, and always reporting limitations honestly.

  • Act as a trusted clinical peer to CCIOs, CMIOs, medical directors and digital leaders across NHS trusts, ICBs and the HSE, and represent Lyrebird at conferences, in the media and in national policy conversations.

  • Bring clinical credibility to the commercial team by leading the clinical, safety and evidence sections of tenders, supporting pilots, and making sure every clinical claim we make stands up.

  • Build and lead a UK and Ireland clinical team, and champion equity, patient safety and inclusive design across languages, accents and patient groups.

What you’ll bring

  • Full GMC registration with a licence to practise, in good standing.

  • Significant senior clinical leadership experience in the NHS, such as Medical Director, Deputy or Associate Medical Director, or Clinical Director.

  • Substantial digital health or clinical informatics leadership, for example as a CCIO, CMIO or senior clinical lead on an EPR or digital transformation programme.

Backed by Series B funding, we’ve reached 300M+ downloads and now process around 7 billion images a year for businesses of every size, from solo sellers to global brands and marketplaces like Amazon, Decathlon, and Depop. We serve them through our mobile app, web platform, and API, with tailored solutions for enterprise catalogs.

We’re an international team of 130+, with offices in Paris and New York. We take ownership of what we build, move quickly to learn what works, and speak candidly, united by our ambition to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

 

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

 
 

What you will own

 

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

 

Compliance

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

 

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

 

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

 

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description:
Senior People Partner

Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000

Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function.

THE MOMENT

Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago.

You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them.

This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one.

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT

In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty.

  • Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back.

  • People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding.

  • Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning.

  • CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to.

To be clear about the level: The CPO still designs the People strategy and the systems architecture. You own how it runs day to day, and you’re trusted to run a whole initiative, not just a case. That is a different job to People Partner, not a bigger version of the same one.

THE ROLE

You’ll sit in the People team reporting to the Chief People Officer. Three strands make up the job:

  • Casework: The employee relations situations with the most complexity or sensitivity land with you, start to finish.

  • Initiatives: When the CPO needs a piece of work owned (a policy rollout, a wellbeing programme, a piece of the reward or benefits agenda), you take it from design through to something that runs.

  • Operations: Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own payroll and benefits administration, onboarding, screening and security clearances, and keeping Rippling accurate.

When the People Partner joins, they’ll report to the CPO. You won’t manage them formally, but you’ll lead their handover, you’ll be the person they come to first, and your judgement will set the standard for how this function operates day to day.

WHERE THE ROLE STARTS AND STOPS

New roles get vague, so here is the boundary as we see it today.

Yours

  • The most complex and sensitive employee relations casework, end to end.

  • Full ownership of People initiatives, from design to embedding.

  • Acting as the CPO’s operational partner on ambiguous or cross-cutting problems.

  • Until the People Partner joins (planned for later in 2027):

    • Payroll and benefits administration, including the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling and Mintago.

    • Pre-onboarding, onboarding and probation.

    • Background screening in Zinc.

    • Security clearance coordination.

    • Rippling data quality, workflows and reporting.

    • Our working groups and committees.

  • Once the People Partner joins:

    • A structured handover of the operational core.

    • Day-to-day guidance for the People Partner.

Shared

  • Ashby, which Talent Acquisition owns. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on every hire until the People Partner joins, and on senior hires after that.

  • Mentoring and supporting the People Partner on their casework and initiatives, once they join.

Not yours

  • Recruitment delivery, which sits with Talent Acquisition.

  • The design of the People strategy, the operating model and the systems architecture, which sit with the CPO.

  • Formal line management of the People Partner, who will report to the CPO.

THE STACK

  • Rippling: Our single source of truth. Until the People Partner joins you’ll run it day to day, including the monthly payroll cycle, data quality and workflows, and you’ll use its reporting at a level that supports whole initiatives.

  • Zinc: Background screening. You’ll run checks for every new joiner until the People Partner joins, and stay close to the senior and sensitive hires after that.

  • Ashby: Owned by Talent Acquisition. You’ll work in it from offer through to start date on the hires you’re responsible for.

  • Claude: A daily tool here. You’ll use it for casework preparation, drafting policy and communications, and pulling together the analysis behind an initiative.

  • Mintago: Our employee benefits and financial wellbeing platform (pensions, salary sacrifice and financial advice). You’ll administer it and keep enrolment accurate until the People Partner takes it on.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Own the hardest casework. You’ll run our most complex and sensitive employee relations cases end to end, with the CPO there to sense-check rather than take over.

  • Own initiatives, not tasks. You’ll take a People initiative from a rough brief to something that’s running and embedded, rather than handing it back once the interesting part is done.

  • Run the operational core. Until the People Partner joins, you’ll own the monthly payroll cycle in Rippling, benefits administration including Mintago, onboarding, background screening and security clearances. Accurate, on time, and documented as you go.

  • Hand it over well. When the People Partner arrives, you’ll give them a working system and a clear handover, then stay the person they come to first and the judgement others in the function measure themselves against.

  • Partner with senior leaders. You’ll be credible with leaders on the most difficult conversations: complex change, capability, and situations without a clean playbook.

  • Use AI properly. You’ll use Claude daily to take time out of your own week, checking anything that touches a decision about a person and owning the outcome.

  • Improve what you find. You’ll spot the gaps in policy, process or practice before anyone else does, and bring the CPO a considered view on the fix, not just the problem.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE AT 12 MONTHS

  • You’re running the most complex ER cases with confidence, and the CPO isn’t being pulled into them.

  • At least one or two People initiatives have gone from a rough brief to something genuinely embedded, owned by you.

  • Payroll, benefits, onboarding and clearances run accurately and on time, and every process is documented well enough to hand over.

  • You’ve helped shape the People Partner hire, so the handover is ready when they land.

  • Senior leaders treat you as a credible operational partner, not an escalation point.

  • You’ve made and documented sensible calls in genuinely ambiguous situations, and they’ve held up.

  • The CPO can hand you an ambiguous problem and trust it gets shaped properly.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Deep employee relations experience. You’ve run complex disciplinaries, grievances and change situations yourself, and you know exactly when to escalate and when not to. CIPD qualification, or solid progress towards it, is welcome.

  • A track record of owning initiatives. You can point to work you took from a brief to something that actually ran, not just a project you contributed to.

  • Hands-on with the operational detail. You’ve owned or closely supported a payroll cycle, benefits administration and onboarding, and you’re comfortable being accountable for their accuracy while also carrying the senior work.

  • Credible with senior leaders. You can hold your own in a difficult conversation with someone under real pressure and be listened to.

  • Comfortable operating near-autonomously. You don’t need a playbook for everything. You make a sensible call, write it down, and check it with the CPO afterwards.

  • Ready to grow into people leadership. You won’t formally manage anyone at the start, but you’ll induct and guide the People Partner when they join, and you should want to lead a team as the structure catches up.

  • Discreet and organised at volume. Complex casework and live initiatives, often at the same time. You’ll need a system, and it can’t be your memory.

THE HONEST PART

This role sits in an odd space for now: senior in scope and judgement, without a team underneath it yet. Until the People Partner joins later in 2027, you’ll also be the whole operational team, so a payroll deadline and a complex grievance can land in the same week. That eases as the function grows, but it means the authority you carry day to day has to come from the quality of your work, not a job title.

You are not designing the People strategy or the systems architecture. The CPO does that. What you get instead is real ownership of the hardest cases and the initiatives that matter, a close working relationship with the CPO, and a genuine path toward leading the People Partner practice as it grows.

This probably isn’t for you if you want a formal team from day one, or if you’d rather leave payroll and onboarding to someone else. It probably is for you if you want to prove you can run this function well enough, top to bottom, that a team gets built around you.

If that sounds like the challenge you’ve been looking for, let’s talk.

jobs.title: Head of Business Development, Defence
jobs.description:
About ExTrac

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.


The Role

We are looking for a Head of Business Development, Defence to lead the next phase of ExTrac's growth across UK and European defence. This is a senior, high-impact role for someone who combines deep familiarity with defence and national security with the energy and agility of the technology sector.

You will set the direction for ExTrac's defence business: deciding which customers, programmes and markets we pursue, building the pipeline and partnerships to win them, and growing the team that delivers it. Reporting to the Director of Growth, you will be the senior commercial face of ExTrac to defence customers, and the voice of the defence customer inside ExTrac.

What the job involves

Defence growth strategy

  • Shape and execute ExTrac's growth strategy across UK and European defence.

  • Set the defence go-to-market plan: priority customers, programmes and markets, revenue targets, and where ExTrac will deliberately not play.

  • Own the defence revenue target and forecast, reporting progress and risk to the leadership team with candour.

Senior relationships and positioning

  • Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and influencers across MoD, NATO and allied defence ecosystems.

  • Position ExTrac as the go-to decision intelligence partner for modern defence challenges.

  • Speak the language of operators and engineers, win trust in high-stakes environments, and translate ExTrac's technical edge into strategic advantage for our customers.

Capture, procurement and closing

  • Lead capture on multi-million pound opportunities from early shaping through to contract, across frameworks, competitions and direct awards.

  • Navigate UK and European procurement pathways, including innovation and rapid-acquisition routes, to get ExTrac on contract and scaling inside programmes.

  • Build partnerships with primes, systems integrators and channel partners where they accelerate access to programmes ExTrac could not reach alone.

Customer insight into product

  • Bring user needs back into product and data strategy, helping ExTrac stay ahead of market demand.

  • Work closely with Product, Research & Analysis and Customer Success so that what we sell, what we build and what we deliver stay aligned.

Building the defence BD function

  • Hire, develop and lead a defence BD team as the market scales, working with our existing Defence Business Development Lead.

  • Establish the pipeline discipline, qualification standards and playbooks that let the team win consistently without depending on any single individual.

You should apply if

  • You have a proven record winning multi-million pound opportunities in defence, intelligence or security markets, and you are ready to own the strategy, not just the deals.

  • You know UK and European defence from the inside: how procurement really works, who decides, and how long it really takes.

  • You can brief ministers, generals and CTOs with equal confidence, and you are credible with operators and engineers alike.

  • You bring commercial discipline: an honest pipeline, hard qualification, and the judgement to walk away when the fit is not there.

  • You want to build a market, a team and a function, and you see a high-growth, venture-backed environment as the reason to join rather than a risk to manage.

  • You are comfortable being senior and hands-on at the same time. In the first year you will personally lead key pursuits while building the function around you.

Where this role can take you

  • Build and lead the defence BD function you create as ExTrac scales across the UK and Europe.

  • Shape company strategy, not just sales strategy, influencing how ExTrac positions itself at a defining moment for AI in defence and national security.

  • A clear path to broader commercial leadership as the defence business grows.

Requirements

  • ExTrac provides services to a number of government clients, some of which specify nationality criteria for individuals seeking security clearance. For this reason, we can only consider applications from individuals who are nationals of the UK, another NATO member state, Australia or New Zealand.

  • Candidates must hold a valid UK Security Clearance (e.g. SC, DV) or be eligible to obtain UK Security Clearance to be considered for this role.

  • Proven success winning multi-million pound opportunities in defence, intelligence, or security markets.

  • Deep domain knowledge of UK and European defence, procurement pathways, and decision-making cycles.

  • Strong relationships and extant networks across MoD, NATO, and allied defence ecosystems.

  • Technology fluency, ideally in AI, SaaS, or data analytics contexts.

  • Exceptional communicator, able to brief ministers, generals, and CTOs with equal confidence.

  • Commercial discipline, with a track record of driving pipeline growth and closing complex deals.

  • 10+ years in defence business development, capture or commercial leadership, including leading a team or a major multi-stakeholder campaign.

Desirable

  • Experience in both government service and commercial technology companies.

  • Familiarity with classified and open-source intelligence workflows.

  • Understanding of European defence industrial and political landscapes.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with appetite for building new markets and capabilities.

  • Comfortable in a high-growth, venture-backed environment.

  • Experience building or scaling a BD function in a start-up or scale-up.

  • Working proficiency in a second European language.

Interview Process

We aim to ensure that each person who interviews with our team has the opportunity to showcase their experience and strengths, and to have honest conversations about whether ExTrac and the role align with their career aspirations. The process for this role is as follows:

  • Initial Intro Interview - 30 Minutes

  • Technical Craft & Competency-based Interviews - 45 Minutes x 2 (including a defence go-to-market case exercise)

  • Senior Executive Interview - 45 Minutes

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on skills and experience.

  • A generous benefits package, including Private Medical Health Insurance and enhanced pension contributions.

  • Enhanced parental leave and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • A sabbatical leave offer.

  • £500/year education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • 33 days of leave across the year inclusive of bank holidays.

  • Flexible working, with the opportunity to spend 3 to 4 days a week remotely alongside regular days with our team in our central London office.

  • A role that combines mission-driven purpose with cutting-edge technology in a fast-growing company.

ExTrac AI provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

ExTrac AI is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing open role within our organisation. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position but all hiring decisions will be made by a member of our team.

jobs.description: Vi söker en erfaren IT-säkerhetsspecialist som vill säkra och utveckla en komplex Active Directory- och hybrid identitetsmiljö.Vill du arbeta hands-on med säker, stabil och välfungerande åtkomsthantering? Engelska krävs, svenska är meriterande. Kontorsnärvaro kombineras med distansarbete upp till 50 procent.Ansök senast 2026-11-24.

jobs.title: GIS-specialist inom ekosystemtjänstanalyser
jobs.description: Vi söker en GIS-specialist som vill bidra med analyser av ekosystemtjänster som stöd för hållbar fysisk planering.Vill du använda GIS och ekologisk kompetens för att skapa bättre underlag för hållbar samhällsplanering? I den här rollen bidrar du med analyser av ekosystemtjänster och omsätter geografiska data till användbara beslutsunderlag.Om rollen    Genomföra GIS-baserade analyser av ekosystemtjänster.    Stödja arbete inom fysisk planering och hållbar markanvändning.    Ta fram tydliga underlag för bedömning och prioritering.Det här kommer du göra    Bearbeta, analysera och visualisera geografiska data.    Kartlägga och bedöma ekosystemtjänster i olika geografiska områden.    Ta fram kartor, analyser och dokumentation för planeringsunderlag.    Bidra med ekologiska perspektiv i planeringsrelaterade frågor.Vi söker dig som har    Erfarenhet av GIS-analyser.    Kompetens inom ekosystemtjänster och ekologiska bedömningar.    Erfarenhet av fysisk planering eller närliggande samhällsplaneringsarbete.    Förmåga att kommunicera analysresultat på ett tydligt sätt.Teknik & Verktyg    GIS    GIS-analyser    Geografiska data och kartunderlag    Metoder för ekosystemtjänstanalyserPraktisk information    Ort: Söderhamn, Sverige    Arbetssätt: Distans    Språk: SvenskaUppdragets period och omfattning2026-12-07 – 2027-02-28. projektleverans till fastpris, helt på distans med digitala möten.Relevant utbildning inom ekologi, GIS, landskapsarkitektur, naturgeografi eller samhällsplanering, alternativt likvärdig kompetens, krävs. Ansvarig konsult och nyckelkompetens inom GIS ska ha 2–5 års erfarenhet. Två egna referensuppdrag för offentlig sektor under de senaste fem åren krävs. De tre obligatoriska analyserna gäller biologisk mångfald/livsmiljöer, ekologiska samband och psykiskt välbefinnande. Nio ytterligare analyser är tillval. Arbetet bygger på befintliga data; inga fältbesök ingår. Leverans i öppna GIS-format, SWEREF 99 TM, med metadata och reproducerbar metod.Ansök senast 2026-12-01.

eller samordna toleranskedjor, variationsanalyser och dimensionsriskbedömningar.    Översätta produktkarakteristika till mätbara kvalitetskrav och krav på fixturer.    Ta fram strategier för mätning, korrelation, kapabilitet och dimensionsgodkännande.    Driva rotorsaksanalyser och verifiera korrigerande åtgärder vid dimensionsavvikelser.Vi söker dig som har    Minst fem års erfarenhet av GD&T och arbete med datumsystem.    Minst fem års erfarenhet av toleranskedjor, variationsanalys och geometrissäkring.    Minst tre års erfarenhet av fixturlokalisering, uppspänning och dimensionellt godkännande.    Erfarenhet av precisionskrävande tillverkning i hög volym, gärna inom fordons-, batteri- eller elektrifieringsområdet.    Förmåga att samarbeta med tvärfunktionella teknikteam och externa utrustningsleverantörer.Teknik & Verktyg    GD&T, datumsystem och toleranssättning.    Toleranskedjeanalys och variationsanalys, exempelvis i RD&T, 3DCS, CETOL eller VSA.    CMM, optisk skanning, visionsystem och inline-metrologi.    Fixturer, uppspänning, sammanfogningsprocesser och hantering av termisk deformation.Praktisk information    Ort: Göteborg.    Arbetssätt: Arbete på plats fem dagar i veckan.    Språk: Engelska, flytande nivå.Uppdragets period och omfattning2026-11-23 – 2026-12-31. heltid, på plats i Torslanda fem dagar per vecka.Utöver kraven ovan krävs minst tre Relevant ingenjörsexamen eller likvärdig dokumenterad yrkeserfarenhet godtas. Bakgrundskontroll nivå 1 genomförs före start. jobs.title: Senior Frontend Test Engineer
