With a structured approach and clear communication, you turn complex requirements into practical actions that support product development and market access.Key qualifications include:    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field    Experience in product certification, regulatory affairs or a similar role    Strong knowledge of RF and EMC standards and global wireless certification requirements    Knowledge of and practical experience with functional safety (ISO 13849, IEC 62061/IEC 61508), e.g. risk assessment and PL/SIL determination and verification    Experience working with EU and international regulations (e.g. RED, EMC, Machinery Regulation, FCC, ISED, MIC)    Ability to review and interpret test reports and certification documentation    Understanding of PLM systems and certification documentation processes    Fluent English, spoken and written. Swedish, Spanish or other languages are also a plus.It is a plus if you have:    A functional safety certification    Experience with product cybersecurity (RED Article 3.3 d/e/f, EN 18031, CRA)    Experience with RF exposure assessment and TCB/FCB processes    Experience with marine/offshore type approvals from classification societies (e.g. DNV, Lloyd’s Register)    Project management experienceWhat We Offer    Work with cutting-edge, high-quality products in a dynamic environment    A key role at a time when functional safety, the Machinery Regulation and cybersecurity are reshaping our industry    Opportunities for continuous professional growth and career development.    A challenging and rewarding role within a growing organization    Collective agreement (working in Sweden), including 9 extra days off per calendar year through reduced working hours    3,000 SEK annually for wellness benefits (working in Sweden)About AllgonAllgon is a Swedish company specializing in industrial radio control, with a strong track record in wireless technology innovation. Through our brands Tele Radio, Åkerströms and Sistematica, we have built a global presence, employing over 470 professionals and presence in 26 countries.We offer an exciting work environment in a profitable and growing organization with a strong technical focus. Despite our global reach, we maintain the close-knit atmosphere of a smaller company, where every employee has a voice and can influence the projects they work on.At Allgon, sustainability is a key priority—ecologically, socially, and financially. We are committed to attracting passionate individuals who share our vision of a safer, more efficient world through advanced wireless technology.Last application date is 5 January 2027. Selection and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis, so the position may be filled before last application date. Welcome with your application already today!

jobs.description:
Tradition, Kreativität und Medienkompetenz – willkommen bei Horn Druck & Verlag!

Die Horn Druck & Verlag KG ist ein traditionsreiches, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen, das seit 1986 erfolgreich in der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche tätig ist. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden mit individuellen Marketinglösungen, kreativen Gestaltungskonzepten und einer persönlichen Beratung.

Ihre Aufgaben – kreativ, vielseitig und abwechslungsreich

Sie gestalten unterschiedliche Print- und Digitalprodukte für unsere Kunden aus der Fitness- und Gesundheitsbranche und begleiten deren Umsetzung von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Ergebnis.

  • Gestaltung und Umsetzung von Printmedien wie Anzeigen, Flyern, Broschüren, Magazinen und Werbemitteln

  • Entwicklung und Gestaltung digitaler Werbemittel für Websites, Social Media und Online-Marketingkampagnen

  • Bildbearbeitung, Retusche und kreative Aufbereitung von Bildmaterial

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung visueller Gestaltungskonzepte unter Berücksichtigung der jeweiligen Corporate Designs

  • Erstellung und Aufbereitung druckfertiger Daten

  • Weiterentwicklung bestehender Layouts und Gestaltungsvorlagen

  • Abstimmung mit unserem Marketing- und Verlagsteam sowie die Umsetzung individueller Kundenwünsche

Sie haben eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Grafikdesign, Mediengestaltung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen und verfügen über ein gutes Gespür für Gestaltung, Farben, Typografie und Bildsprache.

Uns ist wichtig, dass Sie gut bei uns ankommen. Deshalb erhalten Sie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung und lernen zunächst unsere Kunden, Projekte und internen Arbeitsabläufe kennen.

Während Ihrer sechsmonatigen Probezeit werden Sie Schritt für Schritt an Ihre Aufgaben herangeführt, übernehmen erste eigene Gestaltungsprojekte und arbeiten zunehmend eigenständig an unseren Marketingkampagnen und Kundenaufträgen.

Dabei stehen Ihnen erfahrene Kollegen als Ansprechpartner zur Seite. Auch die Abläufe unserer Druckproduktion lernen Sie kennen, damit Sie Ihre Gestaltungsideen optimal für die spätere Umsetzung vorbereiten können.

Arbeiten bei Horn Druck & Verlag – das erwartet Sie

Wir bieten Ihnen einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz in einem etablierten Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einem kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld.

Ihre Vorteile:

  • Persönliche und begleitende Einarbeitung mit festem Ansprechpartner

  • Möglichkeiten zur internen Weiterbildung und beruflichen Entwicklung

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und Raum für kreative Ideen

  • Lockere Kleiderordnung und angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre

  • Kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten direkt vor Ort am Standort Bad Schönborn

Ihr möglicher Arbeitsort: Bad Schönborn oder alternativ Berlin.

Klingt das nach Ihrer nächsten beruflichen Herausforderung?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen! Senden Sie uns Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Lebenslauf und – wenn vorhanden – Arbeitsproben oder Portfolio. Gerne möchten wir erfahren, welche kreativen Ideen Sie in unser Team einbringen möchten.

jobs.title: Prosjektingeniør
jobs.description:
Er du teknisk dyktig, med erfaring innen prosjektering av telekomsystemer? Har du i tillegg erfaring med eller interesse for PAGA (Public Address and General Alarm) systemer, kombinert med interesse for lyd, kommunikasjon og nettverksbaserte systemer, er det deg vi ser etter nå!

Som ingeniør i Zenitel vil du være med å prosjektere og sette i drift PAGA systemer til våre partnere og kunder innenfor vår Business unit Maritime & Energy. Du vil i hovedsak jobbe mot offshore plattformer og landanlegg. Hos oss blir du del av et team som består av kompetente og engasjerte teknikere og ingeniører, som sammen jobber for å levere PAGA systemer av høy kvalitet. Som del av vårt team vil du få en sentral rolle i den videre utviklingen og satsningen på våre lydsystemer. Arbeidssted vil være i Kristiansund.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver vil være:

  • Prosjektering og tegning av PAGA systemer

  • Være delaktig i testing og konfigurasjon av våre PAGA systemer

  • Gjennomføring av FAT med kunder

  • Kontakt med og oppfølging av leverandører

Kort sagt vil du være delaktig i hele prosessen fra vi mottar bestilling på et nytt PAGA system til det er levert.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner:

  • Utdanning innen elektronikk eller automasjon på bachelor-nivå er ønskelig. Relevant erfaring teller positivt, og kan kompensere for lavere formell utdanning

  • Kompetanse innen IP- og nettverksteknologi

  • Offshore-sertifikat og erfaring fra offshore er en fordel

  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner både muntlig og skriftlig, på norsk og engelsk

Noe reisevirksomhet må påregnes i denne stillingen.

Vi ser etter deg som er praktisk orientert med evne til å sette deg inn i kundens situasjon. Du er proaktiv og løsningsorientert, en sterk kommunikator og en relasjonsbygger. Du jobber selvstendig og målrettet, alltid med en positiv og 'can do' holdning.

Vi tilbyren utfordrende og variert stilling, med konkurransedyktige betingelser. Hos Zenitel blir du en del av et kompetent og engasjert teknisk team, i et arbeidsmiljø der profesjonalitet, åpenhet og lidenskap for det vi skaper bringer resultatene. Som ingeniør i Zenitel kan du påvirke og virkelig gjøre en forskjell. Bli med på teamet vårt!

Vi benytter Semac bakgrunnssjekk på aktuelle kandidater.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Zenitel is a major global player in the development and marketing of intelligent communication solutions where security, guaranteed availability and sound quality are essential. With nearly 120 years of experience, Zenitel has proven to be a reliable and quality provider of telecommunication solution for the Maritime and Energy segments. This includes PAGA systems, PABX / Intercom systems, CCTV systems, two-way radio intercom solutions and more. These systems are installed on more the 30.000 marine vessels across the world to provide secure operation of the vessel, as well as safety for workers and passengers on board. In addition, we have offshore- and onshore energy installations including offshore wind, which are securely and efficient operated with support by Zenitel audio communication equipment guiding operations in rough environments.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Project Manager - Customer ImplementationsEhra Talent Solutions · Kalmar · Consultant assignment, with openness to permanent employmentDo you want to own customer implementations from kickoff to go-live, and be the person who brings customers, consultants and technology partners together? Ehra Talent Solutions is looking for an experienced Project Manager for our Talent business area.We are primarily looking for an independent consultant for an assignment, but we are also open to permanent employment for the right candidate.About usWe are a SaaS company dedicated to the employee journey. We provide the tools and knowledge that help our customers attract, hire, and develop their talent. With 60 colleagues across five countries, Sweden, Norway, Latvia, the UK, and the Netherlands, we are united by a single mission: helping our clients create the world’s best workplaces. https://ehratalentsolutions.com/The roleYou will lead implementations of our learning and talent management solutions for mid-sized and large organisations in the Nordic private and public sectors. Projects range from 200 to 1,000 hours, and you will typically run 2–5 in parallel. They include new implementations, migrations from other platforms, and expansions with new modules or business units. Your key objective is transparency and predictability, so that customers get what was agreed, on time and within budget.You will    Support Sales in presales and scoping by clarifying requirements and estimating hours, resources and timeline, so that what is sold can be delivered    Plan, lead and follow up projects covering workshops, configuration, integrations (HR systems, SSO), data migration, testing, training and go-live    Lead a cross-functional team of solution consultants, integration specialists and partner resources, as well as the customer’s own project team    Manage scope and change requests and keep time reporting and invoicing aligned with the contract    Run steering groups and status reporting, and secure a structured handover to Customer Success    Contribute to developing our delivery methodologyWho you areMust have    At least three years’ experience leading customer-facing IT or SaaS implementation projects    Experience managing scope, hour-based budgets and change requests with external customers    Fluent Swedish and confident English, written and spoken, as you will work with customers and partners in both languages    A relevant degree or equivalent experienceStrong advantage    Experience from LMS, HR or talent management systems    Understanding of integrations, SSO and data migration    Project management certification such as PRINCE2, PMP, Scrum or SAFe    Experience working with external partners in a distributed organisationYou are structured and calm across several projects at once. You build trust with customers at both operational and management level, and you lead people without formal line authority. You are comfortable saying “no”, or “yes, as a change request”.What we offerYou will have a central role in a growing Nordic company and a collaborative team with real influence on how we deliver. For employees, we offer benefits including pension, wellness allowance, health insurance, extra days off and development opportunities.Practical details    Engagement - Consultant assignment or permanent employment    Location - Kalmar or Stockholm    Travel - Occasional customer visits    Start - By agreement    Reports to- Business Area Director    Process - Includes candidate tests and background checksHow to applySend your application in Swedish or English. In your application, please tell us:    Whether you prefer a consultant assignment or employment, or are open to both    Your availability and earliest start dateWe will carry out selection and call for interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application as soon as possible. If you want more information about the service, you are warmly welcome to contact anders.madsen@ehratalent.comWe look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Vendeur / Vendeuse en menuiserie
jobs.description: Chez Leroy Merlin, le rôle de Conseillère/Conseiller en vente en menuiserie va bien au-delà du simple acte d'achat. Il s'agit de proposer des solutions concrètes, de faciliter les choix, et de rendre les projets possibles.  Votre futur métier : un rôle de vente à triple casquette40% du poste repose sur la vente directe, 40 % sur l'accompagnement de projets et 20% de découpe du bois et du verre. L'un ne va pas sans l'autre : c'est l'équilibre qui fait la richesse du métier.En magasin, dans l'univers de la menuiserie vous jouez un rôle central dans la relation client :Vous accueillez, questionnez, discutez, proposezVous aidez chaque personne à identifier la solution adaptée à ses besoinsVous dynamisez votre rayon : produits disponibles, prix visibles, mise en scène soignée, conseils clairsVous facilitez l'orientation dans les linéaires et contribuez à une expérience d'achat fluide.Et quand le projet prend de l'ampleur, vous accompagnez la réflexion :Grâce aux outils de conception (comme OAA), vous imaginez avec le client un projet sur mesure, en lien avec son espace, ses goûts et son budgetVous orientez les choix de produits, de matériaux, d'agencement ou de couleurs, en tenant compte des envies comme des contraintes.Vous proposez les services adaptés pour concrétiser l'idée : livraison, mise en relation avec des artisans partenaires, etc.Sur le terrain, vous avancez avec autonomie, en lien avec une équipe soudée et un management de proximité.Votre objectif reste le même chaque jour : accompagner avec clarté, vendre avec justesse, et faire en sorte que chaque client reparte avec une solution concrète. Votre profil :Le profil idéal est une personne qui aime autant vendre qu'accompagner, qui apprécie le contact humain autant que la réflexion autour d'un projet.Vous avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et aimez échanger avec les personnes,Vous faites preuve de curiosité, aimez comprendre, découvrir, vous informer, et trouver des solutions,Vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, pour assurer un suivi de qualité de chaque projet client dont vous aurez la charge,Vous avez un tempérament commerçant, et vous aimez profondément la relation client,Une expérience de vente ou de conseil sera évidemment appréciée. Et dans le cas contraire, on vous formera !Leroy Merlin s'engage en faveur de la diversité et de l'égalité des chances. jobs.title: Chief Engineer – Electrical System
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day Step into the role of Chief Engineer – Electrical System with focus on Project Delivery Excellence and become the driving force behind our electrical system solutions. You’ll lead the way in ensuring technical excellence for both customer and development projects, acting as one of our go-to expert for engineers and project teams. Join us to champion quality, standardization, and innovation, while building strong relationships with suppliers and internal partners. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of electrical systems and eager to make a real impact, this is your opportunity to shine. How You’ll Make an Impact     Support project teams by sharing your technical expertise and guiding engineers in the field.     Act as a senior reviewer for both standard and project-specific technical documents.     Represent the Center of Excellence in design reviews, technical meetings, and decision-making forums.     Lead updates to standard schedules, purchasing structures, and contribute to NCC follow-up activities.     Drive improvements in processes, tools, and technical standards to ensure optimal, cost-effective designs. What You Bring     Several years of hands-on experience in order engineering and electrical systems.     In-depth knowledge of gas turbines, ideally within the Medium Gas Turbine segment.     Expertise in I/O, vibration monitoring, and speed monitoring systems.     Strong skills in interpreting technical documents, system descriptions, and design documentation.     Excellent communication and collaboration abilities to support and inspire project teams. About the TeamYou’ll join a dedicated team committed to delivering technical excellence and innovative solutions in electrical systems. The team works closely with project delivery, suppliers, and internal functions such as purchasing to ensure every solution meets the highest standards. As a collaborative and supportive group, we value open communication, continuous improvement, and a shared passion for quality and efficiency. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Application Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 307257 not later than 2026-12-10 Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers. Here, you will take on a broad and varied role, coordinating QSHE activities across the Nordic region, with a particular focus on Sweden and Finland. You will work in an international environment, collaborating with colleagues across different functions and countries.Sounds interesting? We look forward to receiving your application!ABOUT THE ROLEAs Sustainability Manager Nordics, you will work closely with local site managers to ensure regulatory compliance, manage operational risks and maintain high standards across Omya's production and distribution activities.You will be part of an international matrix organisation, working with regional management, local operations and Omya's global Sustainability team.Your main responsibilities will include:    Maintain and develop integrated management systems in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 50001.    Coordinate internal and external audits, certifications and corrective actions.    Monitor regulatory requirements and support compliance with relevant legislation.    Identify and assess QSHE risks and implement preventive measures together with local teams.    Follow up on performance, KPIs and targets, and provide guidance and training where needed.The position is based at Omya's office in Malmö and involves frequent travel within the Nordic region to visit operational sites. You will report to the Head of Sustainability Nordics, based in Norway.ABOUT YOUWe are looking for someone with a solid technical background who understands the challenges of working in a production environment and knows how to translate regulatory requirements into practical solutions.We believe you have:    Relevant experience in QSHE, quality management, sustainability or industrial compliance.    Experience from manufacturing or industrial operations, including exposure to chemical warehousing.    Good knowledge of relevant ISO standards, management systems and regulatory requirements.    A university degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Environmental Science or a related technical field.    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.Experience from chemical distribution, tank farms or sea shipments is considered an advantage. Finnish language skills are also a plus.As a person, you are proactive, structured and analytical. You build trust, communicate clearly and have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when needed. With a diplomatic and collaborative approach, you know how to engage others and drive change without formal authority.CONTACTIn this recruitment process, Omya is partnering with Committo. For more information, please contact Linda Samuelsson at linda.samuelsson@committo.se or +46 70 216 37 52, or Ida Ingeström at ida.ingestrom@committo.se or +46 70 434 76 81 at Committo.Interviews and selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.ABOUT OMYAOmya is a leading global producer of industrial minerals and a worldwide distributor of specialty materials. Omya was founded 140 years ago and remains a privately-owned, independent company headquartered in Switzerland but with offices and plants in more than 50 countries.Thinking of tomorrow. TogetherWhen you join Omya, you become part of a global team that uses its creativity, expertise and experience to make a difference to people's lives. Thinking of Tomorrow means focusing on the challenges of the future and how we can develop mineral products to solve them. This is a collaborative environment where people work towards common goals, with a common purpose.Making life better through our passion for minerals and chemistryOmya´s purpose, combined with their values of modesty, courtesy, integrity and perseverance, is the foundation of their business. Omya´s values are relevant to their lives, not just their work.All Omya employees, partners and suppliers are bound by a Code of Conduct which reflects our values and guides our behavior.

jobs.title: Sykepleier/Vernepleier i Oppfølgingstjenester rus og ROP, team Ilaveien, 100 % fast
jobs.employer: FREDRIKSTAD KOMMUNE RUS OG PSYKISK HELSEARBEID
jobs.description:
Oppfølgingsavdeling Rus/ROP er en avdeling underlagt tjenesteområde Livsmestring i Fredrikstad kommune, hvorav en underavdeling har fast arbeidssted på Ilaveien bosenter. Dette drives som et samarbeidsprosjekt mellom Blå Kors og Fredrikstad kommune, hvor ansatte fra begge organisasjoner samarbeider for økte kvaliteter og utvikling av tjenestene. Målgruppen er personer i aktiv rus og med ROP‑lidelser, ofte med somatisk sykdom. Arbeidet krever god klinisk observasjonskompetanse og etablerte, trygge rutiner for legemiddelhåndtering.

Vi tilbyr oppfølging som støtter brukerne i å mestre hverdagen, ivareta helsen og bo stabilt. Tjenestene er recoveryorienterte, fleksible og tilpasset behovene til mennesker som lever med omfattende og sammensatte utfordringer.Arbeidstiden er dagtid, med én kveldsvakt i uken, samt hver sjette helg med 12,5‑timers langvakter.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Bidra til rusmestring og styrket daglig fungering gjennom systematisk kartlegging og målrettet oppfølging.
  • Legge til rette for å motivere til deltakelse i meningsfulle aktiviteter og struktur i hverdagen.
  • Benytte en recoveryorientert tilnærming for å utforske ressurser og støtte brukere i økt livsmestring og samfunnsdeltakelse.
  • Følge opp personer i aktiv rus og med ROP‑lidelser før, under og etter behandling i spesialisthelsetjenesten, samt ved behov etter soning.
  • Bidra med kliniske observasjoner og oppfølging av somatisk sykdom, samt sikre gode rutiner for legemiddelhåndtering.
  • Samhandle med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere, inkludert frivillige organisasjoner.
  • Henvisning til TSB ved behov for ruspoliklinisk behandling.
  • Utføre dokumentasjon, faglige vurderinger og planarbeid i tråd med lovverk og interne rutiner.
  • Bidra aktivt i avdelingens kvalitetsarbeid og faglige utvikling.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Norsk autorisasjon som Sykepleier eller Vernepleier
  • God kunnskap om og forståelse for rusavhengighet, ROP‑lidelser og somatisk helse.
  • Gode muntlige og skriftlige kommunikasjonsevner.
  • Førerkort klasse B.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Videreutdanning innen rus og avhengighet, psykisk helse eller annen relevant faglig fordypning.
  • Andre relevante videreutdanninger innen tjenestens fokusområder.
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med mennesker med rusavhengighet og psykiske lidelser
  • Erfaring med journalsystemet Gerica.
  • Kjennskap til FIT – tilbakemeldingsverktøy.
  • Erfaring med og kunnskap om klinisk observasjonskompetanse
Personlige egenskaper
  • Du er fleksibel, men samtidig strukturert i arbeidsprosesser.
  • Du håndterer endringer godt og kan omstille deg raskt etter brukerens behov.
  • Du har gode relasjonelle ferdigheter og trives med oppsøkende arbeid på brukers arena.
  • Du er faglig engasjert, motivert og opptatt av kvalitet i tjenestene.
  • Du samarbeider godt i team og bidrar positivt til arbeidsmiljøet.
  • Du er arbeidsom, mobil og trygg i en variert og til tider uforutsigbar arbeidshverdag.
  • Du jobber godt både selvstendig og i team.

Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Vi tilbyrEt stimulerende arbeidsmiljø i en avdeling med fokus på tverrfaglig samarbeid og kompetanse.Gode pensjonsordninger i KLP

Andre vilkårArbeidstakere ansettes i Fredrikstad kommune i henhold til lover, reglement og tariffavtale. Prøvetiden er 6 måneder.

OffentlighetOpplysning om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om å bli unntatt offentlighet. Fredrikstad kommune vil varsle søkere som har bedt om unntak for offentlighet, dersom dette ønsket ikke kan imøtekommes (offentlighetsloven § 25). Det vil gå frem av den offentlige søkerlista hvor mange søkere det har vært til stillingen og hvilket kjønn de har.KontaktinformasjonMaria Sætherbakken, Avdelingsleder, 98907108 Kine Norbom, Virksomhetsleder, 40449126 ArbeidsstedIlaveien 110 1605 Fredrikstad Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Fredrikstad kommune Referansenr.: 5208989607 Stillingsprosent: 100% Fast Søknadsfrist: 26.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Velkommen til Fredrikstad, en av Norges mest attraktive byer. En liten time fra Oslo, der Glomma renner ut i havet, finner du Fredrikstad. Med våre 86.500 innbyggere er vi landets åttende største by. Fredrikstad er i sterk vekst. I tillegg til en urban bykjerne, har vi et spennende og variert omland og en vakker skjærgård. Byen er kjent for sitt rike kulturliv og sine historiske tradisjoner. Gamlebyen er Nord-Europas best bevarte festningsby. I Fredrikstad finner man trygge oppvekst- og levekår, et godt botilbud og et variert miljø- og teknologibasert næringsliv. Du når Oslo på en time og Gøteborg på vel to timer.

Fredrikstad kommune ønsker å være en arbeidsgiver hvor ulikheter og mangfold er en styrke. Kvalifiserte personer med innvandrerbakgrunn og/eller redusert funksjonsevne oppfordres til å søke. Kommunens verdier er Inkluderende, Ansvarlig og Modig.

jobs.title: People Performance Manager
jobs.description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Performance Manager to join our Performance Service.

tem is growing fast. Our goal is to get better as we get bigger - revenue growing faster than headcount. In practice that means keeping our strongest people engaged and performing, getting new joiners productive quickly, and enabling our leaders to multiply their impact over time. Most companies solve that with layers of management. We don't. Our leaders (Player-Coaches) coach their teams while staying hands-on with the work, which means the systems around them have to do more of the lifting. That's where the Performance Service comes in.

We're a team of four, and we own how tem runs as an organisation: the operating rhythm (how work gets planned, tracked, escalated and reported), the onboarding and development that build capability, the frameworks that define what good performance looks like and how people progress and get paid, and the operational backbone of contracts, benefits and payroll. We don't own recruitment. We're adding a second Performance Partner because we need more hands on deck - both partnering with our leaders day to day, and building the frameworks that support them.

Your patch is sustained performance - the part that runs continuously once someone is through the door. You'll carry a portfolio of leaders across our Engines and Services that you're accountable for, and you'll co-own the frameworks that sit underneath them alongside the rest of the team. You will not be handed a finished playbook to administer. You'll report into the Performance Service Manager. HR experience is welcome but not required - we're open to operators, people who've led teams, and the sort of person who ends up owning whatever the company needs next.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Become the first call for a portfolio of leaders on anything to do with their people - performance calls, team decisions and hard conversations.

  • Co-design how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team.

  • Handle live cases end to end - performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, and measure whether they work.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Coach and challenge: be a leader's first call on anything to do with their people - a decision they want a second view on, coaching on how to handle a situation, or a read on employment law - and hold a position when you disagree with them.

  • Raise the bar: hold leaders to a high standard on performance, potential, pay and progression - help them make sharper calls, and hold consistency across your patch.

  • Handle live cases end to end: performance management, difficult conversations, exits and restructures.

  • Build to delight: shape how progression, performance standards, evaluation and reward actually work at tem, alongside the rest of the Performance team. We treat our people like top athletes, and our aim is to delight them at every step of their employee experience - the systems around them have to express that at every contact point.

  • Design for our shape, not the textbook: we index on outcomes and impact in everything - how progression works, how teams are structured, what leaders spend their time on. Most standard people frameworks assume a management hierarchy we don't have.

  • Automate the repeatable: use AI and automation so the operational layer runs itself and your time goes on judgement, not process.

  • Think in process, scalability and iteration: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service. Measure whether they work and redesign when they don't fit the purpose.

✅ Requirements

You do not need a CIPD qualification, and you do not need to have worked in a large, established HR function. You might have been a founder's associate or Chief of Staff at a Series A or B startup, holding the place together while it scaled. You might have built a People function from scratch and taken it from a one-person band to a well-oiled machine. You might have run a team or an Operations function where the people calls were effectively yours, even if People or HR never appeared in your job title. Or you might have done a different job that helped you build the skills below. A background in HR might help you do this job well, but it is not a requirement.

Must-Haves

  • You've held real accountability for decisions on people - you've partnered with leaders, or managed a team yourself, where hiring, performance and exit calls were either yours or made on your guidance.

  • You can be trusted with the hardest conversations in the business and you're recognised for how you handle them, and you understand how decisions about people shape culture and employer brand - balancing efficiency with empathy.

  • You've worked in or towards building a high-performance culture, and you're a confident challenger who carries conviction and can influence leadership decisions.

  • You're comfortable operating without a playbook, in a company where the requirements and the shape of your role change constantly.

  • You think from first principles, get to the root cause of complex problems, weigh competing considerations and anticipate second-order consequences.

  • You're fluent with Notion, automation and AI tooling - your instinct is to build the thing rather than do it manually a second time - and you write clearly enough that a busy person reads it once and comes away with a clear idea of the situation and the next actions.

Desirable

  • Employment relations experience in the UK, Europe or the US - we operate across the UK and Europe today, with plans to expand to the US soon.

  • Experience working across multiple countries, including employer of record arrangements.

  • Compensation and benchmarking experience - salary banding, pay review cycles, market data.

🎁 Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🤝 Interview Process

We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know.

  • Intro call with our Talent team.

  • Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise we may ask you to prepare in advance.

  • Hiring Manager interview.

  • Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Alan exists to end the wait.

About Tacto

Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision.

Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world.

Our mission at Tacto

We make industry stronger.

Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work.

Your role

You build the teams that build Tacto, working directly with our CEO and Chief of Staff.

Why this role exists

We are entering our next growth phase in the AGI age: new markets, new teams and the structures that carry them. Almost all of it runs through people: who we hire, how we set up teams and the culture of ambition we protect. As a Venture Developer, you own several hiring pipelines across functions, from Sales to Tech to Customer Value, and you help make Tacto the place where the best talent in Europe wants to work. Our own AI agents do much of the searching and first outreach, so about half of your week goes to what only people get to do: speaking to talent, judging fit and giving every candidate a great experience. You work directly with André (CEO) and Marla (Chief of Staff).

Why your role matters

  • You decide who gets in. You run the first interviews and shape which candidates our hiring managers meet. Every person you move forward can shape a team at Tacto for years. Talent is our biggest lever in building a generational company.

  • You see every part of the company. You interact with Sales, Tech and Customer Value roles and learn fast what great looks like in each.

  • AI does the groundwork, you bring the judgement. Our agents search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, check what they find and raise their bar.

  • You grow as fast as you deliver. 70%+ of our leadership team was promoted internally. After your first year, you shape your own path: in Talent, Ops, Tech or in a commercial role.

What your week looks like

  • Interviews: about 40%

  • Steering and reviewing sourcing: about 20%

  • Candidate communication and scheduling: about 10%

  • Events, campaigns, merch and employer branding: about 20%

  • Other: about 10%

What this role is and isn’t

  • Hands on: The first 9 to 12 months are about execution: many interviews and candidate calls, clean pipelines and events that run smoothly. It's not always glamorous, but some of the highest leverage work at Tacto and that's how we like it.

  • Not a closing role: Offers and final negotiations sit with our Chief of Staff and the hiring managers. Your job is to bring the right people to the final round, with a clear picture of who they are and making sure that everybody is aligned to provide the best possible candidate experience we can.

  • Not a strategy role: Those don’t exist at Tacto. It is also not a short stop: we look for people who want to grow here. Where you want to grow and into which direction you want to take your career is up to you to define.

  • The deal: Prove yourself with real impact, and we back your growth in every way we can.

Your tasks

  • Own your pipelines and build the org: You own a few open roles at a time, often in very different teams. You agree with each hiring manager on who we are looking for and keep the pipeline moving until the final interview.

  • Interview and assess: You run first interviews, judge fit against a clear bar and give hiring managers a sharp recommendation.

  • Orchestrate sourcing: Our AI skills search, score and write to candidates. You decide where they look, review what they find and source yourself where it counts.

  • Turn candidates into fans: You make our process fast, personal and honest, from the first message to the final interview. Even the people we say no to should walk away telling their friends to apply.

  • Build a base that scales: You set up job descriptions, interview plans, pipelines and data that let us grow the team without losing speed or quality. What you build today is how Tacto hires tomorrow.

  • Shape how Tacto shows up: You help run our talent events, from hackathons and university partnerships to invite-only dinners and Lunch & Learns, plus campaigns, merch and employer branding.

  • Grow into company building: Once the basics run, you take on additional projects with our Chief of Staff. Your path is yours to define in this role and you will receive all the support needed to make it happen.

Your profile

Experience and skills

  • Experience: Ideally 1 to 2 years of work experience, but not required

  • High bar: You’ve seen what great looks like, through an internship or role at a top startup, in consulting or in VC

  • AI native: You already use AI in your daily work and want to build with it, not just use it

  • Languages: Fluent German and English

  • Storyteller: You sell a vision and get others excited to join it

  • Hands on: You solve problems yourself instead of only talking about them

  • Hungry and fast: You get energy from moving fast and seeing results

  • Curious about company building: You want to understand how companies grow and can see yourself in Talent or org building long term

You don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

Our values

No fixed career path: everyone here grows their own way.

  • We stay real: Come as you are, wherever you come from.

  • Merit matters: Results count, not titles.

  • Bold ambitions: Excellence as the standard.

  • Real passion: Grit and ownership.

  • Transforming industrials: Close to our customers in manufacturing.

  • Fun built-in: We don’t take ourselves too seriously.

  • Caring is key: We help each other grow.

What we offer

What to expect

  • Building at the AI frontier: The newest models from day one, an AI Captain in every team and no limits on what you can try.

  • Growing with clear feedback: Regular feedback conversations mean you always know what it takes to reach the next step.

  • Munich’s tech ecosystem: Every week you meet leading founders and operators at our own and external events, for example with Andreas Klinger, Judith Dada or at large hackathons. All events: luma.com/tacto

Benefits

  • 26 + 4 days of vacation

  • €300 childcare allowance per child

  • EGYM Wellpass

  • JobRad bike leasing and public transport tickets

  • Company pension plan and discounts

How you apply

Fast and transparent, with feedback after every step.

  1. Intro Call, 20 min, with the People Team

  2. Hiring Manager Interview, 30 min, with Marla (Chief of Staff)

  3. Mini Task, 30 min prep + 30 min call, with Marla

Equal opportunity and data protection

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We offer everyone the same opportunities regardless of ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity.

Please do not send us any personal data revealing your ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs or trade union membership, and no data about your health or sexual orientation.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. jobs.title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!

Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:

  • Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.

  • The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.

  • Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.

  • Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.

  • Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

What you bring


You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.

  • Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).

  • High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.

  • Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.

  • Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.

  • A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.

  • You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.

  • You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.

  • You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.

  • You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

  • Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.

  • Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.

  • Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

The location


Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience

  3. Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role

  4. Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

WHO YOU ARE

You don't need experience with every tool listed. Strong troubleshooting, dependable follow-through, and a willingness to learn matter most.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Engineer
jobs.description:
The role

Neural Concept is looking for a Technical Marketing Engineer to turn emerging engineering technologies into compelling demonstrations, technical content and joint partner stories.

You will explore how Neural Concept can work with technologies from partners, primarily NVIDIA, and prototype new engineering workflows. You will then translate that work into strong demos, videos and articles that make our technical depth tangible to the market.

Your content work will also extend beyond partner initiatives. You will stay close to our Research, Frontier, Vertical Solutions and Product teams to understand what they are building, identify stories worth taking to market and produce technical content independently. You will turn the work into a technically credible article explaining the method, findings and implications.

This role sits within Marketing and works closely with Product Marketing, Partner Marketing, Research, Product, Engineering and our Vertical Solutions teams.

Your mission

Make Neural Concept’s technical capabilities visible and understandable.

You will combine hands-on engineering work with strong market judgement. You will start with the audience and the story we want to tell, then build the right prototype or content to prove it.

The goal is to create credible and visually strong demonstrations of what becomes possible when Neural Concept connects with emerging AI and engineering technologies. These are marketing prototypes, not production-ready integrations. They must communicate the concept clearly and remain technically accurate.

What you will do

Drive technical co-builds with partners

  • Explore partner technologies and identify where they can create new engineering workflows with Neural Concept.

  • Lead technical co-build initiatives, with an initial focus on the NVIDIA ecosystem, including technologies such as PhysicsNeMo, Warp, Omniverse and agentic frameworks.

  • Build prototypes that combine Neural Concept capabilities with partner products and infrastructure.

  • Work directly with partner technical and marketing teams to shape joint stories.

  • Turn technical exploration into demos, videos, event content and other co-marketing assets.

  • Identify new opportunities for joint content, launches and market visibility.

Produce technical marketing content

  • Write technically grounded articles, explainers and demo narratives.

  • Create and present demos for partners, events, campaigns and executive conversations.

  • Develop demo scripts and work with design or video specialists to produce polished assets.

  • Repackage internal prototypes and engineering work into content that external audiences can understand and remember.

  • Help Product and Partner Marketing communicate technical mechanisms precisely, without unnecessary complexity.

Build for the audience

  • Define the audience, message and desired outcome before starting technical work.

  • Make deliberate choices about what needs to work end to end and what can remain a prototype.

  • Prioritise a clear story, strong visual execution and market relevance.

  • Simplify the experience without oversimplifying the technology.

  • Validate technical claims with the relevant internal experts before publication.

What we are looking for

  • A strong engineering background

  • The ability to build technical prototypes independently. Experience with Python and AI or engineering software is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of one or more relevant areas: machine learning, physics AI, simulation, CAD/CAE, geometry processing, engineering software or agentic systems.

  • Evidence that you can explain technical subjects through writing, demos or video.

  • A marketing-first mindset. You think about the audience and the intended reaction, not only the technical implementation.

  • Strong visual and product judgement. You care about how a demo looks and how clearly it communicates value.

  • Comfort working with external technology partners and coordinating across technical and marketing teams.

  • The ability to move quickly through ambiguity and build enough to prove a concept.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

This role may suit you if

  • You are an engineer who has repeatedly moved towards storytelling, demos, content or developer marketing.

  • You enjoy experimenting with new technologies and immediately think about how to show their value.

  • You want to influence how a deep-tech company presents its capabilities to the market.

  • You prefer building a convincing prototype and narrative over maintaining production systems.

  • You can challenge a technically impressive idea when it does not serve the audience or the message.

This role is probably not for you if

  • Your primary interest is delivering reliable customer implementations or maintaining production integrations.

  • You optimise technical work without considering how an external audience will understand it.

  • You see writing, storytelling and visual presentation as tasks to hand over after the engineering work is complete.

  • You are uncomfortable making pragmatic trade-offs when building exploratory prototypes.

How the role complements Product Marketing

Our Product and Technology Marketing function owns the broader product narrative, positioning and business value. The Technical Marketing Engineer brings deeper hands-on engineering capacity.

The two roles work together: Product Marketing defines the story and market context; the Technical Marketing Engineer explores the technology, builds the proof and contributes the technical content.

What success looks like

Within the first year, you will have:

  • Established a repeatable technical co-build motion with NVIDIA and other priority partners.

  • Produced partner demonstrations that create concrete content, event and relationship opportunities.

  • Built a steady flow of high-quality technical articles, demos and videos.

  • Made complex Neural Concept capabilities easier to understand without weakening their technical substance.

  • Become the bridge between Marketing, Engineering and partner technical teams.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across continents. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

jobs.title: Chargé de clientèle (H/F)
jobs.description: Créée en 2002, la marque Shiva est née d'une ambition : offrir aux particuliers une solution innovante et de qualité dans le domaine de l'entretien du domicile. Animé par des entrepreneurs impliqués, le réseau de franchise Shiva compte aujourd'hui plus de 500 agences implantées près de chez vous pour être à même de répondre à toutes les attentes de ses 100 000 clients !Nous nous sommes donnés pour mission de professionnaliser le marché du ménage et repassage à domicile, avec la conviction que notre métier repose sur la valorisation des employés de maison. C'est dans ce modèle vertueux et respectueux que nous avons su gagner la confiance de nos clients, de nos intervenants pour vivre une « Success story » unique.Un poste à votre image Rattaché.e au Directeur de secteur, vous exercez un métier qui a du sens, dans un réseau qui fait évoluer ses talents. En tant que chargé.e de clientèle, vous bénéficiez de l'attractivité de la marque Shiva pour développer votre portefeuille de clients. Vous contribuez au développement de votre agence en atteignant des objectifs SMART. Vous travaillez au contact d'un public varié, dans une ambiance chaleureuse et accueillante.Les plus Shiva Des missions valorisantes et stimulantes, un quotidien varié, de nombreux avantages, des formations régulières aux outils et process, des perspectives d'évolution dans un groupe ambitieux en fort développement, dans le respect de votre équilibre personnel.Vos missions en tant que chargé.e de clientèle :- Développement du portefeuille clients : décrocher des rendez-vous au domicile, respecter le process de vente Shiva, convertir vos prospects par un discours qualitatif et percutant, capacité à répondre aux objections, faire preuve de réactivité dans les appels, les relances.Visite à domicile- Sélection et intégration des intervenants : traiter les candidatures, rencontrer et sélectionner les candidats, tests ménage et repassage en agence, constituer le dossier administratif des intervenants.- Réalisation et optimisation des plannings d'intervention (gestion des absences et remplacements) grâce à l'utilisation d'un logiciel convivial.- Suivi de la qualité des interventions et de la satisfaction clients et employés de maison (appels 1ères prestations et appels 1ères interventions, visite qualité au domicile, réponse aux insatisfactions clients et intervenants).- Réalisation d'objectifs SMART (spécifiques, mesurables, atteignables, réalistes, temporellement définis) en collaboration avec la direction.Profil recherché- Polyvalence- Réactivité et sens de l'organisation, adaptabilité et rigueur, autonomie- Bonne maitrise des outils informatiques, à l'aise avec l'administratif- Esprit d'équipe, sens du service, culture du résultat- Capacité d'écoute, aisance relationnelle, disponibilité- Partage de nos valeurs : qualité du service rendu, intégrité, altruisme, respect

jobs.title: TECHNICIEN EQUIPEMENT HYDRAULIQUE (H/F)
jobs.description: Notre agence d'Aix en Provence recrute pour l'un de ses clients, spécialisé dans la fabrication d'hélicoptères civils et militaires, un TECHNICIEN EQUIPEMENT HYDRAULIQUE H/F. Cette mission intérim de 6 mois, est à pourvoir dès que possible sur Marignane.Pour ce poste, vous aurez les missions suivantes :  Remettre en service un équipement sous les différents agréments que possède AHEffectuer la réparation ou la révision des équipements déposés d'appareil selon les différentes documentations techniquesEffectuer sur les équipements des essais préliminaires suivant la documentation de maintenanceInvestiguer sur les défauts, établit un devis en conséquence du travail prévu à la réparationAprès accord du donneur d'ordre, vous devrez effectuer le remplacement des pièces défectueusesPuis, réaliser les tests suivant la documentation approuvéeEt enfin, réaliser les compte-rendu de travauxAinsi, vous devrez déclarer les anomalies et/ou amélioration vues dans les différents documents utilisés, et faire remonter à votre hiérarchie tous les écarts rencontrésVous devrez posséder de bonnes compétences en mécaniques des fluides, mais aussi sur les équipements hydrauliques aéronautiques et à la lecture des plans.Vous effectuerez des tests sur des équipements issus des secteurs FAL et PISTE afin de confirmer ou infirmer un défaut constaté et rédiger un rapport d'observations.Vous réaliserez aussi des contrôles sur les équipements reçus en contre réception des fabricants et en cours de stockage des différents magasins (BR ; NC ; Z6 ; ICS). Vous renseignerez les documents associés et les différentes bases de données avec les outils informatiques (SAP ; Gestmag; Google sheet; .). Créer, suivre et animer des non conformités dans l'outil NCM. Mettre en œuvre des essais spécifiques pour le R&D, S&S et rédiger les rapports techniques. Votre expertise apportera un support technique aux FAL, PISTE et aux clients. Enfin, vous pourrez aussi être amener à rédiger des procès-verbaux.Vous aurez la possibilité d'évoluer vers des activités de maintenances des équipements hydrauliques afin de développer sa polyvalence et des besoins du service.En tant que technicien, vous serez amené à travailler dans un environnement ou les réglementations PART 21 et PART 145 sont en vigueur.De formation BAC +2 (BTS/Bachelor) orienté mécanique, maintenance industrielle, aéronautique ou équivalent, idéalement vous justifiez idéalement d'une première expérience dans le domaine aéronautique ou dans les systèmes hydrauliques.Vous êtes polyvalent et rigoureux, vous possédez également d'excellente capacité rédactionnelle.
