Nous accompagnons les voyageurs avant, pendant et après leur séjour à travers des consultations en présentiel et en téléconsultation, incluant conseils médicaux, vaccinations et dépistages.Dans le domaine de la santé sexuelle, nous proposons des consultations de prévention, de dépistage et de prise en charge des infections sexuellement transmissibles (IST), ainsi que des conseils personnalisés en matière de prévention, de contraception et de santé sexuelle.Notre approche repose sur une prise en charge globale, confidentielle, accessible et sans jugement.ResponsabilitésNous recherchons un·e infirmier·ère motivé·e pour assurer des consultations de médecine des voyages et santé sexuelle, en présentiel et en téléconsultation. Vous serez amené·e à :* Accueillir et conseiller les patients sur les risques sanitaires liés à leur destination ?* Administrer les vaccinations et réaliser des tests diagnostiques ?* Effectuer des téléconsultations pour le suivi et le conseil aux voyageurs ?* Réaliser des consultations de prévention et de dépistage des infections sexuellement transmissibles (IST).* Effectuer les prélèvements nécessaires au dépistage des IST et assurer le suivi des résultats.* Conseiller et accompagner les patients en matière de prévention, de protection et de santé sexuelle.* Participer à l’éducation des patients sur la prévention des maladies infectieuses et des IST.* Assurer le suivi administratif et documentaire des consultations.Qualifications* Diplôme d’infirmier·ère reconnu en Suisse, avec reconnaissance CRS si vous l'avez obtenu à l'étranger.* 3 ans d'expérience clinique.* Expérience en vaccination et/ou en santé des voyages un atout* À l’aise avec les outils numériques et la téléconsultation* Intérêt pour la santé globale, la médecine tropicale et la prévention des maladies infectieuses* Sens de l’accueil, autonomie et rigueur professionnelle* Bonnes compétences en français. Anglais et allemand un plusAvantages* Un cadre de travail dynamique et innovant* Une formation spécifique à la médecine des voyages et santé sexuelle* Une flexibilité dans l'organisation du travail* Un environnement bienveillant et collaboratifInformations sur la candidaturePour postuler, veuillez envoyez votre CV, lettre de motivation, copie de vos certificats de travail et diplômes/attestations de formation.j4id10490656jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

jobs.title: Minister, Church of Scotland, Geneva
jobs.description: Minister within the linked charge of the Church of Scotland, Geneva and the Scots Kirk LausanneJob Description :The historic English-speaking Church of Scotland, Geneva is looking for a Minister to lead its life, work and witness. The Church of Scotland, Geneva is linked with the Scots Kirk Lausanne and is a member of the International Presbytery of the Church of Scotland.The selected candidate will be employed locally on a Swiss contract. They will work as a member of the ministry team along with the Minister of the linked charge who is based in Lausanne, and the Ordained Local Minister (OLM) over the full range of parish ministry, and mission and outreach activities.Main Responsibilities :Celebration of the Sacraments – the Lord’s Supper (Holy Communion) and Baptism; Preaching and the conduct of worship; Moderating meetings of the Geneva Kirk Session, which has responsibility for the spiritual issues within the congregation, and guiding the Session in its discussions; Conducting funerals and offering pastoral support to the dying and bereaved; Conducting blessing of weddings that have taken place according to Swiss law and helping people prepare for marriage; Conducting confirmation classes; Providing ministry, including pastoral care, that is not exclusive to the membership of the Church but also to the wider community of Geneva. These responsibilities are rooted in the Church of Scotland “Vows of Ordination and Induction” - see the “Other Information” section for details.Outreach and Mission :Lead and develop strategies to introduce new people to the gospel and draw them into the life of the church. Build relationships with people in the wider community through personal evangelism, community engagement, and partnerships. Encourage, train, and empower church members for outreach, mission and personal witness. Develop pathways for newcomers from first contact to active membership. Congregational Revitalisation :Work with the Minister of the linked charge, the OLM, and the Kirk Sessions to foster spiritual growth, unity, and renewed vision within the congregations. Encourage healthy discipleship through small groups, pastoral visitation, and teaching. Support the integration of new members into the life and ministry of the church. Help identify and develop existing and emerging leaders. Contribute creatively to the renewal of church life, particularly in pastoral care, worship participation, and community life. Enhance the children’s ministry, building on the existing Sunday School. Qualifications & experience :The candidate must: be an ordained ministerbe a passionate shepherd of people, with a proven track record of working within, developing and leading teams, and growing initiatives. embody an integrity of faith and life, with Christ-like values and attitudes. be a strong, authentic communicator capable of relating Biblical truths in meaningful, practical, and creative ways. hold at minimum a university bachelor’s degree in theology or divinity from an accredited institution. preferably have a minimum of 5 years in a lead ministry context.Language :English (fluent) - the working language is English.Non-Swiss/EU/EEA candidates are required for work permit reasons to have beginner level French. Approach & soft skillsGospel-centred communication and humilityRelational warmth Integrity and professionalismCollaborative and relational leadership Encouraging presenceMissional mindset Faithful adherence to church structures International & cultural sensitivity Ecumenical maturity Adaptable and resilient growthCompensation and Benefits:This is a full-time position following the Church of Scotland stipend scale, adjusted for cost of living in Switzerland. Benefits in addition to the stipend include:Use of the manse in GenevaHealth insurance Paid vacationRelocation assistance Support for French language classes The opportunity to continue the ministry to the English-speaking Reformed congregation at the Auditoire de Calvin, the very place from which Calvin’s teaching spread throughout the world and from which John Knox carried the Reformation to Scotland.Duration of Employment: Three years, renewableAnticipated Start Date: As soon as possibleJob type: Full time, Swiss contractAbout the Church of Scotland, Geneva and the Scots Kirk LausanneSee the Joint Congregational Profile and additional information at the following links: https://churchofscotlandgeneva.ch/ http://www.scotskirklausanne.ch/ Other InformationThe responsibilities above are rooted in the context of the “Terms of Responsibility for Ministers serving in the Church of Scotland” and the “Vows of Ordination and Induction” of the Church of Scotland. The link to the handbook is for the sake of information, but do note that some local differences apply:https://ascend.churchofscotland.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/4943-FAPLT-Ministers-HANDBOOK-2025-V6.pdfThe Presbytery of International Charges’ document “Guidance for Ministers taking up or demitting a charge” contains details of arrangements within International Presbytery which may differ from those of Scottish presbyteries. A copy is available upon request.Note to ApplicantsPotential applicants who are not on the Church of Scotland Register of Ministry in categories O or E will have to obtain an International Certificate of Eligibility from the Church of Scotland. Application for this should only be made once the Nominating Committee has confirmed that the application has made the short list. Guidance will be provided at the appropriate time.

jobs.title: Senior Patent Counsel
jobs.description: Established in 1927, SICPA is a Swiss private technology company that supports the effective governance and long\-term prosperity of nations.SICPA sets *the pulse of sovereignty*, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position.The in\-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands\-on partner to the business, advising on day\-to\-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research \& Innovation (R\&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution.The role requires a proactive, collaborative approach, working across R\&I, Commercial and Legal teams to ensure that intellectual property protection supports the company's broader business objectives. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise messages and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels is essential.**Key responsibilities*** Work closely with the Research \& Innovation team, harvest and capture innovation. Pro\-actively look for inventions and create and maintain awareness about use and necessity of patent applications.* Contribute to the acquisition, protection, defence and enforcement (drafting, filing, prosecution, opposition, appeal, etc.) of patent rights; prosecution of a global patent portfolio in the assigned technical areas.* Provide comprehensive patent support to selected projects as an integral member of multidisciplinary project teams.* Formulate strategic practice recommendations in response to commercial, legal and technical developments, this includes evaluating patent validity, patent risk management and infringement issues and reviewing IP\-related agreements.**Essential duties*** Analysis of the innovation and potential inventions, drafting, filing of patent applications and worldwide prosecution; therefore, drafting skills are essential here and prosecution, opposition and infringement matters offer a wide variety of work.* Liaise prior art search reports from external providers and assess feasibility and patentability.* Draft IP related aspects of agreements with third\-party collaborators and service providers.* Oversee patent risk management and provide Freedom to Operate opinion and clearance studies.* Working closely with R\&I division, sales and legal and promote patent culture with good visibility within the company. The direct contact with international colleagues and clients will require commitment, passion, strong communication skills and commercial savviness.**Profile*** PhD (preferred) or master’s degree in chemistry.* Be passionate about the technology you work with and follow the developments within the industry with invested interest.* Qualified European Patent Attorney. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in drafting and prosecuting patent cases after EPA qualification.* Proactive, structured with a collaborative working style with solid team player attributes with the ability to manage relationships with different stakeholders in the company.* Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to work with cross\-functional teams across departments and divisions.* Show flexibility under stress and delivers quality work with strong attention to detail in an autonomous manner.* Fluent in English, French a strong asset is a plusj4id10489905jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

jobs.title: Technical Supplier Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We are supporting our client, a globally recognized healthcare and life sciences organization, in their search for an experienced Technical Supplier Manager (m/f/d) to join their Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) organization, a key pillar of their Global Instrument Network (GIN). This is an 18\-month assignment based in Rotkreuz, Switzerland.**Background:**Our client develops and delivers life\-critical diagnostic solutions that empower healthcare professionals and patients around the world. In this strategic role, you will serve as the vital technical bridge between internal engineering and operations teams and a global network of contract manufacturing partners.You will take technical ownership of instrument components, subassemblies, and production lines. A primary pillar of your daily work is robust manufacturing process design, architecting, validating, and industrializing stable production processes both internally and across supplier sites. Alongside this focus, you will serve as the Technical Project Lead for Technical Transfers (External to External), leading international technology migrations, second\-sourcing ramp\-ups, and capacity expansions to ensure long\-term supply security and premium product quality.The Perfect Candidate possesses a relevant technical degree and demonstrated expertise in statistical process control and project leadership, specifically in external technology transfers and line ramp\-ups. Additionally, strong knowledge of precision manufacturing technologies and production cost optimization is required.**Tasks \& Responsibilities:*** **Manufacturing Process Design \& Industrialization (Core Activity)**    + Process Architecture \& Development: Actively design, optimize, and industrialize robust manufacturing and testing processes for instrument components, electronics, and precision assemblies across the external supply base    + Process Capability \& Validation: Define process validation strategies (IQ/OQ/PQ), design verification protocols, and establish process capability baselines (Cp/Cpk analysis, tolerance studies, and Gage R\&R)    + Design for Excellence (DfX): Partner closely with R\&D during early product development to embed Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, and Testability principles into component designs, preventing manufacturing bottlenecks and driving yield optimization    + Process Risk \& Mitigation: Lead process failure mode and effects analysis (pFMEA), establish poka\-yoke (error\-proofing) controls, and drive root\-cause investigations to engineer out process vulnerabilities* **Technical Project Leadership \& External\-to\-External (E2E) Transfers**    + Lead Technology Transfers: Steer end\-to\-end technical transfers between external contract manufacturers and suppliers (External\-to\-External), including production line relocations, tool duplications, and second\-source qualifications    + Project Governance \& Milestones: Establish qualification master plans (QMPs), define project schedules, align critical milestones, and report progress transparently to cross\-functional leadership within MSAT and GIN    + Cross\-Partner Synchronization: Lead technical alignment and change control across originating sites, receiving supplier facilities, Global Sourcing, Quality Assurance, and Regulatory Affairs* **Technical Supplier Stewardship \& Operations Support**    + Supplier Performance \& Monitoring: Monitor supplier process stability, technical KPIs, and component quality trends across the complete instrument lifecycle    + Deviation Handling \& SCARs: Lead technical problem\-solving teams (8D, Ishikawa, 5\-Why) for component deviations; resolve Supplier Corrective Action Requests sustainably    + Supplier Technical Assessments: Conduct technical evaluations and audits of potential and existing suppliers as part of the formal supplier qualification process    + Operations Projects: Steer supplier\-side engineering changes (without spec change), capacity expansions, and continuous line stabilization initiatives**Your Profile:*** A University degree (Bachelor's, Master's, or Higher Technical Diploma) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Process Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field* At least 5\-6\+ years of relevant industry experience in manufacturing process design, technical supplier management, industrialization, or manufacturing engineering, ideally within medical devices, in\-vitro diagnostics (IVD), pharmaceuticals, or precision high\-tech equipment* Process Design Expertise: Proven hands\-on track record in designing, qualifying, and optimizing manufacturing and test processes. Strong command of statistical process control (SPC), capability studies (Cpk), measurement systems analysis j4id10489771jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

jobs.description: Ref 2592058 \\\| Date: 19 Nov 2026 !\[Pouvoir judiciaire - Direction RH\]( ) \*\*Directrice ou directeur du Tribunal administratif de première instance 80\\-100% \\\[Classe 26\\\]\*\* Votre mission ------------- Le Pouvoir judiciaire est le troisième pouvoir de l'Etat. Séparé des pouvoirs législatif et exécutif, il remplit sa mission en toute indépendance et dispose de sa propre administration. Il réunit l'ensemble des autorités judiciaires du canton, dont le Tribunal administratif de première instance, composé de 6 magistrates et magistrats de carrière et de près de 30 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Il statue sur les recours dirigés contre les décisions d'autorités administratives, cantonales ou communales, dans les limites des compétences qui lui sont attribuées par la loi. Ses principaux domaines de compétence sont le droit des constructions, le droit fiscal, le droit des étrangers et le droit de la circulation routière. Rattachée ou rattaché hiérarchiquement au secrétaire général adjoint chargé de la filière civile et administrative, vous êtes responsable de la conduite de l'ensemble du personnel de la juridiction et assumez la gestion globale des ressources du tribunal. Vous encadrez à cet effet une équipe de direction composée d'une directrice adjointe ou d'un directeur adjoint, d'une ou d'un responsable de secteur, et d'une adjointe administrative ou d'un adjoint administratif. Dans ce rôle\\-clé, vous œuvrez de concert avec la présidence pour organiser l'activité judiciaire et développez avec elle un véritable partenariat dans le but d'assurer la cohésion de la juridiction et de faire progresser sans cesse son fonctionnement et la qualité de ses prestations. Vous dirigez et organisez les secteurs administratif et scientifique de la juridiction, dont vous assurez et optimisez le bon fonctionnement opérationnel, grâce à l'allocation optimale des ressources, au développement de la polyvalence interne et à l'accompagnement au changement. La gestion de vos équipes, la définition et la mise en œuvre des processus, ainsi que l'évaluation de leur efficience sont des aspects primordiaux de votre fonction. Vous pilotez le déploiement et la mise à jour du système de contrôle interne dans votre domaine de compétence et garantissez le suivi des risques et des plans d'actions visant à leur réduction. Vous participez à des projets, ou en conduisez, à impact transversal, institutionnel ou juridictionnel, contribuant à l'atteinte des objectifs stratégiques fixés par le Pouvoir judiciaire ou par la juridiction. Vous collaborez étroitement avec les directrices ou directeurs des autres juridictions et des services de support. Votre profil ------------ Titulaire d'un master universitaire en droit ou en gestion, complété par une formation post\\-graduée en management, vous êtes au bénéfice d'une expérience confirmée de 5 ans au moins dans une fonction de direction ou de management. Vous savez concilier vision globale et direction opérationnelle. Vous avez en outre une bonne connaissance du milieu judiciaire, acquise dans un tribunal, une administration ou une entreprise ou vous avez, à défaut, un intérêt marqué pour ce domaine d'activité. Vous possédez également d'excellentes facultés rédactionnelles. Personne dynamique, rigoureuse, cohérente, flexible et proactive, vous êtes force de propositions. Disposant d'une grande capacité d'analyse et de synthèse, vous savez établir des priorités, résister au stress et faire preuve de pragmatisme. Vous possédez des qualités de leader qui font de vous une personne reconnue de vos collaboratrices ou collaborateurs, de vos collègues et de vos partenaires, et vous savez concilier vision stratégique et contraintes opérationnelles. Grâce à votre assertivité et à votre persévérance, associées à un sens aigu de la négociation et de la communication, vous créez un climat de travail motivant, empreint de respect et de confiance mutuels ainsi que de professionnalisme. Possédant un bon entregent, vous savez développer un réseau et dynamiser les équipes avec lesquelles vous collaborez. Vos compétences sociales et relationnelles vous permettent de fédérer et de convaincre. Personnalité crédible et solide, vous faites preuve d'exemplarité et êtes perçue ou perçu comme une ou un manager responsable et facilitant. Vous avez la sensibilité requise pour le service public et êtes prête ou prêt à vous engager pleinement dans l'exercice d'une fonction de management passionnante, exigeante et de haut niveau. Vos avantages ------------- Prestations sociales de qualité. Nous vous offrons l'opportunité de rejoindre une institution en charge d'une mission passionnante et essentielle pour la collectivité publique et de contribuer à son bon fonctionnement. Observations ------------ Un extrait du casier judiciaire et une attestation du registre des poursuites et des faillites seront systématiquement requis à la fin du processus de recrutement. jobs.title: Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments) 80-100%
jobs.description: **About PG3**PG3 AG is the family office of the Partners Group founders and was established in 2013\. As a FINMA regulated asset manager, we manage a range of niche investment strategies for our founders and investors. We focus on uncorrelated returns which ensure material diversification both in terms of underlying sectors and investment structures.**About the role**PG3 AG is looking for a **Fund Operations Specialist (Alternative Investments)**to join our Fund Operations team in Baar, ZG (Switzerland), on an 80\-100% basis.In this role, you will take ownership of the accounting and fund administration of a diverse portfolio of investment products throughout their lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include supporting fund launches, restructurings and wind\-downs, as well as overseeing ongoing accounting, NAV preparation, financial reporting and operational monitoring. You will work closely with internal teams and external service providers to ensure accurate seamless execution and high stakeholder satisfaction.The Fund Operations team manages a broad mandate across alternative (insurance finance, legal finance, royalty finance) and traditional asset classes, including equities and credit. You will be part of a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment, contributing to both strategic and operational initiatives.Key Responsibilities:* Support day\-to\-day financial administration and accounting of investment funds and related entities including all fund transactions (subscriptions, redemptions, capital calls, distributions, loans and FX transactions).* Review and reconcile quarterly NAV calculations, including cash balances, investment positions, financial transactions and management and performance fee calculations.* Coordinate with external fund administrators, AIFMs, custodians, banks, auditors and other service providers in reconciling portfolio and cash flows of investment positions.* Monitor fund liquidity, cash flows, loans and settlement processes.* Maintain accurate fund records, transaction documentation, and operational databases.* Coordinate annual auditsand liaise with external auditors, fund administrators, and other service providers on accounting\-related matters, providing supporting documentation.* Assist with new fund launches, restructurings, investments, disposals and liquidations.* Support the onboarding and ongoing administration of investors, assisting with periodic KYC refreshes, FATCA/CRS reporting and other compliance\-related information requests.* Execution of investment reporting with precision and timeliness* Provide support across our middle\- and back\-office functions.* Application of regulatory and legal knowledge in daily operations**About you**We are looking for a proactive, detail\-oriented self\-starter who thrives in a dynamic and multicultural environment. You should be motivated by high standards, eager to take ownership, and comfortable navigating complexity. Ideally, you bring:* University degree (or equivalent qualification) in business administration, finance or economics* At least 2 years of relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration, asset management, accounting or financial advisory* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities within tight deadlines* A collaborative mindset with a willingness to go the extra mile* Exhibit accuracy, efficiency, independence, and a strong sense of responsibility* Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus)* A keen interest in alternative investments and exposure to the full investment lifecyclePlease submit your complete application, including a CV, cover letter, relevant certificates, and references.j4id10489921jm j4it1147jm j4iy26jm

jobs.description: Sous Chef SWISS First Class Lounges (all genders)DoN Lounge Catering \- Zürich \- VollzeitDu willst nicht einfach irgendeine Küche? Unsere renommierten Lounges stehen für erstklassige Hospitality und wurden bereits mehrfach für ihre herausragende Qualität ausgezeichnet. Anders gedacht. Mutig gemacht. Als exklusiver Premium\-Catering\-Partner der SWISS Lounges in Zürich und Genf gestalten wir täglich besondere Genussmomente für über 1,7 Millionen Gäste jährlich. Mit rund 270 Mitarbeitenden an den Flughäfen Zürich und Genf schaffen wir kulinarische Erlebnisse, die in Erinnerung bleiben.Für unsere SWISS First Class Lounges am Flughafen Zürich suchen wir eine engagierte, führungsstarke und leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeit als Sous Chef.**Shape the culinary future with us \- we don't work here, we create.****Dein Aufgabengebiet**Deine Rolle – die rechte Hand des Head ChefsAls Sous Chef bist du die operative und fachliche Stellvertretung des Head Chefs. Gemeinsam führt ihr ein rund 20\-köpfiges Küchenteam und stellt sicher, dass unsere hohen kulinarischen Ansprüche Tag für Tag umgesetzt werden. Du bist Vorbild, Motivator und Gastgeber aus Leidenschaft. weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus* Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (7\-Tage Betrieb)* Kreativität, fundiertes Fachwissen und Begeisterung für hochwertige Kulinarik* Ausgeprägtes Qualitäts\-, Hygiene\- und Kostenbewusstsein* Organisationstalent, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise* Du bist eine authentische Führungspersönlichkeit, gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran und packst selbst mit an* Gute Deutschkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus* Freude an einem internationalen Umfeld und unterschiedlichen Kulturen* Erste Führungserfahrung und Freude daran, Mitarbeitende zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln**Das bieten wir**Warum DoN?Weil wir dir mehr bieten als nur einen Arbeitsplatz.* **Entwicklung** Wir investieren in deine Entwicklung: **mit unserer internen Academy**, praxisnahen Schulungen und individuellen Coaching\-Sessions mit einem persönlichen Coach. Zusätzlich erhältst du Zugang zu unserer WebAcademy und wir unterstützen dich bei der Finanzierung von Sprachkursen. So kannst du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen.* **Attraktive Benefits*** **Kostenlose Verpflegung** während der Arbeit sowie CHF 50\.– monatlicher Beitrag an deinen Arbeitsweg / ÖV.* **Mitarbeiter werben Mitarbeiter Prämie**.* **Starkes Team*** Professionell arbeiten, gemeinsam besser werden und dabei die Leidenschaft für Gastronomie leben.* **Internationales Umfeld*** Arbeite dort, wo täglich Menschen aus aller Welt zusammenkommen.* Verantwortung \& Vertrauen* **Dein Posten gehört dir.*** Deine Leistung zählt.* Abwechslung, **Lounges, Events, saisonale Konzepte** und wechselnde Herausforderungen sorgen dafür, dass kein Tag wie der andere ist.

documentation and implementation of approved model releases  \- Develop implementation, handover and knowledge transfer documentation  \- Coordinate activities with Data Science teams and technical jobs.description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Climate, Environment \& Health Coordinator --- Climate, Environment \\\& Health Coordinator ========================================== \*\*Join MSF OCG as a Climate, Environment \\\& Health Coordinator !\*\* \*\*We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.\*\* \*\*Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.\*\* Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF -------------------------------- Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job? We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with. We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don't fulfil every listed qualification. We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics. MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks. Context \\\& mission ------------------ Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man\\-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter). The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers. We are looking for a Climate, Environment \\\& Health (CEH) Coordinator to join MSF OCG. Reporting to the Deputy General Director, the CEH Coordinator is responsible for leading and coordinating OCG's strategic approach to reducing the environmental impact of its activities, while strengthening the integration of the health and humanitarian consequences of climate change into operational position works closely with the Logistics, Medical, Communication and Operations departments, supporting field missions and contributing to more relevant, responsible and effective humanitarian operations. Tasks \\\& Responsibilities ------------------------- Develop and implement OCG's strategy to address climate change and environmental issues across its activities.Support the integration of climate risks and evolving patterns of climate\\-sensitive diseases into operational planning to strengthen the relevance of operational responses.Promote the reduction of environmental impacts across OCG's activities to enhance the environmental responsibility of MSF operations.Coordinate cross\\-functional initiatives on climate and environmental issues to ensure alignment and consistency across OCG.Develop frameworks, guidelines, and tools to support teams in effectively addressing climate risks and environmental impacts.Monitor progress towards climate and environmental objectives to ensure accountability and continuous improvement, including overseeing the organisation's annual carbon accounting process.Represent OCG in intersectional and external meetings on climate, environment, and health. Your profile ------------ \*Education\* Essential: Advanced university degree in environmental health, climate change, sustainability, environmental engineering, or a related field.Desired: Certification in carbon accounting. \*Experience\* Essential: Experience in a similar role or in leading cross\\-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders without direct hierarchical experience with MSF or another humanitarian organization is an asset. \*Languages\* English and French are mandatory.Additional languages are an asset. \*Skills/ Technical competencies\* Carbon accounting.Environmental sustainability and climate and humanitarian impacts of climate change.Strategic planning and change analytics, monitoring, reporting, and performance tracking. \*Personal Abilities/Qualities\* Strategic thinking.Influencing and stakeholder engagement skills.Analytical and problem\\-solving skills.Coordination and facilitation skills.Communication and presentation skills.Project and change management skills.Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and demonstrate commitment to diversity, gender\\-responsive, inclusive, and non\\-discriminatory behaviours and attitudes. Terms of employment ------------------- Full\\-time position 100% (40h/week)Open\\-ended contractWorking place: GenevaIdeal start date: 1st of December 2026 Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 119'964\\.\\- to CHF 137'640\\.\\- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.Relocation support available for eligible candidates. How to apply ------------ Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines: CV (maximum 2 pages)Cover letter (maximum 1 page)Documents must be submitted in either English or French. \*\*The application deadline is 10thof november 2026\\.\*\* \*We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.\* \[\*\*APPLY\*\*\](\< \>) \*\*All applications will be treated confidentially.\*\* \*\*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.\*\* \*\*Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.\*\* !\[Médecins Sans Frontières\]( ) \* Médecins Sans Frontières Route de Ferney 140 1202 Genève \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid35b9c7ejm jpit1147jm jpiy26jm

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
jobs.description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

What we need...

- 6+ years of quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals

- Experience selling EPM, FP&A, planning, or other Office-of-the-CFO software (finance, ERP, spend, or data platforms)

- A track record of closing six-figure ARR deals with 3–6 month cycles and hitting or beating quota

- Comfort leading multi-stakeholder deals with finance, IT, procurement and security at the table

- Experience displacing an incumbent, whether a legacy system or a spreadsheet-based process

- A consultative, value-based approach: you build a business case in a CFO's language

- The drive to build your own pipeline, not wait for inbound

- Clear, sharp written and verbal communication, including running demos with senior buyers

- Based in EMEA, with the ability to travel to customers and events

Bonus points if you have...

- Sold with or through ERP ecosystems (NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Microsoft Dynamics) or implementation partners

- Worked in finance, or you're comfortable talking models, drivers and variances with an FP&A team

- Used a structured sales method (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message, or similar)

- Been an early seller at a scaling company and helped build the enterprise playbook

Why sell Abacum

You know the category. Here's why this is the product you want in your bag.

1. A market ready to switch. Finance teams are stuck between rigid legacy planning tools that need a rebuild every time the business changes, and spreadsheets and AI tools no one can trust. Abacum is the governed, AI-native foundation that fixes both. That's a displacement story you can tell in every account.

2. AI that stands up to a CFO. Plenty of vendors claim AI. Ours runs on a governed financial model, so the AI reasons and the math stays exact. CFOs and IT teams can trust the output, and that wins technical evaluations.

3. Faster time to value than legacy EPM. 700+ integrations and self-service data pipelines mean customers see value in weeks, not after a long implementation. That shortens your cycle and makes the business case easy to sign.

4. Channels that bring you deals. Abacum is the only FP&A platform to pass NetSuite's SuiteCloud Developer Network review, is listed on the Sage Intacct Marketplace, and is a verified Microsoft Dynamics 365 partner. Those ecosystems and our implementation partners mean co-sell pipeline, not just cold outbound.

5. A product that keeps getting stronger. New AI skills ship every week. Abacum works where finance already works: Excel, Slack, Claude and ChatGPT, through MCP-native infrastructure. You'll have something new to show every quarter.

6. Funded to win enterprise. Abacum raised a $60M Series B to scale into larger customers. You'll join as we build the enterprise motion, with the room to shape it and grow with it.

What you get

- Competitive base, uncapped commission, and equity

- Remote in EMEA, with hubs in New York, Toronto and Barcelona

- Direct access to leadership and a real say in how we sell to enterprise

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation including equity package

  • Competitive vacation policy

  • Medical Insurance

  • L&D budget

  • Access to Meditopia (wellbeing platform)

  • Language courses (English / Spanish)

Our Values

Customer Obsession: Our purpose is to create value for the finance teams we serve. We pour our energy into driving impact for them fast, and we measure our success by theirs.

Relentless Ambition: We chose to compete at the top alongside the best. We set ambitious goals, and keep pushing when it gets hard. Nothing worth having comes easy.

One Team: There is no “they” at Abacum: “their” problem is our problem. We’re candid because we care, we help each other grow, and we embrace different perspectives.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager - German Speaking (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt entweder in Berlin, München oder komplett remote in Deutschland; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit:

  • In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden.

  • Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys.

  • Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends.

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

  • Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen.

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden.

  • Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.

  • Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil.

  • Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil.

Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten.

Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst, freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

jobs.title: Responsable d'offres techniques (F/H)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Responsable d’offres techniques (F/H) en CDI pour venir renforcer nos équipes HEMERIA SERVICES au sein de notre division LAND & SEA sur Villebon-Sur-Yvette.

Au cœur de notre développement, vous pilotez la construction de nos offres techniques et commerciales, de l’analyse du besoin client jusqu’à la remise de la proposition. En lien étroit avec le Bureau d’Études, les ingénieurs et les équipes commerciales, vous contribuez aux choix techniques, à la qualité des réponses et au développement de nouvelles offres. 

Missions :

Construire et piloter les offres techniques 

  • Analyser les cahiers des charges, les spécifications clients et les dossiers de consultation afin d’identifier les besoins, les exigences, les contraintes et les risques. 

  • Rédiger les offres techniques et les mémoires techniques en vous appuyant sur les membres du Bureau d’Études (BE), les ingénieurs spécialistes et les experts métiers. 

  • Piloter la définition des solutions techniques proposées et décider des orientations de réponse, en tenant compte de la faisabilité, des performances attendues, des coûts, des délais et des engagements contractuels. 

  • Mobiliser les ingénieurs et les contributeurs internes pour challenger les solutions, instruire les points techniques et construire des réponses robustes et différenciantes. 

  • Consolider les spécifications techniques, les données d’entrée, les architectures et les nomenclatures complètes (BOM) afin de garantir la cohérence et l’exhaustivité des propositions. 

Coordonner les contributeurs et sécuriser les jalons 

  • Organiser et suivre les revues d’offres ainsi que les différents jalons de préparation et de remise, en étroite collaboration avec le responsable commercial. 

  • Assurer la coordination entre les équipes techniques, le BE, les ingénieurs, les experts métiers et les interlocuteurs commerciaux. 

  • Anticiper les points de blocage, identifier les risques et suivre les actions nécessaires au respect des échéances. 

  • Contribuer à la consolidation des chiffrages et vérifier la cohérence technico-économique des propositions et des engagements pris. 

Améliorer les méthodes et les outils de chiffrage 

  • Proposer et piloter l’amélioration des outils de chiffrage, notamment automatisés, afin d’accélérer le flux de traitement et de remise des offres. 

  • Identifier les possibilités d’automatisation, de standardisation et de capitalisation des données techniques et économiques. 

  • Fiabiliser les méthodes et les référentiels utilisés pour gagner en rapidité, en qualité et en répétabilité dans la construction des offres. 

Développer de nouvelles offres produits et services 

  • Être force de proposition dans la conception de nouvelles offres de services et de produits, en lien avec les équipes d’ingénierie, les experts et le commerce. 

  • Identifier les opportunités de valorisation des savoir-faire de l’entreprise et contribuer à la diversification de ses propositions. 

  • Participer à la structuration de solutions techniques et commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux besoins émergents des clients et aux évolutions des marchés.

Profil :

  • Formation supérieure technique (école d’ingénieur ou équivalent), ou expérience significative permettant de maîtriser des environnements techniques. 

  • Expérience dans la construction, la rédaction et le pilotage d’offres techniques, idéalement dans un environnement industriel, technologique ou de systèmes complexes. 

  • Bonne connaissance du secteur de la Défense et aisance dans des environnements à fortes exigences de criticité. Une expérience dans l’aéronautique, le naval, le spatial ou les industries sensibles sera également appréciée. 

  • Capacité à comprendre et challenger des solutions techniques, à exploiter des spécifications et à consolider des nomenclatures. 

  • Aptitude à mobiliser des équipes pluridisciplinaires et à faire travailler ensemble des interlocuteurs aux expertises variées. 

  • Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et capacité à piloter plusieurs offres en parallèle avec des échéances parfois contraintes. 

  • Appétence pour l’amélioration des processus, l’automatisation et les outils de chiffrage. 

  • Vous êtes curieux(se), dynamique et force de proposition. 

  • Vous êtes à l’aise dans les échanges avec les ingénieurs, les experts métiers, les équipes commerciales et les responsables opérationnels. 

  • Vous savez prendre du recul, challenger les solutions et arbitrer les orientations de réponse dans votre périmètre. 

  • Vous appréciez les environnements collaboratifs dans lesquels l’autonomie, l’initiative et le sens du collectif sont essentiels. 

Localisation : Possibilité d'occuper le poste depuis Toulouse, avec des déplacements réguliers à prévoir à Villebon-sur-Yvette, à raison de 2 à 3 jours par semaine.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

  • Des projets passionnants et stratégiques : des sujets technologiques variés dans les univers Terre, Mer, Air et Spatial, avec des applications concrètes dans des environnements exigeants. 

  • Une équipe jeune et dynamique : une équipe engagée, portée par la collaboration, l’initiative et l’envie de progresser. 

  • Un management de proximité : des managers accessibles et impliqués, qui favorisent les échanges directs, l’autonomie et la prise d’initiative. 

  • Une entreprise en croissance : une dynamique de développement soutenue depuis cinq ans, offrant la possibilité de contribuer directement à la structuration et à l’évolution de l’entreprise. 

  • Un environnement stimulant en région parisienne : un poste au contact direct des équipes d’ingénierie et commerciales, au cœur des projets et des décisions. 

🌟 NOS AVANTAGES :

💼 Avantages sociaux : mutuelle gratuite et familiale, tickets restaurant, participation et intéressement.
🕐 Organisation flexible : horaires aménageables pour un meilleur équilibre vie pro / perso.
🚀 Évolution & formation : mobilité interne, parcours personnalisés et accompagnement de carrière.
🌿 Qualité de vie au travail : compte épargne-temps, droit à la déconnexion, etc.

jobs.title: Technical Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
As an individual contributor sitting at the intersection of engineering and business, you turn complex memory technology and system concepts into accurate, accessible, and compelling technical content. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams, as well as memory design and strategic partnership teams, you gather validated information to create key materials, including product and specification documents in line with system architects and product managers, datasheets, reference manuals, whitepapers, application notes, technical blogs, and technical presentation decks.

In addition to technical content creation, you will participate in customer first technical meetings to present and support the specifications and technical claims before highly technical audiences. 

Reporting to Vertical Compute’s Product Marketing Lead, this is a hands-on individual-contributor role with a direct impact on how our technology is understood and brought to market.

Technical writing/content development  |  primary focus

  • Write technical documentation (product, specifications..), customer-facing datasheets, reference manuals.

  • Create, edit and maintain technical blogs, in-depth whitepapers, application notes, product/technology briefs, FAQs and other long-form technical content.

  • Develop customer-facing datasheets and specification documents based on requirements and parameters defined and approved by Product/Engineering.

  • Create architecture diagrams, explanatory visuals, technical slide content and compelling material for conference talks, abstracts and presentations.

  • Adapt approved technical information for audiences ranging from semiconductor specialists to system architects, partners and technically minded business stakeholders.

  • Create and coordinate high-quality technical content: website copy, product pages, whitepapers, presentations, and conference materials

Interface with Product, Architecture & Engineering

  • Work closely with the Product/Architecture team and relevant engineering experts to gather information about functionality, use cases, performance, power, bandwidth, integration and system-level trade-offs.

  • Ask probing technical questions, distinguish demonstrated results from targets, and turn source material into precise, readable drafts.

  • Coordinate technical review and approval with the relevant subject-matter owners and marketing lead before external release; maintain the traceability and versioning of technical claims.

Technical marketing & enablement

  • Participate in first-level customer technical meetings to present and support technical specifications, architecture choices, and performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs to system architects.

  • Support early customer engagements with tailored messaging and technical storytelling

  • Produce technically sound product and competitive comparisons that support the positioning and priorities defined by the Marketing Lead.

  • Develop technical content for product pages, demonstrations, customer briefings, partner presentations and Business Development enablement.

  • Support agreed conference submissions and product milestones with the technical material needed by speakers and customer-facing teams.

  • Support presence at industry events, conferences, and partner demos

Content execution & quality

  • Own timelines, drafts, review loops, version control and delivery for assigned content; flag missing inputs and risks early.

  • Maintain a curated, approved repository of technical facts, diagrams, reusable explanations and reference materials.

  • Demonstrate adaptability to a fast-moving startup environment and evolving targets.


Training background :  Degree in electronics, microelectronics, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical field; equivalent relevant experience is also welcome.

Relevant experience:   Practical experience in technical writing, technical marketing, applications engineering, product engineering, or another engineering-facing communication role. Suitable seniority may range from an emerging independent contributor to an experienced specialist.

Technical / industry knowledge:  Solid understanding of semiconductor hardware and system concepts; familiarity with memory architectures, SoCs, AI accelerators, advanced packaging or compute infrastructure is strongly valued. Ability to understand performance/power/bandwidth trade-offs and data from technical experts is essential.

Writing / communication: Excellent written and spoken English; ability to communicate effectively in meetings, structure detailed technical arguments, edit precisely, and tailor content to technical audiences. Evidence of authored documentation or published technical content is a strong plus.

Design & Visual Content Independence: Must be capable of creating compelling technical content, diagrams, and visual assets independently (e.g. Powerpoint, Google slides, Canva, Gimp..) without relying on external agencies, and should be well-versed with office productivity tools and presentation software.

Interpersonal skills and ways of working:  Curious, rigorous, comfortable challenging ambiguous input; proactive in working with engineers; strong prioritization, commitment to deadlines and careful technical-review discipline.


Other considerations:  Portfolio or writing samples preferred. You should be able to write strong first drafts independently, while keeping in mind that final product definitions and external claims are handled by the product and marketing leads.

Generative AI Tools: Familiarity with generative AI tools and workflows to enhance content creation productivity and efficiency.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Platform Engineer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Platform Engineer. Iemand die zelfstandig complete IT-omgevingen ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert. Je pakt complexe migraties van A tot Z op en bouwt met visie aan een ijzersterk platform.

Jouw rol

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.

  • Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.

  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.

  • Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.

  • Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.

  • Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.

  • Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.  

  • Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.


Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau. Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code. Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands.

Wat bieden wij jou?

jobs.title: Senior transformatieconsultant
jobs.description:
0,8 tot 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | € 5.086 - € 7.800 | Transformatie van organisaties | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat.

Als senior transformatieconsultant begeleid je complexe en vaak meerjarige veranderprogramma’s bij grote organisaties. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie en uitvoering, verbindt experts vanuit verschillende vakgebieden en helpt opdrachtgevers om het transitieproces met succes te implementeren.

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

Dit ga je doen

Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan

Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. Het doel is om de organisatie duurzaam anders te laten functioneren, zodat zij beter kan inspelen op nieuwe strategische uitdagingen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse regie op omvangrijke verandertrajecten bij opdrachtgevers. Vaak gaat het om programma’s die meerdere jaren lopen en waarbij meerdere organisatieonderdelen betrokken zijn. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, organisatie-inrichting, processen & technologie, hr-processen, organisatiedynamiek en leiderschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat verandering niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd.

Je verbindt mensen en expertise

De kracht van Berenschot zit in de combinatie van verschillende expertises. Afhankelijk van de opgave werk je samen met collega's op het gebied van organisatieontwikkeling, hr, leiderschap, cultuur, data-analyse, functiewaardering, bedrijfsvoering en collega’s uit specifieke sectoren. Denk daarbij aan openbaar bestuur, bedrijfsleven en energie & leefomgeving.

Jij brengt deze expertise samen rond één gezamenlijke ambitie. Je creëert structuur, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat mensen elkaar versterken en resultaten worden behaald.

Je bent een vertrouwde gesprekspartner voor bestuurders

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen.

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties

Naast je opdrachten draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze propositie. Je deelt kennis, ontwikkelt nieuwe aanpakken en begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s in hun professionele groei.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. 

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt te werken binnen de adviesgroep Transformaties van organisaties. Vanuit verschillende expertisegebieden werken we samen aan complexe veranderopgaven bij onze klanten. Vaak gebeurt dit onder regie van een transformatiepartner of programmamanager.

Wij geloven dat duurzame verandering alleen lukt wanneer strategie, organisatiestructuur, processen, systemen, hr, cultuur en leiderschap in samenhang worden aangepakt. Daarom werken we nadrukkelijk multidisciplinair en zoeken we collega’s die energie krijgen van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en expertise.

Je werkt regelmatig zelfstandig bij de klant, maar bent nooit alleen. Achter je staat een sterk netwerk van collega’s dat je kunt inzetten wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Juist die combinatie van zelfstandigheid, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk zo bijzonder.


Dit neem je mee

  • Een academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal zes jaar ervaring met complexe verander-, transformatie- of reorganisatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld als programmamanager, verandermanager of transformatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van omvangrijke programma’s binnen complexe organisaties en stakeholderomgevingen.

  • Het vermogen om verschillende expertises, belangen en mensen samen te brengen rond een gezamenlijke opgave.

  • Ondernemerschap en gevoel voor kansen in de markt. Je bouwt graag aan klantrelaties en duurzame samenwerkingen.

  • Verbindend leiderschap en een uitmuntend teamplayerschap. Je brengt rust, overzicht en vertrouwen, ook wanneer de omgeving dynamisch of politiek gevoelig is.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 5.086– en € 7.800,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • een representatievergoeding van € 3.000,- per jaar

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een mobiliteitsregeling naar keuze: een auto van de zaak of een mobiliteitsbudget

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Krijg jij energie van het begeleiden van complexe organisatieveranderingen? Vind je het leuk om mensen, expertise en belangen samen te brengen en langdurig samen te werken met klanten aan duurzame resultaten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen.

Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om een assessment te maken. Blijkt daaruit dat jij goed past bij Berenschot en onze manier van werken? Dan doen we je graag een passend aanbod.

Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je van harte welkom in ons team.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
TYTAN Technologies

The PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We push boundaries, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who are driven by ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect European sovereignty.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Hardware-in-the-Loop Systems to join our Platform Team. Our interceptors fly autonomous missions from launch to intercept. Before a software change flies in the air, we want to see it fly on the bench: the real mission computer and flight controller, flying a full simulated mission in real time against simulated physics, sensors and targets. We are taking our hardware-in-the-loop testing to full closed-loop missions, and you lead that build.

You are a builder, not a test author. You design the rigs, couple the simulation to the hardware, and build the framework so that our autonomy and perception engineers write and run their own HIL scenarios on every change.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • The closed loop: Couple real-time physics, sensor and target simulation to real flight hardware. Inject IMU, GNSS, camera and other sensor data at the interface the hardware expects, close the loop on actuator commands, and keep latency, jitter and time synchronisation within budget, so a flight on the rig behaves like a flight in the air.

  • Fault injection: Sensor failures, GNSS denial and spoofing, link loss, bus errors and power faults, reproducible on demand.

  • System rigs: Rigs for the current and next generation mission computer and for full system configurations with ground station, radio link and interceptors. Provisioned as code, with automated deployment of builds, remote power control, health monitoring and self-recovery.

  • HIL in CI: Merge-gating regression suites, nightly and long-running mission suites, rig scheduling across pipelines, flaky test detection, and structured results traceable to requirements.

  • Test framework: Fixtures for devices, instruments and simulators, so that a domain engineer writes a HIL test as easily as a unit test, and the same scenario runs in SIL and HIL.

  • HIL as a product: Your users are our autonomy, perception and systems engineers. Availability and time to result are your metrics, also in restricted and air-gapped lab networks.


  • 4+ years building HIL or hardware test systems for embedded or autonomous systems, including at least one closed-loop rig you designed and built yourself, not only operated or wrote test cases for

  • Real-time simulation coupled to hardware: plant and sensor models running in real time against real hardware, on commercial HIL platforms or custom Linux-based rigs

  • Expert Python, plus C or C++ for real-time components

  • Strong Linux and CI: self-hosted runners with hardware in the loop, containerised test environments, device management, remote power and console control

  • Debugging across the hardware and software boundary: embedded interfaces such as CAN, UART, SPI and Ethernet, and timing problems you have measured, not guessed

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to haves

  • Flight or vehicle dynamics models, and PX4 or ArduPilot SITL/HITL

  • HIL platforms such as dSPACE, NI PXI/VeriStand or Speedgoat

  • Sensor stimulation at the hardware interface: IMU, GNSS, camera and video injection

  • Time synchronisation (e.g. PTP), real-time Linux and jitter measurement

  • Test frameworks at scale (pytest or Robot Framework) and instrument control via SCPI or VISA

  • FMI/FMU or Gazebo-based simulation

  • MAVLink and flight controller interfaces

  • GNSS simulators (e.g. Spirent, Safran Skydel) and RF environment simulation

  • Camera and image generation pipelines for perception testing

  • Requirements-based testing in DO-178C or ISO 26262 contexts

  • Rust for performance-critical test components

  • Firmware for test fixtures on microcontrollers

  • End-of-line test stations

Why TYTAN?

  • Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defense systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security

  • Shape scalable defense capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale

  • Contribute to networked air defense: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defense architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors

  • Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback

  • Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact

  • Define a new generation of defense technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company

  • Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe

Our Benefits

  • Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation

  • Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit

  • Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us

  • Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team

  • Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together

  • Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands

  • Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

jobs.description: Word jij onze nieuwe beveiligingstechnicus bij Unica in Geleen? Ben jij klaar om je carrière een boost te geven binnen de dynamische wereld van beveiligingstechnologie? Unica is op zoek naar getalenteerde beveiligingstechnici, die ons team in Geleen komen versterken. Of je nu net je diploma hebt behaald of al jaren ervaring hebt in de branche, wij hebben de perfecte uitdaging voor jou! Jouw uitdaging als Beveiligingstechnicus Als Servicetechnicus Beveiliging bij Unica ben je het hart van onze operatie. Je gaat zelfstandig aan de slag met het installeren, programmeren en onderhouden van inbraakdetectie-, camerabewaking-, intercom- en toegangscontrolesystemen.
