Je krijgt de kans om te groeien, te leren en jezelf te overtreffen, zowel in technische vaardigheden als in dienstverlening. We bieden je: Goed salaris: tussen € 3.724,- en € 4.865,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), afhankelijk van jouw expertise. Daarnaast deel je mee in de winst die Unica maakt met onze winstdelingsregeling. Tools: Een elektrische Unica servicewagen en persoonlijk gereedschap. Vrije tijd: 25 vakantiedagen en 13 Adv-dagen om te ontspannen en te genieten. Pensioen: Uitstekende pensioenregeling via het Pensioenfonds Metaal waarbij Unica twee-derde van jouw premie betaalt. Ontwikkeling en doorgroeimogelijkheden: Toegang tot een breed scala aan opleidingen encursussen. Unica is een grote organisatie met ruime doorgroeimogelijkheden waarbij wij graag invulling geven aan jouw persoonlijke ambities. Natuurlijk vragen we ook wat van jou Opleiding: Afgeronde MBV- of TBV-opleiding. Ervaring: In de beveiligingstechniek is een pre, evenals kennis van ICT-netwerken. Skills: Zelfstandig, teamspeler, nauwkeurig en kwaliteitsbewust. Taal: Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal. Persoonlijkheid: Je bent nieuwsgierig, innovatief en gedreven. Vanwege onze werkzaamheden voor overheidsinstanties is het noodzakelijk dat je een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) kunt overleggen. Jouw team Unica Smart Security is specialist op gebied van beveiligingsoplossingen. We leveren turn key oplossingen voor fysieke omgevingen binnen het middensegment voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven. Onze dienstverlening richt zich op gebouwbeveiliging, security management, remote dienstverlening, cloud oplossingen, service & onderhoud en het certificeren van beveiligingssystemen. Je komt te werken in een dynamische omgeving die iedere dag slimmer en complexer wordt. Een wereld waarin iedere sector uniek is en haar eigen specifieke uitdagingen, regelgeving en wensen kent. Binnen Unica Smart Security vinden we het leuk om ons te verdiepen in de complexe techniek/vragen, werkomgevingen, en hebben de absolute wil om onszelf voortdurend te verbeteren. Het resultaat en klanttevredenheid staat altijd voorop. Unica Smart Security is onderdeel van het cluster Unica Access & Security; de full-service dienstverlener op het gebied van toegangsverlening en -beveiliging. Wie zijn wij? Met ruim 90 jaar ervaring in de technische dienstverlening is Unica de robuuste werkgever. Vakmanschap staat bij ons centraal. We geloven in onze mensen, in onze teams en in onze klanten. jobs.title: Director of Platform Engineering [gn] – Data Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
About Actian

Actian is the company behind the Data Intelligence Platform — an enterprise solution that helps organisations discover, govern, and trust their data at scale.

Our platform connects metadata, data lineage, data quality, and business context into a single knowledge graph, enabling enterprises to turn raw data into reliable decisions and providing the trusted data foundation required for enterprise AI.

We operate globally, move fast, and build for the long term.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Director of Platform Engineering or Director of DevOps to establish and lead our newly formed Platform Engineering organisation.

This is a hands-on technical leadership position for an engineering leader who has successfully built and scaled platform or infrastructure teams within a technology product company.

You will not simply inherit and manage an existing organisation. You will build the team, define its technical direction, establish its operating model, and remain closely involved in architecture and implementation.

You should be someone who can move confidently between strategic decisions and hands-on engineering: designing infrastructure, reviewing code, implementing automation, solving complex production challenges, and setting engineering standards.

We are an AI-first engineering organisation. We expect you to actively use AI technologies to accelerate engineering, automate infrastructure operations, and fundamentally rethink how platform teams work.

This is a builder's role, not a traditional executive management position.

 


What You Will Own:

1. Platform Engineering & Architecture

  • Establish and lead the Platform Engineering organisation from the ground up.
  • Design and implement scalable, reliable platform services supporting our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Define the architecture and engineering standards used across the organisation.
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and effective collaboration with product engineering teams.

    • 2. Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Design and deliver a cloud-agnostic deployment architecture across AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, and customer-managed on-premises and private-cloud environments.
  • Build and maintain Kubernetes-based infrastructure in production.
  • Own infrastructure as code using Terraform/Terragrunt and GitOps-based deployment using Argo CD or equivalent technologies.
  • Ensure reliable installation, upgrades, maintenance, and supportability across different customer environments.
  • Support restricted-network and air-gapped deployment scenarios where required.

    • 3. AI-First Engineering & Infrastructure Operations

  • Integrate AI agents into infrastructure operations, including incident triage, remediation, change validation, and reporting.
  • Use AI coding assistants and development agents extensively in your own daily engineering work.
  • Establish practical standards for AI-assisted engineering across the platform team.
  • Identify opportunities to replace traditional tools and operational processes with AI-driven automation.
  • Build the infrastructure required to support AI and ML workloads, including model-serving environments and associated data services.
  • Ensure appropriate human oversight, security guardrails, and auditability for AI-driven operations.

    • 4. Security, Compliance & Reliability

  • Establish security and compliance practices supporting SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and GDPR.
  • Ensure compliance with EU data residency and customer-specific security requirements.
  • Implement automated compliance evidence collection and audit readiness.
  • Establish observability, monitoring, incident management, and on-call practices.

    • 5. Team Building & Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Platform Engineering team.
  • Define the team's structure, responsibilities, processes, and engineering culture.
  • Remain technically involved while developing the team's capabilities and autonomy.
  • Work closely with the SVP of Engineering and other technical leaders to align platform strategy with business and product priorities.

    • What You Will Deliver in Your First 12 Months:
  • Build and establish a high-performing Platform Engineering team with clear ownership and responsibilities.
  • Deliver a portable deployment architecture supporting AWS, at least one additional public cloud, and customer-managed infrastructure.
  • Establish infrastructure as code and GitOps delivery as standard engineering practices.
  • Introduce AI agents into operational workflows, with measurable reductions in manual effort and operational overhead.
  • Deliver scalable infrastructure foundations for our data catalog, knowledge graph, and integration APIs.
  • Automate compliance evidence collection and improve audit readiness.
  • Establish a reliable operating model covering observability, incident response, security, and cloud cost management.

    • What You Bring:

    Leadership & Experience

  • 10+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.
  • At least 3 years of direct engineering management experience.
  • Currently operating at Director of Platform Engineering, Director of DevOps, or an equivalent hands-on Director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling engineering teams, rather than exclusively managing established organisations.
  • A strong track record of delivering and operating production platforms within a technology product company.
  • The ability to combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering execution.

    • Technical Expertise

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with Kubernetes.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code experience, particularly Terraform or Terragrunt.
  • Proven experience implementing GitOps and CI/CD pipelines using Argo CD or comparable technologies.
  • Strong AWS expertise and practical experience designing cloud-portable architectures.
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience with self-hosted or on-premises enterprise software deployments.
  • Practical experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience with cloud cost optimisation, FinOps, and infrastructure efficiency.

    • AI-First Mindset

  • Extensive practical use of AI coding assistants, development agents, and AI-driven automation.
  • Experience applying AI to engineering productivity and infrastructure operations.
  • Ability to identify, implement, and govern AI-driven operational workflows.
  • A forward-looking mindset about how AI will change platform engineering and infrastructure management.

    • Leadership Approach

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.
  • Comfortable making technical decisions and taking responsibility for their outcomes.
  • Able to build teams and systems from scratch.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work across distributed international engineering teams.
  • Comfortable working across US Eastern and Central European time zones.

    • Nice to Have:
  • Experience with enterprise data platforms, data catalogues, metadata management, or graph databases.
  • Production experience across multiple cloud providers.
  • Experience with air-gapped and restricted-network deployments.
  • Infrastructure for AI/ML workloads, model serving, vector databases, or graph data stores.
  • OpenTelemetry or comparable observability technologies.
  • Privileged access management solutions such as StrongDM.

    • How You Will Work:

    You will report directly to the SVP of Engineering and work closely with Product Engineering, Security, Customer Success, and Support.

    This is a fully remote position based in the US East Coast, UK, Germany, France, or Spain, subject to local employment eligibility.

    You should be able to maintain at least four hours of daily overlap with both US Eastern Time and Central European Time.

    Occasional travel for team offsites and company-wide meetings may be required.

    We value builders over theorists, ownership over hierarchy, and measurable outcomes over activity.

    If you have built and scaled a platform engineering organisation, remain technically hands-on, and believe AI should fundamentally change how infrastructure teams operate, we would like to hear from you.


    What We Offer:
  • The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
  • Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

    Interested? We’d love to hear from you! Let’s discuss how you can contribute to our success while growing your career with us.
     
    We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

jobs.title: Senior Quantitative Researcher
jobs.description:
Swissblock Technologies is a private investment firm dedicated to pioneering cryptocurrency integration with cross-asset investing. Applying a quantitative view to financial markets, we manage systematic multi-strategy portfolios of digital and traditional assets.

Our Systematic Crypto Group transforms market insights into robust algorithmic investment strategies, trading fully automated on our prop trading infrastructure. We are dedicated to a collaborative, non-siloed environment with shared incentives, where each member can directly shape the team’s and company's future.

This role can based from anywhere in Switzerland.

Responsibilities and Objectives
Quantitative Researchers in our Systematic Crypto Group have the opportunity to drive the research process from ideation to final implementation, ultimately specialising according to individual strengths and preferences. This will involve:
- Analyse the crypto ecosystems to uncover the fundamental dynamics that drive price and risk formation.
- Utilise advanced statistical techniques on both traditional and crypto-specific data sets.
- Conceptualised and enhanced monetisation systems for trading signals and other market anomalies.
- Implement, backtest, and deploy algorithmic trading strategies within a live trading environment.
- Monitor live strategy performance and integrate insights into the research loop.
- Participate in the development of our research agenda based on research findings and ideas.

Skills and Talents
- Advanced degree in a highly quantitative field.
- Excellent analytical skills with strong attention to detail; ability to maintain a pragmatic mindset.
- Passion for traditional and crypto markets; driven to model the underlying market dynamics.
- Ability to conduct data-driven research focused on solving real-world problems.
- Dedication to continuous learning and making an impact; willingness to question the status quo.
- Ability to effectively summarise and clearly communicate research results.
- Prior exposure to quantitative research (preferably in digital assets).
- Proficiency in Python and experience in using statistical packages

Culture
Swissblock Technologies offers an exciting and diverse environment with flat hierarchies and excellent peers. We are a profitable company with a culture based on responsibility and merit. Empowerment of each individual team member is a key value reflected in our career dynamics, which continuously grow with the business.

In addition to a modern office in Baar, Switzerland – flexibility to work remotely within Switzerland – we propose a competitive compensation package, an annual bonus, 25 days of annual leave, progressive social benefits, and engaging company events.

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Netherlands.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment.


Accountabilities:

As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers.

  • Deliver compelling presentations and value propositions that demonstrate how solutions can help customers investigate and disrupt criminal activities.

  • Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams.

  • Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience.

    • Requirements:

    The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a strong track record of selling SaaS solutions to public sector organizations across the DACH market. You should be comfortable navigating complex procurement processes, engaging senior decision-makers, and managing strategic opportunities with significant commercial value. The following qualifications are expected:

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and successfully close high-value, six- and seven-figure deals.

  • Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives.

  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving customer needs, and dynamic market conditions.

  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and ownership of commercial outcomes.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a collaborative approach to working across teams.

    • Benefits:

  • Remote-first working environment within an international and distributed team.

  • Competitive compensation package.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative AI-powered technology at the intersection of cryptocurrency, national security, and financial crime prevention.

  • Fast-paced and collaborative environment with regular team communication and support from leadership.

jobs.title: Functional Architect – AI-Driven Engineering
jobs.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019. 

The role 

DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product. 

Reporting to the Head of Architecture, you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation. 

This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact. 

Missions: 

  • Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively. 

  • Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails. 

  • Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals. 

  • Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D. 

  • Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review. 

  • Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure. 

  • Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform. 

  • Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working. 

Requirements 

  • Based in France with full working rights. 

  • Fluent in French and English. 

Experience & seniority: 

  • 10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms. 

  • Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history. 

  • Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions. 

  • Legal Tech experience is not required. 

Technical expertise: 

  • Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events. 

  • Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming. 

  • Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin. 

  • Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects. 

  • Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools. 

  • Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed. 

  • Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs. 

Leadership & collaboration: 

  • Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time. 

  • A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models. 

  • Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others. 

  • The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed. 

  • Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams. 

Education: 

Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology.

For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role.

jobs.title: Senior SW Engineer – Embedded Linux SDK & Distribution (M/W/D)
jobs.description:
Mobileye is looking for a passionate Systems Software Developer to join the Operating System Team in the EyeQ Platform Software Group. While many work on Linux, we work in Linux. Our team is responsible for the core OS DNA of the EyeQ computer vision SoC, defining how the system starts, is composed, and manages its lifecycle in a high-performance automotive environment.

We are looking for an experienced systems engineer to join our Core Distribution team. The center of this role is the Linux userspace and the distribution itself: boot and service bring-up, root filesystem composition, and the integration of external SDK into that platform. You will also build Python-based deployment tooling so the OS and SDK stack can be provisioned reproducibly - infrastructure and tool development in service of the OS.


What will your job look like:
  • Architect and develop Linux userspace and service bring-up so the distribution boots into a consistent, operational platform under embedded constraints. 
  • Enable and integrate an SDK into the OS image - drivers, libraries, runtimes, and filesystem layout as first-class distribution components.
  • Own distribution composition, including packages, sysroots, and image features that make the SDK and core OS a maintainable, versioned platform.
  • Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
  • Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.
  • Perform root cause analysis on system-level failures in the distribution, from boot and userspace bring-up through a fully operational stack.
  • Collaborate on board bring-up, tailoring the distribution and SDK integration to new EyeQ generations and related target hardware.

    • All you need is:
  • Outstanding graduate in Computer Science or similar field.  
  • 5+ years of experience in Embedded Linux development, with a focus on systems software, userspace, or distribution work.
  • Strong C/C++ skills and a solid understanding of POSIX APIs, libraries, and how userspace talks to the kernel.
  • Deep knowledge of Linux Internals, specifically the boot process (Bootloaders, Kernel hand-off, Init systems) and root filesystem layout.
  • Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux Distributions (e.g., custom Yocto recipes, Buildroot, or Linux-from-scratch).
  • Experience enabling vendor SDKs or BSP stacks on Linux — integrating third-party drivers, runtimes, and userspace components into a custom image.
  • Proficiency in debugging tools like GDB, Valgrind, strace, and perf.
  • Experience with Python for infrastructure and tool development — deployment, packaging, and environment setup.

    • Nice to have:
  • Background in Automotive Software.
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator compute stacks (driver + userspace runtime, inference/compute libraries, cross-sysroot workflows).
  • Familiarity with reading hardware schematics and reasoning about basic hardware interfaces and signal.

jobs.title: Director of Industrialisation
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

Getting complex hardware through development and into flight is one challenge. Building the industrial capability to deliver it repeatedly, at the required quality and rate, is another. We’re looking for a Director of Industrialisation to lead that work in Germany.

You’ll take a greenfield manufacturing site from an empty floor to sustained series production. You’ll shape the facility, decide what we build in-house, bring in the equipment and people, and lead the ramp until the operation can deliver reliably. Your job starts while the product is still taking shape, when the right manufacturing decision can save months of work later.

We’re looking for someone who’s done this before and wants to build again. You’ll work directly with the founders and with Engineering, Programmes, Quality, Supply Chain and Operations. You’ll be close enough to the floor to see where the plan is breaking down, and senior enough to make the decisions that fix it.


What you’ll do

  • Own the industrialisation plan. Translate programme demand into a plan for capacity, capital investment, people and suppliers. Set milestones from facility readiness through pilot builds and production ramp, and make the trade-offs visible when timelines or assumptions change.

  • Build and commission the operation. Define what the site needs to support, shape the layout and material flow, and lead equipment selection, installation and commissioning. Plan how the operation will expand as demand grows.

  • Bring manufacturing into product decisions early. Work with Engineering to make the hardware practical to build, inspect and test. Bring evidence from the floor into design reviews, and agree how changes will be introduced as the design matures.

  • Decide what to make and what to buy. Work with Supply Chain to establish which capabilities we need to own, where specialist suppliers make sense, and how we qualify and scale those suppliers alongside our own production.

  • Take pilot builds into repeatable production. Use early builds to expose what will limit output. Resolve bottlenecks, improve yield and build consistency, and demonstrate that the operation can sustain its target rate across successive builds.

  • Build the team and the way it works. Hire the people who will establish the operation. Give them clear ownership, develop leaders on the floor, and put in place the training and routines that let the team solve problems as production grows.

  • Own manufacturing readiness. Define the evidence needed before increasing the rate, from process capability and trained operators to supplier readiness, inspection and traceability. Work with Quality and Safety to build those requirements into everyday work.

  • Make the hard calls. Decide where automation earns its place, where a simpler process gets us there sooner, and where to commit capital before all the answers are in. Give leadership a clear view of what’s on track, what’s at risk and what decision is needed.


    • Who you are

  • You’ve personally led a greenfield site or a major production operation built from scratch, through commissioning and into sustained series or volume production. You can tell us what existed on day one, what you owned and what the operation was delivering once it ramped.

  • You’ve industrialised complex hardware while the design was still evolving. You know how to keep engineering and manufacturing moving together when a design change affects tooling, suppliers, inspection or the delivery plan.

  • You’ve made consequential capital, capacity and staffing decisions. You can explain what you committed to early, what you deliberately kept flexible and how those choices played out.

  • You’ve lived through a difficult ramp. You can talk us through a target you missed, how you found the real constraint, what you changed and what happened to output, yield, cost or delivery as a result.

  • You’ve built and led teams across disciplines. You can earn the trust of operators, technicians and engineers, challenge a design decision with evidence, and explain a manufacturing trade-off to the founders in plain language.

  • You know how to build at pace in a demanding hardware environment. You put the controls that matter in place early, and keep decisions close to the people doing the work.

  • You’re motivated by the opportunity to build industrial capability for European defence, and you want to be on site with the team doing it.


    • Where you might have done it
    You might have launched a new factory in automotive, built a production operation at a hardware startup, or taken an aerospace or advanced manufacturing product from low-rate builds to series production.
     
    You could have done it inside a larger company if you had the mandate to build the operation and were personally accountable for the ramp.The common thread is the build itself. We want to hear about the operation you created, how quickly you brought it online, the rate it sustained and the decisions you made when the original plan met reality.

    What we offer

  • Genuine ownership of the industrialisation of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes, from an empty site to sustained series production.

  • The chance to join early enough that your decisions will shape the factory, the team and how Hypersonica manufactures for years to come.

  • Direct access to the founders and the factory floor, with short decision paths and the authority to act when you see a better way to build.

  • Daily collaboration with exceptional people across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Test and Programmes. You’ll have a seat at the table while the product is still taking shape.

  • The freedom to challenge convention and build from first principles, from what we make in-house to where automation earns its place.

  • The resources and ambition to build a production operation at a pace that would be hard to match in a traditional aerospace organisation.

  • The chance to see your decisions through, from the first factory layout on a whiteboard to hardware coming off a line that delivers reliably, shift after shift.

    • At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
     
    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
     
    You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

jobs.title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices. 
 
You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support. 
 

Engineering mindset 
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?” 

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs. 
 
What success looks like 
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable. 
 
Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration. 


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation 

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro. 

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies. 

  • Administer and automate Jamf policies, configuration profiles, Jamf Blueprints, Jamf compliance, extension attributes, smart groups, packages and lifecycle workflows. 

  • Integrate Jamf Pro and Apple Business Manager with identity, security, asset, infrastructure and service-management platforms. 

  • Apply Git, CI/CD, automated testing and configuration-as-code practices so Apple platform changes are controlled, repeatable and auditable. 

    • Security, Compliance & Observability 

  • Translate macOS security and compliance requirements into Jamf configuration profiles, automated controls and measurable outcomes. 

  • Automate macOS and third-party application patching, vulnerability remediation and exception handling. 

  • Build guardrails for FileVault, endpoint protection, authentication, privacy controls and device compliance. 

  • Create inventory, telemetry, dashboards and alerting that provide actionable visibility into automation performance, Mac health and risk. 

  • Partner with Security teams to automate evidence collection, audit reporting and remediation workflows for the Apple estate. 

    • Engineering, Lifecycle & Support 

  • Define the macOS and Jamf automation architecture, engineering standards and roadmap for a global Apple device service. 

  • Engineer automated packaging, deployment, update and rollback pipelines for macOS applications. 

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service. 

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services. 

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention. 

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively. 

    •  
     

    What you'll need

  • Jamf 300 certification. 

  • 4+ years of experience engineering and automating macOS services in a modern enterprise environment. 

  • Deep hands-on expertise with Jamf Pro, including policies, profiles, smart groups, extension attributes, inventory, application deployment and API-based administration. 

  • Strong knowledge of macOS management, Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, declarative device management and Apple security controls. 

  • Ability to build production-quality automation using shell scripting, Python, REST APIs and structured data formats, supported by Git, CI/CD, testing, secrets management, Jamf webhooks and code review. 

  • Experience automating macOS application packaging, deployment, patching and vulnerability remediation; a bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. 

    •  

    Additional experience that would be valuable: 

  • Experience with identity integrations, Platform SSO, certificate services, zero-touch deployment and device trust. 

  • Knowledge of Installomator, swiftDialog, Nudge, or similar community and enterprise macOS automation tooling. 

  • Experience integrating Jamf with ServiceNow, asset-management, security, observability or data platforms. 

  • Cloud services, serverless functions, SQL or reporting technologies used to host integrations and analyse endpoint data. 

  • Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Linux or mobile device management in a broader endpoint environment. 

    •  
     

     


     

    What we offer

    A competitive compensation package, of course.  

    Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning. 

    Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.  

    Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

    Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance. 

    Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.  

    Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. 

    Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world. 

    Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! 

    Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location. 


    Meet your team

    We’re Employee IT. We’re on a mission to deliver a seamless user experience for TomTom'ers across. Whether we're creating solutions to enable collaboration, increase productivity or help people communicate, your work will ensure TomTom'ers are equipped to create the first real-time map. In our team, you’ll help design, develop, deliver, operate and support solutions through a defined set of services, so that we can continue to bring people closer to the world around them.

jobs.title: Projektiasiantuntija
jobs.description: Pieksämäki on osatoteuttajana mukana Toimitusketjut ja arvoketjut kokonaisturvallisuuden ja elinvoiman vahvistajina itäisessä Suomessa (TARMO) - hankkeessa. Hanke on ylimaakunnallinen kehittämiskokonaisuus, jonka tavoitteena on vahvistaa kokonaisturvallisuuden ja huoltovarmuuden verkostoja ja ekosysteemejä sekä hyödyntää ja kehittää alueella olevaa osaamista ylimaakunnallisesti. Hanke vahvistaa pk-yritysten ja niiden verkostojen kykyä toimia osana vaativia toimitus- ja arvoketjuja myös häiriö- ja poikkeusolosuhteissa. Painopiste on erityisesti niissä pk-yrityksissä, jotka eivät ole virallisesti huoltovarmuuskriittisiä, mutta joiden toimituskyky ja toimintavarmuus ovat olennaisia arvoketjujen ja alueen kannalta. Yritykset kytketään osaksi laajempaa kokonaisturvallisuuden ekosysteemiä klustereiden ja yhteistyöverkostojen kautta. Hankkeen hallinnoijana toimii Kaakkois-Suomen ammattikorkeakoulu Xamk.Hankkeeseen haetaan osa-aikaista projektiasiantuntijaa, joka toimii Pieksämäen yhteyshenkilönä TARMO-hankkeessa. Hän koordinoi ja varmistaa hankkeen Pieksämäen osuuden etenemisen hankesuunnitelman mukaisesti. Hänen ensisijaisena tehtävänään on tehdä puolustus- ja turvallisuusalan yritysneuvontaa, tehdä yhteistyötä muiden puolustus- turvallisuussektorin verkostojen kanssa, kuten Savo Defence ja Borderland, sekä edistää Pieksämäen kaupungin puolustus- ja turvallisuustoimialaan liittyvien elinkeinoelämän hankkeiden valmistelua. Hankkeessa on tavoitteeksi kirjattu myös viranomaisyhteistyön käynnistäminen yritysten kilpailukyvyn edistämisessä ja TKI-hankkeissa. Projektiasiantuntija on osa yrityspalvelut - tiimiä kaupunkiorganisaatiossa.Hanke kohdistuu pk-yrityksiin, niitä kokoaviin klustereihin sekä yritystoimintaa tukeviin kehittämis ja TKI-toimijoihin, ja sen pitkäaikaisena vaikutuksena vahvistaa yritysten kasvua ja kansainvälistymistä edellyttävää luotettavaa toimittajuutta, toimitus- ja arvoketjujen resilienssiä sekä alueellista kokonaisturvallisuutta ylimaakunnallisena ja pysyvänä toimintakykynä. Paikka täytetään, mikäli hanke saa myönteisen rahoituspäätöksen.Projektiasiantuntijalta toivomme:- sopivaa korkeakoulututkintoa- kokemusta hankeosaamisesta- liiketoimintaosaamista ja osaamista yritysneuvonnasta- erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja viestintätaitoja- itseohjautuvuutta- hyviä ict-taitoja- puolustus- ja turvallisuustoimialan osaamista sekä verkostoja- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa. Muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi.Valinnassa noudatetaan kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa. Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunta-alan yleisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (KVTES) mukaisesti. Tehtävän osa-aikaisuuden (50 %) mukainen tasopalkka on 2 100 €/kk. Vastaava täyden työajan tasopalkka on 4 200 €/kk. Haastattelut järjestetään 17.12.2026 klo 8-12 Pieksämäellä.Hakuaikaa jatketaan 10.12.2026 klo 23.59 asti. Tehtävään aiemmin hakeneiden hakemukset huomioidaan. Tarjoilukeittiön työntekijä Keisarinnaan
jobs.description: **Oletko se ihminen, jonka ansiosta Keisarinnan tarjoilukeittiö toimii?**Me uskomme, että jokaisessa keittiössä on yksi ihminen, joka pitää langat käsissään. Hän huomaa, jos jokin asia on jäämässä tekemättä. Hän pitää huolen siitä, että asiat tapahtuvat ajallaan. Hän löytää sujuvamman tavan tehdä asioita ja nauttii siitä, kun arki rullaa – ei siksi, että hän juoksisi sinne tänne, vaan siksi, että hänen työnsä sujuu hyvällä mielellä. Nyt etsimme tätä ihmistä meille.**Kototiimi kasvaa vauhdilla – ja tarvitsemme kasvun mahdollistajan keittiöön**Tällä hetkellä Kototiimillä on kolme hoivakotia (kurkkaa www.kototiimi.fi). Keisarinna avasi ovensa lokakuussa. Kasvun mukana lisääntyvät myös asiakkaat, tarjoiltavat ateriat ja välipalat, tiski, herkkujen tarve ja juhlien suunnittelu jne. Siksi tarvitsemme Keisarinnan jakelukeittiöön työntekijän, jolle keittiössä työskentely ei ole ihan vierasta.**Mitä työsi käytännössä on?**Työsi tärkein vastuu on saada päivittäiset ateriat turvallisesti tarjolle (ateriat tulevat valmiina eli emme valmista lounasta ja päivällistä, emme tarvitse kokkia), pitää keittiö siistinä, valmistella välipaloja ja leivonnaisia sekä huolehtia, että tarvikkeita on riittävästi. Toki myös keittiön omavalvonnasta huolehtiminen on vastuullasi. Huolehdit siitä, että tarjoilukeittiö toimii täsmällisesti, ajallaan ja laadukkaasti. Sinulle tarkkuus ei ole rasite, vaan tapa tehdä työtä. Toimit myös osana Keisarinnan tiimiä. Perehdytät ja kehität toimintaa keittiön näkökulmasta yhdessä muiden kanssa. Haluamme, että osaaminen kasvaa koko tiimissä – ei vain yhdellä ihmisellä. Kaikki auttavat toisiaan, koska meillä yksi asia yhdistää kaikkia: **Ketään ei jätetä yksin.****Me innostumme ihmisistä, jotka kehittävät.**Etsimme ihmistä, joka uskaltaa kysyä, voisiko tämän tehdä paremmin. Kasvavassa yrityksessä mikään ei ole valmiiksi kiveen hakattua. Juuri siksi pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, millaiseksi Kototiimin Keisarinna rakentuu.**Millainen sinä olet?**Pidät järjestyksestä. Nautit siitä, että asiat ovat järjestyksessä ja tehtynä ajallaan. Rakastat työskennellä siistissä keittiössä. Vaikka meillä et valmista ruokaa alusta asti, pidät leipomisesta ja muusta värkkäämisestä ruoan ympärillä. Sinulla on kokemusta keittiötyöstä, leipomisesta ja keittiöhygieniasta.**Mitä saat meiltä?**Saat vakituisen työn yrityksessä, joka kasvaa voimakkaasti ja jossa omaan työhön voi oikeasti vaikuttaa. Saat vastuuta, luottamusta ja mahdollisuuden rakentaa toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa. Saat työyhteisön, jossa autetaan toisia, iloitaan onnistumisista ja tehdään töitä yhteisen tavoitteen eteen. Ja mikä tärkeintä – saat työn, jolla on merkitystä asiakkaillemme.**Jos tunnistit itsesi...**...älä jää miettimään, täytätkö jokaisen kohdan. Jos ajattelet, että voisit olla juuri se ihminen, jonka ansiosta kokonaisuus toimii, haluamme kuulla sinusta. Tule rakentamaan Kototiimin seuraavaa kasvuvaihetta. Meillä tärkeimmät työt eivät aina näy ulospäin – mutta niiden vaikutus näkyy joka päivä.

jobs.title: Cream Consulting - Data Engineer
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...but in reality, we are a consulting company specialized in IT development and Business improvement. We are active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, Pharmaceutical & Transport.   Cream's special recipe
  • 1/3 of Personal development
  • 1/3 of Collective Intelligence
  • 1/3 of Intrapreneurship
And Bonus ingredient: ... Some passionate colleagues ??

What is a Data Engineer at cream?

As a Data Engineer at Cream, you can be in charge of the implementation of BI Business Projects or potentially coaching junior data engineers. As well, be responsible for the development of data ingestion and analytics solutions (data warehouses, data marts, etc.)   Your tasks
  • Architecting Data Systems: Designing robust and scalable data models to meet business needs
  • ETL Development: Creating or improving efficient Extract, Transform, Load processes to integrate and process data
  • Performance Optimization: Monitoring and fine-tuning data pipelines and databases For optimal speed and efficiency
  • Data Security Implementation: Establishing data security measures to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Working closely with data scientists, analysts, and other teams to understand data requirements and provide technical solutions
  • You have at least 2 years experience in data engineering
  • You have a Master's degree, preferably in IT (Computer or industrial engineering) or in Business Administration or equivalent by experience (more than 5 years).
  • You are used to working with different data tools such as SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, AWS, Azure data factory,  Apache Spark, SQL, Python, Tableau
  • You have a good database knowledge (SQL and NoSQL)
  • You are fluent in French or Dutch and have full professional capacity in English
  • You know what it means to work in an Agile mode
  • You are passionate about data, pay attention to details and you bring out concrete analysis to help the business

jobs.title: Psykologi Somatiikan psykologiyksikköön
jobs.description: Haluatko olla rakentamassa uudenlaista psykologista tukea lapsettomuutta kokeville ja hedelmöityshoidoissa oleville potilaille?Haemme psykologia vakituiseen työsuhteeseen uuteen yksikköön: somaattisten palvelujen psykologiyksikköön HUS Psykiatrian Digitaalisten ja psykososiaalisten hoitojen linjalle.Tehtävä ja toimintaympäristöDigitaalisten ja psykososiaalisten hoitojen linjalla tuotetaan psykologipalveluja useille somaattisten sairauksien hoitoon keskittyville HUSin toimialoille. Psykologipalveluja tuotetaan muun muassa syöpätaudeille, naistentaudeille mukaan lukien Seri-toiminta, sisätautikuntoutuksen pitkäaikaisoireiden poliklinikalle, selkäydinvammakeskukseen sekä leikkaus- ja tehohoidon palveluihin. Toimintakenttä on laaja ja kehittyvä, ja yhteistyötä tehdään useiden somaattisten erikoisalojen ja ammattiryhmien kanssa.Tehtävässä pääset kehittämään uutta psykososiaalisen tuen kokonaisuutta lapsettomuuden ja hedelmöityshoitojen parissa. Tehtävä tarjoaa harvinaisen mahdollisuuden olla rakentamassa kokonaan uutta palvelua ja vaikuttaa sen sisältöön, toimintamalleihin sekä tulevaan kehityssuuntaan. Samalla pääset yhdistämään kliinisen psykologityön, palvelujen kehittämisen ja tutkimusnäyttöön perustuvan asiantuntijatyön osana moniammatillista erikoissairaanhoitoa.Tehtävän painopiste on alkuvaiheessa psykososiaalisten palvelujen kehittämisessä. Tavoitteena on rakentaa uusi, näyttöön perustuva ja porrastettu psykososiaalisen tuen kokonaisuus lapsettomuuden ja hedelmöityshoitojen tueksi. Työssä kehitetään erityisesti digitaalisia tukimuotoja, kuten digihoitopolkua, omahoito-ohjelmia ja verkkopohjaisia interventioita, sekä psykososiaalisen tuen porrastusta ja hoitoonohjausta. jobs.title: Télépilote de drone (H/F)
jobs.description: Innov'ATM et votre rôleLa société Innov'ATM a été créée en 2014 avec l'ambition de proposer des produits et des services innovants pour la gestion de trafic aérien (ATM) et de gestion du trafic aérien des drones (UTM). Aujourd'hui, Innov'ATM permet à tous les acteurs de l'écosystème de gérer en toute sécurité et en toute simplicité l'ensemble des opérations dans un espace aérien (ATM et UTM).Depuis 2024, Innov'ATM a créé DroneMed: un service de livraison médicale par drone, il permet aux établissements de santé et aux laboratoires d'acheminer des prélèvements biologiques et des médicaments par des autoroutes aériennes.Précurseur de la livraison médicale par drone en France, et premier U-space Services Provider Français, DroneMed propose une alternative au transport routier traditionnel et opère déjà plusieurs lignes dans différentes régions, en métropole comme en outre-mer, et poursuit activement son déploiement.Rejoindre DroneMed, c'est contribuer au développement d'un service innovant, utile et en forte croissance, au croisement des secteurs de la santé, du drone et de la mobilité aérienne.Le posteInnov'ATM recrute un-e télépilote pour assurer la supervision des opérations DroneMed sur les lignes en France métropolitaine comme en outre-mer.* Sur le terrain : une supervision au plus près des opérations. Pendant les phases de test, de validation et de transition vers l'exploitation, vous êtes présent-e sur les sites afin de préparer, superviser et sécuriser les vols. Cette présence terrain constitue aujourd'hui le cœur du poste.* Depuis nos bureaux : une supervision à distance, depuis le centre de contrôle DroneMed, pour les lignes déjà en phase d'exploitation.Vos missions* Vous assurerez la supervision des vols DroneMed, en tant que télépilote/superviseur de vols.À ce titre, vous serez responsable de l'opération, de sa préparation jusqu'à sa clôture, et vos missions seront les suivantes :Préparer l'opération :* Rédiger la fiche mission et analyser le contexte : météo, informations aéronautiques, zones survolées, espaces aériens voisins, mesures de contingence et Plan de Réponse d'Urgence (PRU).* Déployer le matériel (drone, vertiport, batteries, etc) sur site, réaliser les vérifications avant vol selon les checklists et animer le briefing de l'équipage.Superviser les vols :* Surveiller en continu le drone, sa trajectoire et son environnement, et coordonner l'équipage (second télépilote, personnel au sol) avec une phraséologie normalisée.* Appliquer les procédures de contingence et d'urgence, déclencher le PRU si nécessaire, et retarder, interrompre ou annuler un vol dès que la sécurité l'exige.* Assurer l'après-vol : inspection du drone, carnet de vol, fiche mission et rangement du matériel.Gestion de la sécurité et amélioration continue* Animer le débriefing après chaque opération, consigner tout événement et remonter les anomalies observées sur le terrain.* Appliquer les consignes de sécurité, participer aux exercices PRU et aux formations, et proposer des améliorations des procédures.Missions complémentaires possiblesSelon les besoins, vous pourrez aussi participer à la maintenance du drone, à l'installation des équipements sur les sites, à la formation du personnel des sites partenaires et à la mise en service de nouvelles lignes.Profil recherchéNous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, fiable et ingénieuse, qui aime le travail sur le terrain, au plus près des usagers.Formations et CertificatsVous avez déjà vos certificats de télépilote ? C'est un vrai atout :* l'attestation pour la catégorie ouverte (A1/A3) et la formation complémentaire A2 ;* le certificat théorique de télépilote (CATS) et une formation pratique aux scénarios STS.Vous ne les avez pas encore ? Postulez quand même. Nous cherchons d'abord une personne motivée, débrouillarde et à l'aise sur le terrain. Les certifications nécessaires pourront être passées après l'embauche et prises en charge par Innov'ATM.Dans tous les cas, nous assurons à la prise de poste les formations sur le drone, sur les lignes DroneMed et sur nos procédures internes.Seul impératif : le permis B, car les missions impliquent des déplacements en véhicule avec le matériel.Compétences et qualités attendues* Anglais : certains manuels sont rédigés en anglais.* Ingéniosité : vous trouvez des solutions concrètes face aux imprévus du terrain (matériel, logistique, site).* Rigueur : vous suivez les procédures et les checklists à la lettre.* Sang-froid : vous gardez votre calme et savez prendre une décision quand la situation se complique.* Esprit d'équipe : vous communiquez de façon claire et concise avec l'équipage.* Sens de la sécurité : vous signalez ce qui ne va pas et tirez les leçons de chaque opération.* Adaptabilité : vous êtes à l'aise sur des sites variés, en déplacement, et savez vous organiser seul-e.* Aisance avec les outils numériques : logiciels de pilotage, de planification et de s...

jobs.title: Talousviestintäpäällikkö
jobs.description: Suomalainen arki vaatii energiaa. Ja tekijöitä. Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan polttamatonta ja joustavaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Helen Oy on vähittäissähkönmyynnin markkinajohtaja Suomessa. Innostutko siitä, kun luvut avautuvat ymmärrettäväksi tarinaksi? Etsimme nyt tiimiimme vakituista talousviestintäpäällikköä Helsinkiin. Meille on tärkeää, että rakennamme viestintää yhdessä liike- ja konsernitoimintojen kanssa, jaamme osaamistamme ja uskallamme kokeilla uutta. Toimintomme työskentelee Helenin strategian ytimessä ja tarjoaa sinulle näköalapaikan energiamurrokseen ja sen vaikutuksiin yhteiskunnassamme. IMS, QPR, ARIS tai Signavio)Vahvaa analyyttisuutta ja jäsentelykykyä - kykyä hahmottaa laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja nähdä niistä yhteneväisyydetHyviä vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaitoja sekä taitoa sitouttaa eri yksiköiden asiantuntijat yhteiseen toimintamalliin ja esittää monitahoiset asiat selkeästi ja visuaalisestiItseohjautuvuutta ja tapaa viedä sovitut tuotokset maaliin aikataulussaEduksesi katsomme lean-osaamisen (esim. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Haluaisitko olla mukana kehittämässä Helenin energiantuotannon ohjauksen kannalta keskeisiä järjestelmiä ja rakentamassa SCADA-ohjelmistokehityskyvykkyyttämme? Tule meille Lead Software Developeriksi SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiin. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Roolissa työskentelet osana SCADA ja valvomo -ratkaisutiimiä, joka vastaa energiantuotannon ohjaus- ja valvomojärjestelmien kehittämisestä sekä keskeytymättömästä tiedonkulusta tuotantolaitosten ja valvomon välillä. Tiimin ratkaisut mahdollistavat laitosten reaaliaikaisen automaattisen säädön ja muodostavat huoltovarmuuden kannalta kriittisen kokonaisuuden, jonka ympärivuorokautisesta toimintavarmuudesta huolehditaan yhdessä kumppaneiden kanssa. Lead Software Developerina otat vahvan teknisen roolin tämän järjestelmäkokonaisuuden kehittämisessä. Pääset tekemään käytännön ohjelmistokehitystä sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten Helenin omaa kehityskyvykkyyttä, teknisiä ratkaisuja ja toimintatapoja rakennetaan nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Roolissasi Otat teknistä vetovastuuta Helenin SCADA-järjestelmien ohjelmistokehityksestä ja niiden pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä.Suunnittelet, kehität ja ylläpidät SCADA-järjestelmän ohjelmistokomponentteja, integraatioita ja käyttöliittymiä.Varmistat yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa ratkaisujen ylläpidettävyyden, toimintavarmuuden ja skaalautuvuuden. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä energiantuotannon, optimoinnin, automaation ja muiden ohjelmistokehittäjien kanssa ja viet tarpeita toimiviksi teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi. Osallistut järjestelmien teknisen arkkitehtuurin ja tulevaisuuden ratkaisujen suunnitteluun sekä yhteistyöhön järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Odotamme sinulta Vahvaa kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä sekä kykyä ottaa teknistä vastuuta laajoista ja liiketoimintakriittisistä järjestelmistä. Kokemusta SCADA- tai muista OT-ympäristöistä, kuten valvomokäyttöliittymistä ja teollisista integraatioista. Ymmärrystä teollisuuden tietoliikenneprotokollista, kuten OPC UA, IEC-104, ICCP ja Modbus. Kokemusta moderneista ohjelmistokehityksen käytännöistä, kuten automatisoidusta testauksesta, CI/CDä ja versionhallinnasta, sekä AI-avusteisten työkalujen hyödyntämisestä ohjelmistokehityksessä. Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä kokonaisuuksia, tehdä perusteltuja ratkaisuja ja viedä niitä käytäntöön yhdessä muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Eduksi katsomme Kokemuksen WinCC OA -järjestelmästä ja sen ohjelmistokehityksestä. Kokemuksen automaatiojärjestelmien konfiguroinnista ja toimintaperiaatteista. Kokemuksen energiantuotannon tai muiden kriittisten teollisten järjestelmien parissa työskentelystä. Kokemuksen Databricks-ympäristöstä sekä data-alustan ja operatiivisten järjestelmien välisistä dataratkaisuista. Tarjoamme sinulle Tässä tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti energiantuotannon ohjausjärjestelmien tulevaisuuteen. Roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön ohjelmistokehitys, tekninen vetovastuu ja mahdollisuus kehittää toimintatapoja sekä järjestelmien laatua ja toimintavarmuutta. Työskentelet monipuolisessa ympäristössä, jossa SCADA ja automaatio, moderni ohjelmistokehitys, data-alusta ja energiajärjestelmän optimointi kytkeytyvät yhä tiiviimmin yhteen. Pääset nauttimaan myös erilaisista henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, etätyömahdollisuudesta ulkomailla ja hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määritellään tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Jouni Rantalankila / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) sähköpostitse. Kiinnostuitko? Mahtavaa! Voit hakea rekryjärjestelmämme kautta viimeistään 22.11.2026. Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.description:
Waarom pak je in de supermarkt het ene product wel uit het schap en het andere niet? Ligt het aan de verpakking? De prijs? Smaak? Gemak? Of simpelweg omdat het precies op de juiste plek staat?

Bij Growy telen we verse sla, kruiden en microgreens in Amsterdam in onze vertical farm. Vertical farming klinkt misschien ingewikkeld, maar het idee is simpel: we telen planten in lagen boven elkaar, midden in de stad en helemaal los van het weer buiten.
Nu onze producten in steeds meer Nederlandse supermarkten te vinden zijn, willen we onze consumenten nóg beter leren begrijpen. Daarom zoeken we een nieuwsgierige en commercieel ingestelde stagiair die zich wil verdiepen in consumentengedrag en inzichten kan vertalen naar echte commerciële kansen.

En nee, dit wordt geen stageproject wat ergens in een lade verdwijnt en niemand ooit nog bekijkt, jouw stage gaat voor ons echt een verschil maken!

🌱Wat ga je doen?

Hoe zorgen we ervoor dat meer consumenten Growy ontdekken, proberen én opnieuw kopen?

Tijdens je stage ga je bijvoorbeeld:

  • consumenten interviewen en/of focusgroepen organiseren;

  • onderzoeken wat mensen belangrijk vinden bij het kopen van verse salades en kruiden;

  • ontdekken welke drempels consumenten ervan weerhouden een product te proberen;

  • onderzoeken wat juist zorgt voor een herhaalaankoop;

  • kijken naar kansen rondom prijs, assortiment, verpakking, positionering, promoties en zichtbaarheid;

  • kwantitatief onderzoek, zoals enquêtes, opzetten om ideeën te testen;

  • jouw inzichten vertalen naar concrete commerciële en marketingaanbevelingen.

Aan het einde van je stage presenteer je jouw belangrijkste inzichten en aanbevelingen aan ons Sales & Marketing team. En als het binnen je stage past, kun je misschien zelfs één van je ideeën in de praktijk testen.

De precieze inhoud stemmen we af op de duur van je stage en de eisen vanuit jouw opleiding.

Goed om te weten; onze farm is nog volop in ontwikkeling, we zitten nog in onze start-up/scale-up fase. Dit betekent dat je naast je onderzoek ook tijd zult besteden aan andere zaken in onze farm. Dit geldt niet alleen voor jou als stagiair maar voor ons hele team. Zo draait iedereen uit kantoor maandelijks een shift in de farm, waarbij we helpen met zaaien, oogsten of verpakken.

🌱Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een unieke stageplek; wij bouwen aan de toekomst van voedselproductie;

  • Je wordt onderdeel van een klein team, er wordt naar je ideëen en input geluisterd;

  • We werken fulltime vanaf onze farm in Amsterdam;

  • Een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van 500 euro, we vergoeden geen andere zaken;

  • Veel ruimte en tijd voor creativiteit en een ‘ga het maar proberen!' mentaliteit

  • Een gezellige werksfeer waarin we graag samen na werk nog leuke dingen ondernemen


🌱Wat breng jij?

  • Je volgt een HBO of WO opleiding in Nederland en staat daar ingeschreven gedurende de hele stage periode. Qua studies denken wij in de richting marketing, bedrijfskunde of (commerciële) psychologie, maar wie weet volg jij een andere studie die ook goed aansluit 🙂

  • Fulltime beschikbaar voor 4 of 5 maanden, startdatum december 2026 of januari of februari 2027

  • Je hebt je rijbewijs B; je zult veel op pad zijn om supermarkten te bezoeken

  • Een flinke portie nieuwsgierigheid

  • Je bent sociaal; je stapt makkelijk op mensen af en maakt een praatje met ze

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt je ook goed redden in het Engels

  • Je bent een zelf-starter; we zullen je uiteraard begeleiden tijdens je stage, maar het initiatief voor de invulling en aanpak ligt bij jou

jobs.title: VP of Design
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?
 

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.


Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.


We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

 
Position description
 
Sonar is looking for a VP of Design to own the end-to-end design vision and execution across our product portfolio. Reporting to the CPO, this is Sonar's most senior design leadership role,  responsible for setting design strategy, scaling a high-performing global design organization, and ensuring our products deliver an exceptional, cohesive experience for developers and enterprise customers alike. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Executive Leadership to translate customer needs and market trends into design decisions that drive measurable business impact.

What you will do

  • Own the end-to-end product design vision, including visual design, interaction design, workflows, and overall platform evolution across Sonar's product line.

  • Define and drive a design strategy that ties directly to measurable business outcomes, working with Product and Engineering leadership to prioritize investments. Track and report on design's impact on key business and product metrics.

  • Build, scale, and lead a global design organization, including hiring, mentoring, and developing design talent to foster a high-performing, creative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Champion and evolve Sonar's design systems and UX best practices, ensuring consistency and quality across a complex, technical, developer-facing product suite.

  • Guide the design approach for agentic and AI-driven features, ensuring the team understands emerging patterns and best practices in this space.

  • Engage directly with customers, users, and industry leaders to gather insights, and translate those insights into actionable, high-impact design solutions.

  • Represent design at the executive level, communicating strategy, trade-offs, and progress to executive leadership and cross-functional, global stakeholders.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to ensure design is embedded early in the product development process, not bolted on at the end.


    • Experience and qualifications
