jobs.title: DIRECTEUR D'HÔTEL - H/F
jobs.description: Description :Au sein de la franchise Best Western Plus, nous recherchons un(e) Directeur / Directrice pour notre hôtel 4 étoiles de 48 chambres, situé dans le 12e arrondissement de Paris.L'établissement fait partie du portefeuille hôtelier de Square Groupe, société d'investissement indépendante spécialisée dans le développement et la gestion d'actifs hôteliers.L'hôtel s'apprête à connaître une rénovation complète, offrant une belle opportunité de participer à la transformation de l'établissement et de contribuer à une expérience client renouvelée.En lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'hôtel, le management des équipes et le suivi de sa performance opérationnelle, commerciale et financière. VOS MISSIONS : 1. GESTION OPÉRATIONNELLE ET MANAGEMENT * Assurer le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement et coordonner les différents services : réception, étages et petit-déjeuner. * Encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes au quotidien. * Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à la formation des collaborateurs. * Organiser les plannings et veiller à l'adéquation des ressources avec l'activité. * Assurer le lien avec le siège, les propriétaires et les divers interlocuteurs. * Veiller à l'application des procédures et à la conformité aux standards de la marque, notamment dans le cadre des audits qualité. 2. QUALITÉ ET EXPÉRIENCE CLIENT * Garantir une qualité de service conforme aux standards d'un établissement 4 étoiles. * Assurer le suivi des réclamations et la mise en œuvre des actions correctives. * Superviser le traitement des avis clients et les réponses sur les différentes plateformes. * Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction et déployer des actions d'amélioration continue. 3. HÉBERGEMENT ET HOUSEKEEPING * Superviser l'entretien et la propreté des chambres et des parties communes. * Organiser et contrôler les plans de nettoyage et les procédures qualité. * Coordonner les prestations de la gouvernante, des équipes d'étage et des prestataires. * Assurer le suivi des inventaires de linge, des produits d'accueil et des consommables. 4. PETIT-DÉJEUNER * Garantir la qualité de l'offre et le respect des standards Best Western Plus. * Superviser les commandes, les stocks et les inventaires. * Veiller à l'application des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité alimentaire, notamment HACCP. * Contribuer à l'amélioration de l'expérience client et à la maîtrise des coûts. 5. MAINTENANCE ET SUIVI TECHNIQUE * Veiller au bon état général de l'établissement et au confort des clients. * Coordonner les interventions techniques et assurer le suivi des prestataires. * Suivre le calendrier des contrats de maintenance et les opérations préventives. * Participer, en lien avec le siège, au suivi du projet de rénovation et à la préparation de la mise en service des espaces rénovés. 6. GESTION COMMERCIALE ET FINANCIÈREEn lien avec la Responsable des opérations du siège : * Participer à l'élaboration et au suivi du budget de l'établissement. * Analyser les indicateurs de performance : chiffre d'affaires, taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR et rentabilité. * Suivre la stratégie tarifaire et les actions de revenue management. * Optimiser la distribution et la commercialisation de l'hôtel sur les différents canaux de vente. * Développer la notoriété de l'établissement et les partenariats locaux. * Suivre les notes et commentaires sur les OTA et les plateformes de la marque. * Proposer et mettre en œuvre des plans d'action pour améliorer les résultats. 7. GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE * Veiller au respect des obligations réglementaires, des normes de sécurité et des procédures internes. * Superviser les achats, les commandes et le suivi des stocks. * Contrôler les bons de livraison et les factures. * Transmettre les éléments nécessaires aux services comptabilité et paie. * Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du siège.VOTRE PROFIL : * Vous justifiez idéalement d'au moins deux ans d'expérience en direction d'hôtel ou disposez d'une expérience significative en direction adjointe avec une forte autonomie opérationnelle. * Vous possédez une bonne connaissance de l'exploitation hôtelière et des standards de qualité d'un établissement 3 ou 4 étoiles. * Vous maîtrisez les fondamentaux du management, de la gestion budgétaire et du revenue management. * Vous êtes à l'aise avec les PMS, channel managers et outils de réservation. * Vous faites preuve de leadership, de rigueur, d'autonomie et d'un bon sens des priorités. * Vous avez le goût du terrain, le sens du service client et une réelle capacité à fédérer les équipes. * Vous maitrisez le français et l'angalis (oral et écrit)POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE? * Prendre la direction d'un établissement à taille humaine, avec une vision globale de son exploitation. * Participer à la transformation d'un hôtel grâce à un projet de rénovation complète. * Bénéfi...

jobs.title: LÄHIHOITAJA, Hyvinvointikoti Elämäntaival - Ikifit, Riihimäki
jobs.description: Lääkeluvallinen LÄHIHOITAJA, tule mukaan Riihimäen Elämäntaipaleen tiimiin!Meille on tärkeintä, että jokainen asukas saa elää turvallista, arvokasta, yksilöllistä elämää ja että työntekijämme viihtyvät ja voivat hyvin työssään. Työkavereiksi etsimme hyviä tyyppejä.Tehtäviisi kuuluu ikäihmisten päivittäinen hoito ja avustaminen, lääkehoidon toteuttaminen ja yhteistyö muun hoitohenkilökunnan kanssa.Tämä paikka on juuri Sinulle, jos olet positiivisella asenteella varustettu, kehittämismyönteinen ja siedät keskeneräisyyttä. Kokemus hoitotyöstä on iso plussa, mutta hyvällä asenteella operoiva vastavalmistunut otetaan myös huomioon. Halutessasi pääset mukaan ideoimaan ja kehittämään työtä ja toimintamalleja.Tarjoamme lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyspalvelut, ateriaedun sekä ePassin ylläpitämään työkykyäsi! Töitä on tarjolla vakituisesti ja työ on pääsääntöisesti 2-vuorotyötä, mahdollisuus tehdä lisäksi öitä. Palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES G20C mukainen. Toivomme aloitusta joulukuun puolivälissä, mutta hyvän tyypin ja oikean asenteen kohdalla voimme joustaa vuoden alkuun.Edellytämme lähihoitajan koulutusta, voimassa olevia lääkelupia, sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa, vähintään taso B2. Lähihoitajan ammattioikeus on oltava todennettavissa Valviran rekisteristä. Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuajalla.Hyvinvointikoti Elämäntaival on 30-paikkainen koti, joka sijaitsee Riihimäellä, rauhallisella pientaloalueella. Elämäntaival tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille, jotka tarvitsevat jatkuvaa hoivaa ja huolenpitoa arkeensa.Olemme savuton työpaikka. Myös hyvinvointikeskusten ja -kotien pihapiirit kuuluvat savuttomaan alueeseen.Ikifit on täysin kotimainen, ikäihmisten palvelujen ammattilainen. jobs.title: Digital Account Manager - Netherlands
jobs.description:
We are the platform turning browsing into shopping. We connect 200 million shoppers with deals they love while boosting local sales for hundreds of top retailers and brands.

We help consumers save time and money while making smart shopping decisions, and we support retailers and brands in engaging customers from online research to in-store purchases.

In 2024, Shopfully joined forces with the North American company , creating a global leader in the sector. Together, we reach 400 million households and serve over 1,000 top retailers and brands across 27 markets, including Europe, Canada, the USA, Latin America, and Australia.

Ready to spark your growth with us?

WHO WE LOOK FOR 🦄

We’re expanding into the Netherlands – and you could be one of our very first team members!

We are looking for a Digital Account Manager who combines hands-on campaign expertise, outstanding client communication, and an AI-first mindset.

This is a highly client-facing role: you will work closely with our Performance and Paid Marketing teams, who handle most of the set-up and monitoring, and be ready to set up campaigns end-to-end and optimize them where needed and, above all, be the trusted point of contact for our clients throughout the whole campaign journey.

You will own the operational execution and performance success of digital campaigns for our clients in the Netherlands, from the internal and client kickoff through optimization to periodic performance evaluations.

The role goes well beyond campaign set-up: you will keep clients informed proactively, turn performance data into clear and convincing stories, and use AI, to work smarter, faster and with better insights.

Your work directly impacts campaign performance, client satisfaction, and long-term customer partnerships.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 🏄

  • Client Communication & Relationship Management
    • Be the main point of contact for your clients: communicate consistently and proactively about progress, results and next steps
    • Run periodic evaluations with the client, translating performance into clear insights and recommendations
    • Build trusted, long-term relationships and translate client objectives into effective, measurable campaign strategies
  • Campaign Set-up & Coordination
    • Lead the internal and client kickoffs, coordinate content with all stakeholders and supervise the respective Performance and Paid Marketing teams in setting up campaigns, stepping in to do the full set-up yourself when necessary
    • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client teams and internal stakeholders to ensure campaign success and delivery on time
  • Optimization & Performance
    • Optimize campaigns where needed, turning data into concrete actions to achieve the best possible results for the client
    • Monitor and analyze performance, and manage campaign tracking, reporting and performance dashboards across formats, in coordination with the Performance and Paid Marketing teams
  • Reports, Presentations & Sales Support
    • Create reports and presentations for your clients, from regular performance updates to periodic evaluations
    • Support the Sales team in creating decks for their proposals
  • AI-Powered Ways of Working
    • Use AI tools, in particular Claude, to generate reports and presentations, analyze performance and streamline your daily workflow
    • Identify opportunities to improve and scale campaign processes through AI and automation
  • Collaboration & Administration
    • Work closely with international colleagues, with English as the language of collaboration
    • Handle client invoicing

WHAT YOU WILL NEED🪄

  • Experience: 2–5 years in digital marketing, campaign management, or account management, ideally in an agency or international environment.
  • Client Communication: Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach. You feel at ease being the main point of contact, translating data into clear insights and building trusted relationships.
  • AI Proficiency: Confident in using AI in your daily work, in particular Claude for generating reports and insights, and curious to keep exploring new ways to work smarter.
  • Coordination & Organization: Strong coordination skills, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders at once.
  • Optimization & Data Mindset: Curious about data, with a drive to achieve the best results for the client and the ability to make data-driven decisions.
  • Digital Expertise: Strong knowledge of digital channels, trends, and tools (CRM systems like HubSpot, analytics tools like Google Analytics, SEMrush, Looker; display advertising platforms; Meta Business Suite). Excel or similar skills (Pivot tables) are a must.
  • Campaign Knowledge: Proven experience managing multi-channel campaigns, understanding KPIs, and optimizing performance.
  • Languages: Native-level Dutch and fluent spoken English.
  • Mindset: A positive, proactive attitude and the energy to keep campaigns, clients and colleagues moving.

👉 At our company, we value diversity and actively encourage it — we believe a variety of perspectives and backgrounds makes us stronger. We focus on potential rather than on having a “perfect” CV. If this role excites you and you believe you could grow into it — even if you don’t tick every single box in the requirements — we’d love to hear from you!

NICE TO HAVE 🎆

  • Comprehensive understanding of retail marketing functions, including budgets, retail purchase cycles, and category-specific user behavior (e.g., FMCG, Grocery, Fashion).

LOCATION 🌐

While you need to be based in the Netherlands, you can benefit from our flexible hybrid or full remote model, empowering you to work where you're most effective.

WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SHOPFULLY 🤗

🌎 An opportunity to thrive in a rapidly scaling multinational company

🕶️ A vibrant, informal, and inclusive work environment

🧠 We champion autonomy, flexibility, and a hybrid work model, empowering you to own your work

📚 Access to learning opportunities and regular feedback sessions

🍓 Enjoy our central, modern offices featuring fresh snacks, coffee (including vegan options!), and ergonomic setups

🎉 Engage in meaningful team events: offsites, happy hours, company parties and celebrations that unite us beyond daily tasks

💻We provide all the necessary equipment for you to work effectively and set up your workspace, wherever you are

🧰 Benefit from additional country-specific advantages based on local contracts and practices

WHO WE ARE 💜

We’re a team of 450 people (and counting!), from 30 different nationalities. We’re on a mission to innovate, and we believe the key to that is seeing the world through a variety of perspectives. That’s why building a more diverse team, as well as bringing in even more talent, is so important for us.

TO FEEL AT HOME 🛋️ IN SHOPFULLY YOU NEED 🎯

  • Progress Over Perfection: We move forward. Always. In a fast-moving world, speed with purpose beats certainty without action. Momentum matters—not for its own sake, but because it drives results.
  • Clarity Through Transparency: We bring each other along. We work in teams, not silos. Transparency gives context, and context enables action. That means we share decisions early, publish work in progress, and document outcomes so others can learn, move faster, and build better.
  • Learn Loudly: We grow by doing and by daring. Big bets unlock big breakthroughs. But real innovation demands risk, and risk always carries the possibility of failure. That’s not a flaw. It’s the price of ambition.
  • Challenge with Empathy: We speak up, even when it’s hard—because candor shows care, and leads to better outcomes. Listening deeply is how we grow. Disagreeing openly is how we build trust.

Always Build Better: We are builders—of products, systems, and ideas. But more than that, we are builders of better. Better has no finish line. It’s a mindset.

jobs.title: Health & Safety Coordinator
jobs.description: Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.   With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, spacecraft consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, and much more.  SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.   Want to help create a safer workplace where people can do their best work? As Health & Safety Coordinator at Esrange Space Center, you will help managers turn work environment requirements into clear routines and practical improvements. You will work closely with teams across the site to identify risks, strengthen safe working practices and support compliance with Swedish work environment regulations. This is a hands-on role combining coordination, analysis and training in a technical environment, where your focus will be occupational health and safety. JOB REQUIREMENTS    A relevant university degree in engineering, risk management, occupational health and safety, or equivalent knowledge gained through work experience.     At least five years of relevant health and safety experience.     In-depth knowledge of Swedish work environment regulations and experience applying them in practice.     Experience working at industrial or technical sites in Sweden where operations involve significant health and safety risks.     Fluency in Swedish and English.     A category B driving license valid within the European Economic Area. You communicate clearly and can explain requirements in a way that helps people understand what they need to do and why. You are comfortable addressing risks, challenging unsafe practices and following up on agreed actions. You bring sound judgement, integrity and an analytical approach, together with the ability to build effective working relationships across different teams. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES     Support managers in systematic work environment management, including risk assessments, safety rounds, allocation of work environment tasks and an annual work environment plan.     Develop and improve health and safety processes in line with SSC Space’s global management system.     Provide guidance on Swedish work environment regulations and coordinate health and safety inspections and audits with relevant authorities.     Support incident investigations and root cause analysis, and follow up on actions to prevent recurrence.     Establish routines for tracking required training and certificates for high-risk work, such as working at height.      Coordinate chemical inventories, safety data sheets and chemical risk assessments together with the organization.     Develop and deliver health and safety training and communication for managers and employees.     Monitor health and safety indicators, support the Site Manager with performance reporting and contribute to improvements and certification preparations. You will collaborate with site management, line managers, safety representatives, HR, the Range Safety Office, the Environmental Manager, the Group HSE Officer and specialists responsible for flammable goods and explosives. JOB BENEFITS We offer you       A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.      An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.      An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.   Additional benefits      In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.       Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.      Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.       Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.      Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.      Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.  LOCATION  This is a full-time, permanent position based at our space base Esrange outside of Kiruna. FURTHER INFORMATIONFor questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:  Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com  Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com      NEXT STEPIf this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.  As the application period runs close to the Christmas holidays, please be aware that feedback and next steps may take a little longer than usual. We appreciate your patience during this period. When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.   As part of our recruitment process, all candidates selected for employment undergo a background check and security screening. Citizenship requirements may apply depending on the role.  WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE  SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.  With local presence on all continents and about 800 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.    We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.

This role can be based in either San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.description:
At a glance

Location: Amsterdam

In-office expectation: At least twice a week

Employment type: Permanent, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Salary: 52000 – 75000 EURO Base plus Commission (50/50 Split)

Why this role exists: To grow Redgate's presence with mid-market companies across Benelux and the Nordics, helping more organisations manage their data and databases with confidence.

About Redgate

Redgate brings together people who want to do their best work in an environment built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

We build solutions that help data professionals securely manage the data and databases that their organizations depend on, a space that's only becoming more critical as systems scale, data regulations increase, and AI adoption accelerates.

AI at Redgate

By 2028, Redgate will operate as an expert-plus-agent company, with domain experts amplified by AI, delivering customer value at a pace our peers can't match.

AI handles the heavy lifting. Our people control the judgement. Everyone at Redgate works with Claude, giving you access to the best AI tools from day one.

Why join our Northern Europe Sales team?

  • You'll work in a team that cares about craft, collaboration, and quality.

  • There's real scope to grow your skills and impact, with clear pathways and support.

  • We value sustainable delivery, with good ways of working and time to improve how we work.

About the role

You'll drive new sales of Redgate's solutions into mid-market companies across Benelux and the Nordics, based in our Amsterdam office and reporting to our Sales Director, Northern Europe. This is a quota-carrying role covering the whole sales cycle, from outbound prospecting and qualification through to evaluation, close and ongoing account care. You'll have real ownership of your territory and the judgement to decide where your time goes.

  • Own your territory plan and pipeline, moving many opportunities forward at once and deciding where to focus to hit your goals

  • Work closely with pre-sales engineers, project managers and marketing managers to win new business

  • Become a trusted advisor to your customers, learning their key business challenges and staying accountable for the delivery of Redgate solutions

  • Grow relationships with customer accounts of all sizes, long after the first deal closes

  • Report on pipeline and forecast through our customer relationship management (CRM) system, keep an eye on the competition, and travel to customers when it helps win the deal

What makes you a great fit

  • A track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals across a large territory, with experience building pipeline through outbound prospecting

  • Experience running complex, non-transactional sales, including applying the MEDDPICC qualification framework

  • Strong collaboration skills, working across pre-sales, project management and marketing, with the autonomy and judgement to make good decisions independently

  • Clear, confident written and spoken communication with customers, colleagues and management

  • A genuine interest in technology and the ability to keep accurate pipeline and forecasts in a CRM

What we offer

Salary range: 52000 – 75000 EURO Base plus Commission (50/50 Split)

  • Hybrid working home and Amsterdam office

  • Monthly wellbeing allowance and generous paid time off

  • Genuine investment in learning, development, and career progression

  • Private health insurance

See our full list of benefits here: Careers at Redgate, Benefits

What happens next?

Your application will be reviewed by a person. We don't use AI or automated tools to assess applications. Every profile is read by one of our Talent Partners.

You'll hear back within a few days. Whether it's a next step or a no, we aim to respond promptly so you're not left wondering.

Our interview process is straightforward and consistent. You'll find more detail on our typical hiring process below, so you know what's coming and why.

Belonging at Redgate

We believe that people do their best work in an environment built on respect, fairness, and trust, and that diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes. Redgate is an equal opportunity employer, and we make hiring decisions based on skill, potential, and alignment with our values.

You can read more about how we approach belonging and inclusion at Redgate on our Belonging at Redgate page

jobs.title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
jobs.description: Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Touhula Merikarttaan, Joensuuhun.Meille touhulalaisille lapset ja perheet ovat sydämen asia. Yhdessä heidän kanssaan luomme onnellista lapsuutta ja hyvää työelämää – sitä rakastetuinta päiväkotia, joka on meidän kaikkien yhteinen.Uskomme, että varhaiskasvatus on yksi yhteiskuntamme tärkeimmistä asiantuntijatehtävistä. Haluamme kohdata jokaisen päiväkotimme ovesta sisään astuvan lapsen, huoltajan ja työkaverin lämpimästi, arvostavasti ja ammattitaidolla. Etsimme joukkoomme lapsuuden ja leikin puolustajaa, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta ja johtamassa pedagogista toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Touhula Merikartta – millainen päiväkoti?Touhula Merikartta on neliryhmäinen päiväkoti, jossa uskomme jatkuvaan kehittymiseen ja rohkeuteen tehdä asioita entistä paremmin. Viime vuosien aikana olemme kehittäneet toimintaamme määrätietoisesti, ja tämä näkyy niin asiakastyytyväisyydessä, arjen sujuvuudessa kuin työyhteisön vahvistumisessa. Meillä lapset osallistuvat toiminnan suunnitteluun, pedagogiikkaa rakennetaan yhdessä ja uusia ideoita kokeillaan ennakkoluulottomasti.Etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, joka haluaa olla osa tätä kehitystä. Toivomme sinulta aktiivista ja omatoimista työotetta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä aitoa halua kehittää toimintaa yhdessä työyhteisön kanssa. Arvostamme erityisesti osaamista tai kiinnostusta liikunta-, musiikki- ja kädentaitokasvatukseen sekä ymmärrystä lasten yksilöllisistä tuen tarpeista. Meillä menestyy henkilö, joka tarttuu toimeen, suhtautuu muutoksiin myönteisesti ja tuo työyhteisöön myös huumoria ja positiivista energiaa.Merikartassa pääset osaksi uudistunutta ja sopivan kokoista työyhteisöä, jossa ihmiset tuntevat toisensa ja yhteistyö on luontevaa. Käytössämme ovat Pedapuun materiaalit pedagogisen työn tukena, ja lähiympäristö tarjoaa monipuoliset mahdollisuudet retkiin, tutkimiseen ja toiminnalliseen oppimiseen. Haluamme vahvistaa erityisesti osaamisen jakamista, pedagogista kehittämistä ja yhdessä oppimisen kulttuuria, jossa jokainen työntekijä voi vaikuttaa päiväkodin tulevaisuuteen.Perheiltä saamme kiitosta lämminhenkisestä henkilöstöstä, monipuolisesta toiminnasta ja tavasta huomioida lapset osana arkea. Jos etsit työyhteisöä, jossa kehitystä tehdään määrätietoisesti mutta hyvässä hengessä, Touhula Merikartta voi olla juuri oikea paikka seuraavalle urastepillesi!Tehtäväsi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana:Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi pedagoginen vetäjä ja innostava mahdollistaja. Vastaat ryhmäsi toiminnan suunnittelusta ja laadukkaasta vasuprosessista Touhulan pedagogista vuosisuunnitelmaa, Touhula Rytmiä hyödyntäen. Tehtäväsi ytimessä on:- Pedagoginen johtaminen: Vastaat tiimisi arjen pedagogiikasta, pienryhmätoiminnasta sekä monipuolisten ja turvallisten oppimisympäristöjen rakentamisesta.- Yksilöllinen tuki: Suunnittelet ja arvioit lasten tukitoimia yhteistyössä moniammatillisten verkostojen kanssa.- Asiakaskokemus: Vastaat tiimisi laadukkaasta asiakasviestinnästä ja luot myönteistä tunneilmapiiriä, joka välittyy perheille asti.- Tiimin tuki: Kehität osallistavaa palautekulttuuria ja tuet kollegoita pedagogisessa työssä tiimin vahvuuksia hyödyntäen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut osaaja, teemme töitä sen eteen, että Touhula on sinulle paras paikka tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten tulevaisuuden hyväksi. Tarjoamme sinulle muun muassa:- Työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa- Epassi-edun (200 €/vuosi)- Työhyvinvointirahan yhteisiä virkistys- ja tyhypäiviä varten (80 €/vuosi)- Kattavan perehdytyksen- laadukkaat pedagogiset työvälineet- Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet ja täydennyskoulutusstipendit- Kannustavan ja kokeilunhaluisen toimintakulttuuriin, jossa sinä pääset ideoillasi vaikuttamaanTarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2 792,02 – 3 293,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Odotamme sinulta:- Kykyä rakentaa avointa ja ammatillista vuorovaikutusta kaikkien sidosryhmien kanssa- Vastuullista työotetta ja uskallusta kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja- Lain mukaista rikosrekisteriotetta sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista selvitystä- Varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuttaHuomioimme tarvittaessa myös varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaopiskelijat. Oppimisen ilo on meille tärkeää – siksi tuemme sinua opettajaksi pätevöitymisessä palkallisilla opiskelupäivillä ja 1000 euron stipendillä kannustinohjelmassamme.Haluatko tietää lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä!Touhula MerikarttaPuhelin: +358103258604 Sähköposti: anna.hukka@touhula.fi

jobs.title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
jobs.description: Haemme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa Touhula Taikapolkuun, Varkauteen.Meille touhulalaisille lapset ja perheet ovat sydämen asia. Yhdessä heidän kanssaan luomme onnellista lapsuutta ja hyvää työelämää – sitä rakastetuinta päiväkotia, joka on meidän kaikkien yhteinen.Uskomme, että varhaiskasvatus on yksi yhteiskuntamme tärkeimmistä asiantuntijatehtävistä. Haluamme kohdata jokaisen päiväkotimme ovesta sisään astuvan lapsen, huoltajan ja työkaverin lämpimästi, arvostavasti ja ammattitaidolla. Etsimme joukkoomme lapsuuden ja leikin puolustajaa, joka haluaa olla mukana rakentamassa laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta ja johtamassa pedagogista toimintaa yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.Touhula Taikapolku – millainen päiväkoti?Touhula Taikapolku on neliryhmäinen päiväkoti, jossa uskomme leikin, liikkumisen ja yhdessä oivaltamisen voimaan. Arjessamme näkyvät luonto, toiminnallinen oppiminen ja lasten osallisuus. Lähimetsät, retket ja ympäristön tutkiminen ovat luonteva osa toimintaamme, ja haluamme tarjota lapsille mahdollisuuksia oppia, ihmetellä ja onnistua monipuolisissa oppimisympäristöissä.Etsimme joukkoomme ammattilaista, joka tarttuu toimeen, kantaa vastuuta ja haluaa olla aktiivisesti kehittämässä varhaiskasvatuksen laatua. Arvostamme lapsilähtöistä ja pedagogisesti vahvaa työotetta sekä halua vahvistaa erityisesti liikunta- ja musiikkikasvatuksen näkyvyyttä osana lasten arkea. Toivomme sinulta myös erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja tiimityötaitoja sekä aitoa innostusta yhteiseen kehittämiseen.Taikapolussa pääset osaksi sitoutunutta ja motivoitunutta työyhteisöä, jossa puhalletaan yhteen hiileen ja jossa jokaisen osaamiselle annetaan tilaa. Saat ympärillesi osaavat kollegat, mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa toiminnan kehittämiseen sekä turvallisen työympäristön, jossa ammatillista kasvua tuetaan. Haluamme vahvistaa toimintakulttuuria, jossa toiminnallinen oppiminen, leikki, luonto ja liikunta näkyvät entistä vahvemmin jokaisen lapsen arjessa.Perheiltä saamme kiitosta lämpimästä kohtaamisesta, monipuolisesta toiminnasta sekä retkistä ja ulkona oppimisesta. Jos innostut pedagogiikan kehittämisestä, luonnossa oppimisesta ja yhteisöllisestä tavasta tehdä varhaiskasvatusta, voit olla juuri etsimämme kollega.Tehtäväsi varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana:Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi pedagoginen vetäjä ja innostava mahdollistaja. Vastaat ryhmäsi toiminnan suunnittelusta ja laadukkaasta vasuprosessista Touhulan pedagogista vuosisuunnitelmaa, Touhula Rytmiä hyödyntäen. Tehtäväsi ytimessä on:- Pedagoginen johtaminen: Vastaat tiimisi arjen pedagogiikasta, pienryhmätoiminnasta sekä monipuolisten ja turvallisten oppimisympäristöjen rakentamisesta.- Yksilöllinen tuki: Suunnittelet ja arvioit lasten tukitoimia yhteistyössä moniammatillisten verkostojen kanssa.- Asiakaskokemus: Vastaat tiimisi laadukkaasta asiakasviestinnästä ja luot myönteistä tunneilmapiiriä, joka välittyy perheille asti.- Tiimin tuki: Kehität osallistavaa palautekulttuuria ja tuet kollegoita pedagogisessa työssä tiimin vahvuuksia hyödyntäen.Me huolehdimme sinusta:Vastineeksi tarjoamme työyhteisön, jossa saat kasvaa ammattilaisena, oppia uutta, hyödyntää vahvuuksiasi ja vaikuttaa omaan työhösi. Olitpa urasi alussa tai jo kokenut osaaja, teemme töitä sen eteen, että Touhula on sinulle paras paikka tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten tulevaisuuden hyväksi. Tarjoamme sinulle muun muassa:- Työterveyshuollon Pihlajalinnassa- Epassi-edun (200 €/vuosi)- Työhyvinvointirahan yhteisiä virkistys- ja tyhypäiviä varten (80 €/vuosi)- Kattavan perehdytyksen- laadukkaat pedagogiset työvälineet- Monipuoliset koulutusmahdollisuudet ja täydennyskoulutusstipendit- Kannustavan ja kokeilunhaluisen toimintakulttuuriin, jossa sinä pääset ideoillasi vaikuttamaanTarjoamme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajalle kilpailukykyisen palkan, joka kokoaikaisella työntekijällä sijoittuu välille 2 792,02 – 3 293,23 €/kk. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy työkokemusvuosien sekä mahdollisen erityisosaamiseen perustuvan henkilökohtaisen palkanlisän mukaan. Voimme haastattelutilanteessa keskustella erityisosaamisesi huomioimisesta ja palkan tarkemmasta sijoittumisesta palkkahaitariin.Odotamme sinulta:- Kykyä rakentaa avointa ja ammatillista vuorovaikutusta kaikkien sidosryhmien kanssa- Vastuullista työotetta ja uskallusta kokeilla uusia toimintatapoja- Lain mukaista rikosrekisteriotetta sekä tartuntatautilain mukaista selvitystä- Varhaiskasvatuslain mukaista varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuuttaHuomioimme tarvittaessa myös varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaopiskelijat. Oppimisen ilo on meille tärkeää – siksi tuemme sinua opettajaksi pätevöitymisessä palkallisilla opiskelupäivillä ja 1000 euron stipendillä kannustinohjelmassamme.Haluatko tietää lisää? Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä!Touhula TaikapolkuPuhelin: 010 325 8728 Sähköposti: satu.laitinen@touhula.fi

jobs.title: Head of Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity  In Global Intelligent Business Services (GIBS), we are passionate about simplification, transforming business workflows to drive operational excellence and shift effort from transactional activities toward value creation and insights for the business.     We are now looking for an experienced finance leader to lead GIBS Financial Planning & Analysis delivery flow in a subset of Group Function scope and be part of the future FP&A operating model design and development. A person with high integrity, sound judgement and the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.  The role enables financially sound decision-making through integrated planning, forecasting, performance analysis and decision support and creates a standardized, data-driven and increasingly automated flow.  Role Overview  The Head of GIBS Financial Planning & Analysis owns operational delivery, performance and service quality across the defined FP&A scope. jobs.title: Temporary Executive Assistant -  Luxembourg
jobs.description:
As a (Temporary) Executive Assistant to the CFO, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to a senior executive. Acting as a key business partner, you will ensure the smooth management of the CFO's agenda, travel arrangements, communications, and day-to-day priorities, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and efficiency.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organization based in Luxembourg. The company offers a collaborative and professional environment where flexibility, trust, and high performance are valued. You will work closely with executive leadership and gain exposure to strategic business activities while supporting key operational processes.

Description

Executive & Administrative Support
  • Manage the CFO's complex agenda, meetings, appointments, and business commitments.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, meeting packs, and professional correspondence.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring urgent matters are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, and filing systems.
  • Anticipate administrative needs and provide proactive support on a daily basis.
Travel & Diary Management
  • Coordinate extensive domestic and international travel arrangements, including visas and logistics.
  • Organize flights, accommodation, transportation, and detailed itineraries.
  • Prepare travel documentation and monitor travel-related expenses and reimbursements.
  • Ensure scheduling conflicts are anticipated and resolved efficiently.
Stakeholder & Project Coordination
  • Serve as a key point of contact between the CFO and internal or external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, partners, and external contacts.
  • Monitor action points, track deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Support and coordinate business initiatives, projects, and executive-level meetings.
Office & Operational Support
  • Assist with budget monitoring and expense management across multiple cost centers.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Coordinate office-related activities and procurement when required.
  • Contribute to the smooth operation of daily business activities.
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
  • Proactive, autonomous, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Service-minded with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Turn product data into decisions that improve customer value and product performance. By defining the metrics that matter and connecting product, customer, and commercial signals, you help uncover where the biggest opportunities and challenges are and turn evidence into action.  The Cloud Product Organization brings together the capabilities needed to build and grow our cloud products. With clear responsibilities and close connections across the wider TFS portfolio, we work together to create customer value.  About the job You build the evidence base for a growth-focused product organization, defining the metrics that matter and making product performance easy to understand. Your analysis supports discovery, prioritization, and decisions across the product portfolio, while helping identify how data can create direct commercial value for customers in and around the products they use. You report to the Head of Cloud Product. Job responsibilities     Own product analytics and define, track and develop the metrics that matter.     Analyze product usage and user behavior, translating findings into concrete recommendations.     Support product discovery and prioritization with evidence and actionable insights.     Develop and maintain dashboards, analyses, and recurring insights that make product performance easy to understand.     Combine product usage, customer and commercial signals to identify opportunities, risks, and trends.     Turn gathered data into customer-facing insights and opportunities that create commercial value in and around our products, while improving adoption and product performance. Location & flexibility This position offers flexibility to work remotely or from one of our entities in Sweden, Germany, the US, or India.  Your profile You bring a analytical background and know how to move from complex data to conclusions that non-technical stakeholders can use. Experience in data analytics, product analytics, business intelligence, or a similar analytical field gives you the foundation to understand product behavior and turn it into practical recommendations. Your background includes:     Hands-on experience analyzing product usage and user behavior, including defining and working with KPIs, product metrics and measurement frameworks.     Strong analytical skills and experience working with large or complex datasets.     Experience with analytical and visualization tools such as Power BI.     The ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to Product Managers, commercial teams and leadership.     Preferably, experience in digital, SaaS or cloud products and working knowledge of SQL or similar data-querying approaches. Experience in a product-led or growth-focused organization is an advantage. It’s also beneficial if you understand SaaS/product metrics, or have supported product discovery, prioritization and experimentation with data. Curiosity shapes how you work. You investigate why customers behave as they do, while keeping the focus on what the evidence means for customers, the product and the business. Collaborative yet independent, you communicate complex findings clearly, work pragmatically and aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions constructively when the data points in a different direction.  The team You work closely with Product Managers and the Head of Cloud Product, as well as Data Services, which provides the underlying data layer. Customer Success and Sales are also important partners, bringing customer and revenue signals that help build a more complete picture of product performance.  Our culture Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results.  Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.  Contact information For further information about this position, please contact Gerrit Kremer - Head of Cloud Product & Portfolio, gerrit.kremer@sandvik.com We’ve already decided on which advertising channels and marketing campaigns we wish to use and respectfully decline any additional contacts in that matter. Union contacts – Sweden     Thomas Lilja, Unionen, +46 (0)70 261 04 82     Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87     Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70 222 48 55 Recruitment Specialist: Gustaf Sjögren How to apply Send your application no later than December 4, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0099480. We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure an objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test. To learn more about our recruitment process, please visit our career site or contact HR Services at hrservices.sweden@sandvik.com.     Business area Machining is a global leading manufacturer of tools and tooling systems for advanced industrial metal cutting, as well as metal powder. In 2025, sales were approximately SEK 44 billion with about 18,700 employees.

jobs.title: AI in RAN System Developer
jobs.description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity: Artificial Intelligence is rapidly becoming a key enabler for future Radio Access Networks. We are looking for an experienced AI in RAN System Developer who is passionate about applying machine learning and  advanced analytics  to solve real-world telecom challenges.    In this role, you will contribute from early phase systemization to development of AI-enabled RAN functions that improve network performance, optimize resource utilization and enhance the end-user experience. The focus is on AI for RAN functionality and embedded   You will work with some of the industry’s most advanced Radio Access Network technologies, including latest NR Advanced capabilities, while contributing to the journey toward 6G and AI-native networks. Working alongside experts in RAN architecture, radio algorithms, system design, software development and research, you will help shape how AI becomes an integral part of future wireless systems.    This is an opportunity to combine cutting-edge Machine Learning with carrier-grade radio technology, where solutions must be productized and executed efficiently within strict real-time, compute, memory, power and latency constraints.    What you will do: •    Drive the system design of AI/ML-enabled RAN functions and algorithms, ensuring that machine learning techniques can be productized and executed efficiently within real-time RAN systems. •    Analyze data and translate insights into deployable capabilities that can improve network efficiency, latency, throughput, capacity, reliability and user experience. •    Design meaningful experiments, data collection strategies and validation methodologies to assess the effectiveness, feasibility and product impact of AI-driven solutions. •    Evaluate technical and business problems and determine when machine learning provides value compared with classical algorithmic approaches, avoiding indiscriminate use of AI.  •    Work closely with engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into existing RAN products, software platforms and development flows, from early prototype and proof-of-concept work to production-quality implementation. •    Optimize AI models for deployment under finite CPU, memory, power and latency budgets, balancing AI accuracy against computational cost and operational value. •    Contribute to the evolution of AI methodologies, lifecycle practices, tooling and best practices for RAN products and future AI-native networks.    The skills you bring: •    Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Telecommunications or a related discipline. •    Strong Machine Learning fundamentals, including supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, feature engineering and feature selection, model training, validation, performance evaluation, statistical analysis and data-driven decision making. •    Experience with resource-constrained systems, including the ability to design models that fit within finite CPU, memory, power and latency budgets. •    Understanding of inference optimization, model compression, quantization, pruning, acceleration techniques and deployment feasibility on embedded or telecom platforms. •    Strong software engineering skills, including modern C++, Python for AI experimentation and prototyping, software architecture understanding, CI/CD and the ability to move from prototype to production software. •    Understanding of telecom and RAN systems, preferably within areas such as scheduling, mobility, link adaptation, RRM algorithms, O&M systems or performance management.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Payments
jobs.description: Vill du utveckla betalningslösningar som behöver fungera stabilt dygnet runt och hantera stora transaktionsvolymer? Hos oss får du kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med stort inflytande över en av ATG:s mest affärskritiska tekniska domäner. Vi söker en Principal Engineer som drivs av tekniskt hantverk, gillar att lösa svåra problem och vill utveckla både system och människor omkring sig. I rollen får du:    Utveckla affärskritiska betalningstjänster och integrationer med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet, prestanda och skalbarhet.    Ta en ledande roll i tekniska vägval, systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur, samtidigt som du fortsätter vara hands-on i utvecklingen.    Komma in tidigt i större initiativ, exempelvis vid nya betalningslösningar och integrationer, och identifiera tekniska möjligheter, beroenden och risker.    Driva tekniska frågor över teamgränser och vara en brygga mellan utvecklare, arkitekter, produkt och andra delar av organisationen.    Skapa teknisk riktning i teamet, coacha andra utvecklare och bidra till att höja teamets samlade tekniska förmåga.Payments är en central del av ATG:s digitala ekosystem. Teamet ansvarar för tekniska lösningar kopplade till digitala betalningar, bland annat insättningar och uttag. Du arbetar i en miljö där stora transaktionsvolymer möter integrationer mot externa Payment Service Providers och där området fortsätter utvecklas i takt med nya marknader och betalningsmetoder.Är det här du?Vi tror att du är en mycket erfaren backendutvecklare som fortfarande tycker om att skriva kod och gå på djupet i komplexa tekniska problem. Samtidigt lyfter du naturligt blicken från den egna lösningen och ser hur system, team och beroenden hänger ihop.Du är trygg i att skapa teknisk riktning och tar initiativ när en lösning kräver samarbete över teamgränser. Med teknisk trovärdighet och tydlig kommunikation skapar du samsyn och får andra med dig i komplexa tekniska vägval. Du har också förmågan att göra teknisk komplexitet begriplig och tydliggöra konsekvenser av tekniska problem och beslut för olika delar av organisationen.Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:    Java och/eller Kotlin, gärna med Spring och Hibernate.    Mikrotjänster, distribuerade system och messaging, exempelvis JMS.    AWS eller motsvarande modern molnplattform.    Kubernetes.    SQL och databaser.    Systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur för system med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och prestanda.    Tekniskt ledarskap där du skapat riktning, stöttat andra utvecklare och omsatt komplexa behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.Extra intressant är erfarenhet från:    Fintech eller andra verksamheter med affärskritiska transaktionsflöden.We are the gameI mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.Join the game!Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!Så här har vi detHos oss är du del av en innovativ miljö och med hjälp av den senaste tekniken utvecklar du den bästa spelupplevelsen. Vi gillar att samarbeta och hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka ditt arbetssätt. Här hittar du nyfikna, nytänkande medarbetare och ledare – viktiga egenskaper för att kunna utveckla och utvecklas. Liksom energi , mod och motivation.För att må bra är skrattmuskeln lika viktig att träna som alla andra muskler. Både den fysiska och den mentala hälsan skapar balans i livet. Hur vi har det på jobbet påverkar privatlivet- och vice versa. Vi ser det som en självklarhet att ge det stöd och de verktyg som behövs. Ditt val av arbetsplats och arbetssätt är flexibelt och vi lägger stor vikt på självledarskap.Vi bryr oss om varandra och respekterar varandras olikheter på ATG. Och vi vill att våra kunder ska må bra och ha roligt när de spelar. Vi bryr oss också om sportens välmående, dvs. idrottarna och hästarna - och samhället runt omkring oss. Vi drivs inte av privata vinstintressen utan allt överskott går tillbaka till våra ägare, svensk trav- och galoppsport, något som både känns och gör gott.

jobs.title: Director, Operations IT - MES, Product Management
jobs.description: Job Title: Director, Operations IT - Manufacturing Execution Systems, Product ManagementLocation: Södertälje, SwedenLocation note: Suitable applicants from other AZ hub/Operations sites may be considered We are looking for a visionary and experienced IT Director to lead the global strategy, implementation and optimization of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) across our pharmaceutical operations. In this high-impact role, you will drive digital transformation, ensure alignment between technology and business priorities, and help advance manufacturing efficiency, quality and compliance. This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic leadership, technology and manufacturing expertise while making an impact across a global organization. The role is based in Södertälje, Sweden. The Manufacturing IT capability is a global capability within Operations IT, responsible for delivering strategic digital technologies that enable safe, compliant and efficient manufacturing across AstraZeneca's Operations network. The team spans Manufacturing Execution Systems, Manufacturing Optimisation, Plant Maintenance, Warehouse Management, and Autonomous Manufacturing, working closely with manufacturing sites, enterprise IT teams and strategic technology partners to develop scalable global solutions through platform and product management. What you'll do:Strategic Leadership:    Develop and execute the MES strategy to align with AstraZeneca's 2030 bold ambition.    Develop an MES technology roadmap that considers and makes use of technology advancements that will benefit Operations through Manufacturing Execution processes that contribute to AstraZeneca's goals and objectives.    Proactively plan MES projects and programs globally with relevant AstraZeneca sites/regions. IT Product Management:    Define the MES product vision and roadmap in partnership with technology vendors and manufacturing stakeholders.    Govern product backlog prioritisation, balancing business value, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies and available capacity.    Oversee the full product lifecycle, from discovery and delivery through adoption, continuous improvement and retirement.    Establish product success measures and use stakeholder feedback and performance data to guide investment and improvement. System Implementation and Optimization:    Govern the design, configuration, integration, and deployment of MES solutions globally to ensure standardization and enterprise efficiencies.    Ensure MES solutions align with industry best practices, regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, GMP), and company standards.    Continuously evaluate system performance and identify opportunities for optimization. Stakeholder Collaboration:    Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Manufacturing BPO's, Site teams, IT, ERP teams and external vendors to develop, deliver and maintain the MES strategy and MES systems globally.    Collaborate with IT Business Analysts, Architects and Service Delivery teams to plan, deliver and operate MES solutions globally. Compliance and Risk Management:    Ensure all MES implementations comply with regulatory requirements and cybersecurity standards.    Develop and maintain SOPs related to MES usage, data integrity, and system validation. Budget and Vendor Management:    Manage the MES program budget and ensure cost-effective solutions.    Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with MES vendors and third-party service providers. Essential requirements for the role:    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field    Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in IT within manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role focusing on MES    Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP practices, and regulatory frameworks    Proficiency in MES platforms (Werum PAS-X and/or Tulip) and their integration with ERP and automation systems    Proven ability to lead global teams and manage complex, large-scale projects    Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and deliver solutions    Proven ability to work with external vendors    Proven ability to work with global teams in relation to MES platforms    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Work policy:When we put people in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. This role is located in Södertälje, Sweden and is not available for remote work or with travel or commuting support. Why AstraZeneca:Join a team with the backing and investment to win! You'll be working with cutting-edge technology. This marriage between our purposeful work and the use of high-tech platforms is what sets us apart. Lead the way in digital healthcare. From exploring data and AI to working in the cloud on new technologies. Join a team at the forefront. Help shape and define the technologies of the future, with the backing you need from across the business. What's next:If this sounds like the place and role for you - apply today! We look forward to getting to know you better! Welcome with your application no later than November 30, 2026.

jobs.title: Postdoc position in Applied Geochemistry
jobs.description: Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.In the research subject Applied Geochemistry at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering, Luleå University of Technology (LTU), we are looking for a Postdoc Researcher. Applied Geochemistry at LTU focuses on the occurrence and mobility of elements and geochemical processes that occur in rock, soil, and water at the Earth’s surface. Research is conducted on natural and anthropogenic sources and their interactions within and between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere. This is achieved by combining analytical chemistry, isotopic geochemistry, environmental forensics, and environmental mineralogy. Research and education in this subject address environmental issues tied to the mining industry, infrastructure construction, acid sulphate soils, and sulphide-bearing rocks. The research group has a strong experimental and applied profile, with well-equipped laboratories and extensive collaborations with industry and the public sector, all geared towards building a long-term, sustainable society.Subject descriptionApplied Geochemistry is concerned with studies into the occurrence and mobility of the elements in rocks, soil, and water, focusing on methods to prevent or reduce the environmental impact of metal extraction and infrastructure development.BackgroundThe position will support the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet) funded PhD Research School on Mining and Mineral Research – BioGeoMetals, a national collaboration between Linnaeus University (coordinator), Luleå University of Technology (LTU), and KTH Royal Institute of Technology. BioGeoMetals focuses on biogeochemical and hydrogeochemical approaches for sustainable metal recovery and environmental management in mining environments. The research school addresses the mobilization and recovery of critical raw materials from mining waste rock, tailings, groundwater, or run-off waters, as well as bioremediation of impacted mine sites. Through interdisciplinary doctoral training, joint courses, and close collaboration with industry and public authorities, the research school aims to educate the next generation of researchers contributing to sustainable mining and responsible resource management in Sweden and beyond.Project descriptionThe project will investigate how microbiology can be used in geochemical exploration to find ore deposits. Characterisation of solids, liquids and microbes in mining environments (e.g. tailings, mine water, and waste rock) will serve as the base for subsequent brown- and greenfield exploration trials. The successful candidate will focus on the characterisation of solids and closely work with the PhDs and partners in the project.The work will cover:- Laboratory and field investigations- Mineralogical, geochemical and petrographic characterization- Development of analytical methods and exploration strategiesDutiesAs a Postdoc, you will:- Conduct field sampling of solid phases (rock, soil, till, sediments)- Perform laboratory-based geochemical and mineralogical analyses- Integrate and interpret multi-disciplinary datasets- Design methods of mineral exploration- Co-supervise PhD's- Teach in geology-related courses- Publish results in peer-reviewed scientific journals- Present findings at national and international conferencesQualificationsWe are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in exploration, geochemistry, field and laboratory work, microbiology, and sustainable mining.You must have:- A PhD degree in geology, geochemistry, environmental geoscience, or a closely related field- Good oral and written proficiency in English- Experience in conducting field work- Expertise in soil-related exploration- Strong background in characterisation techniques- A driving licenseMeritorious qualifications include:- SEM-based automated mineralogy- Heavy mineral concentration expertisePersonal qualities such as analytical ability, independence, collaboration skills, and strong motivation for research will be given significant weight.Further information This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension. The position is based in Luleå. Start date: January 2027 or according to agreement.For each position, a preliminary salary range https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Thomas Aiglsperger, +46 920-491016, thomas.aiglsperger@ltu.se, or Oscar Paulsson oscar.paulsson@ltu.sehttps://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-TradeunioncontactsIn case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.ApplicationWe prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.Closing date for applications: December 10, 2026Reference number: 5860-2026

jobs.description:
Butiksassistent

Ulrik-P Retail Aps

 

Til vores hyggelige butik i Blåvand søger vi en engageret butiksassistent.

Om jobbet

I samarbejde med kolegaerne, skal du sørge for at butikken altid fremstår indbydende, så vores kunder får en indkøbsoplevelse ud over det sædvanlige.

Dine opgaver omfatter bl.a. følgende:

  • Betjene kunderne ved kassen

  • Sørge for, at butikken altid fremstår knivskarp med fyldte hylder og flotte varer

  • Modtage varer

  • Vedligeholdelse af priser m.m. i kassesystemet

  • Opbygge udstillinger af nye varer og varer der er på tilbud

Om dig:

  • Du er smilende og venlig

  • Glad for kundekontakt

  • Har et stort engagement og drive

  • Trives i en travl og til tider hektisk hverdag

  • Er omstillingsparat

  • Ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Har fokus på detaljen og sætter en ære at butikken altid er pæn

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Attraktivt arbejdsmiljø

  • En sjov og udfordrende hverdag

  • Ansøgning behandles løbende.

  • Tiltrædelse efter aftale

Fremsend ansøgning til Christine Koch ulrik-p-butik@hotmail.com  mrk: butiksassistent Blåvand/Henne Strand

jobs.title: Säljare till Telenor på Cypern Start 12/1 (Ink boende & flyg!)
jobs.description: Startdatum: 12/1 Plats: På plats, Larnaca, Cypern | Anställning: Heltid 40 h/vecka, provanställning 6 månader | Arbetstider: Måndag–fredag, varierande pass mellan 09.00–19.00 (ej helger) | Löneform: Fast lön + provision Det är möjligt att skicka in din ansökan till kommande starter redan idag för att säkra dig en plats i solenOm rollen & vår klient:  I din roll som kundtjänstmedarbetare och säljare för Telenor Konsument kommer du hjälpa privatkunder med frågor kring telefoni, bredband, abonnemang, kontantkort och tv-paket. Du arbetar både med kundsupport, savedesk och inkommande säljsamtal. Din viktigaste uppgift blir att ge kunderna service i toppklass och skapa en positiv kundupplevelse. Rollen innebär stora utvecklingsmöjligheter och en lönemodell där endast du själv sätter gränserna. För att ge dig de bästa förutsättningarna att trivas och lyckas hos oss på Foundever erbjuder vi:     Fast månadslön med mycket bra provisionssystem, utan tak.     Förmånligt skattesystem med 0 % inkomstskatt upp till €22,000/år.     Betald utbildning och träning av certifierade tränare.     Boende via företaget – fullt utrustade centrala lägenheter i Larnaca.     Flygresa bokad och betald av oss, tur och retur.     Kontorstider, inga helger.     Stöttning och support av kollegor, ledare och lokalt HR-team.     Refer-A-Friend bonus – jobba med vänner och få extra ersättning.     Sol 330 dagar om året.     Sjuk- och olycksfallsförsäkring under både arbete och fritid.     Gruppaktiviteter, exempelvis utflykter, tävlingar och temafester.     Rabatter på caféer, restauranger, skönhetssalonger, butiker m.m.     Hjälp med all administration på plats – bankkonto, migration m.m.     Möjlighet att växa och utvecklas inom företaget. För att lyckas i den här rollen ser vi att du:     Har fullständig gymnasieutbildning.     Talar flytande svenska.     Har goda kunskaper i engelska.     Är en teamplayer som trivs i högt tempo och gillar kundservice och merförsäljning.     Har ett rent belastningsregister. Meriterande (men ej krav):     Tidigare erfarenhet av kundservice eller försäljning.     Datorvana och vana att arbeta i olika system.     Annan språkkunskap. Vad händer nu?     Efter att du skickat in din ansökan går vi igenom den.     Går du vidare kontaktar vi dig via mejl för att boka ett introduktionsmöte över telefon.     Du genomför därefter våra online-tester.     Slutligen bokas en intervju via Teams med en rekryterare. Gemenskap, trivsel, syfte och utveckling är våra ledord. Vi hoppas vi att du vill bli en del av vårt team! Har du frågor om tjänsten, tveka inte att höra av dig till - Nordic-Recruitment@foundever.com____________________________________________________________ Vill du läsa mer om vad Cypern erbjuder, och hur livet där kan vara? Cypern är en ö belägen mitt i Medelhavet där du erbjuds allt!  Med storslagen natur, vita finkorniga sandstränder och turkosglittrande hav har du alltid nära till fantastiska upplevelser. Cypern har ett av Europas finaste badvatten enligt Blå Flagg-klassificering med en snitt-temperatur på 27 grader sommartid, och till havs finns många roliga aktiviteter att testa. Vad sägs om jetski, snorkling, windsurfing eller vattenskidor? Eller kanske väljer du att testa på vrakdykning – har du tur kan du få syn på både sköldpaddor och sälar! Strand-häng i all ära, men vänder du blickarna mot Cyperns storslagna bergskedjor finner du även aktiviteter som vandring, jeepsafari, guidade turer i nationalpark samt skidåkning under vintertid.  I de många olika mysiga orterna runtom på ön finns allt från underbara naturupplevelser till kulturella sevärdheter och shopping i världsklass. Ön är präglad av mötet mellan influenser från både grekisk och turkisk kultur, som speglas i allt från den spännande matkulturen till fantastiska historiska platser och kulturarv. Som tidigare brittisk koloni är Cypern en plats där människor möts och den internationella känslan genomsyrar stämningen, och ön är känd för sin varma, välkomnande lokalbefolkning.  Engelska klarar du dig långt på då i stort sett hela lokalbefolkningen talar språket, men vill man så finns det självfallet möjlighet att gå kurser i bland annat grekiska som också talas av många på ön.
