jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja Liikkuva Kortteli-hankkeeseen
jobs.employer: Vantaan Nuorten Miesten Kristillinen Yhdistys ry
jobs.description: NMKY – YMCA on maailman suurin nuorisojärjestö, joka toimii yli 120 maassa. YMCA Vantaa – Vantaan NMKY ry kuuluu YMCA liikkeeseen. Keskeisimpiä toimintamuotojamme ovat nuoriso-, nuorisotila-, iltapäivä- ja harrastustoiminta sekä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden leirit.Haemme kaksivuotiseen Suomi Liikkeelle-ohjelman Liikkuva kortteli-toimintaan hanketyöntekijää, joka vastaa hankkeen käytännön toteutuksesta, arvioinnista, seurannasta ja raportoinnista. Haemme hankkeeseen työntekijää, jolla on liikunta-alan koulutus (esim. liikuntaneuvoja) sekä taito huolehtia, että kokonaisuus etenee hankkeen tavoitteiden ja aikataulun mukaisesti. Hankkeessa työskentelee YMCAn projektitiimi ja tukenasi on hankkeesta YMCA Vantaalla vastaava nuorisotoiminnan koordinaattori.Liikkuva kortteli -toiminnan tavoitteena on lisätä erityisesti lasten ja nuorten liikkumista arjessa ja vähentää liikkumisen eriarvoistumista. Maksutonta liikunnallista toimintaa järjestetään taloyhtiön pihoilla, puistoissa ja lähiluonnossa. Liikkuva kortteli-toimintaa kehitetään tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri toimijoiden kanssa, joten aiempi kokemus verkosto- ja yhteistyöstä on edellytys työssä onnistumisessa. Toiminta keskittyy valtakunnallisesti kaupunginosiin, joissa asukkailla on keskimäärin haastavampi sosioekonominen asema ja kohonnut riski vähäiselle liikunnan harrastamiselle. Vantaalla toiminta-alueena hankkeen alkaessa on Itä- ja Länsi-Vantaan alueet. Hankkeen alussa työaika määräytyy noin 50% ohjaustyöstä ja 50% muusta hallinnollisesta hanketyöstä (mm. suunnittelu, organisointi, viestintä, kehittämistyö, seuranta, verkosto- ja yhteistyö).**Tehtäviisi kuuluu mm.**- liikunta- ja vapaa-ajantoiminnan sekä tapahtumien suunnittelu, toteutus ja arviointi - osallisuuden, hyvinvoinnin ja yhteisöllisyyden edistäminen - hallinnollinen hanketyö - verkosto- ja yhteistyö mm. VAV:in ja asukasyhdistysten kanssa sekä järjestöjen ja muiden yhteistyökumppaneidemme kanssa **Odotamme sinulta**- soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. liikuntaneuvoja) ja/tai vahva liikunnallinen tausta ja osaaminen - hyvää organisointi- ja kokonaisuudenhallintakykyä sekä itsenäistä, suunnitelmallista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta · positiivista ja innostavaa asennetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ryhmänohjaustaitoja· oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä· kiinnostusta liikunnan, hyvinvoinnin ja osallisuuden edistämiseen- kokemus kokonaisuuksien organisoinnista sekä kehittämis-, suunnittelu- ja arviointityöstä luetaan eduksi - autonkäyttömahdollisuus luetaan eduksi, sillä työ on liikkuvaa **Tarjoamme**- merkityksellisen työn liikunnan parissa - mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen - mahdollisuuden kehittää toimintaa, hyödyntää omia vahvuuksia sekä kehittää omaa osaamista - monipuoliset työtehtävät sekä vaihtelevan työympäristön Työ on osa-aikainen, 70-80%, sopimuksen mukaan. Huomioithan, että ohjaustyötä tehdään niin aamu- kuin ilta-aikoina ja työ sisältää myös satunnaista viikonlopputyötä. Viikkotyöaika on mahdollista räätälöidä työntekijän toiveiden mukaisesti neljä tai viisi päiväiseksi. Työsuhde on määräaikainen hankkeen kestosta johtuen.Työ alkaa 25.1.2027. Työsopimus tehdään aluksi ensimmäiseksi hankevuodeksi, 31.12.2027 asti, jonka jälkeen työsuhdetta on mahdollista jatkaa seuraavalle hankevuodelle.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Nuorisotoiminnan koordinaattori Hanna Sares (044-902 2998) tai Järjestöpäällikkö Marika Ahola (050-551 0447)Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viimeistään 13.12.2026 osoitteeseen: vantaa@ymca.fi Työntekijä palkataan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tehtävään valitun henkilön tulee ennen työsuhteen alkamista esittää rikosrekisteriote lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukaisesti. Lähettämällä hakemuksesi annat suostumuksesi henkilötietojesi käsittelyyn rekrytointiprosessin toteuttamiseksi.**Tule mukaan rakentamaan YMCA:laista liikunnallista, mielekästä ja yhteisöllistä arkea!**

jobs.title: Project and Item Master Coordinator
jobs.description: At Toyota Material Handling Europe, we create the technology that keeps the world moving. With over 13,500 colleagues, we are passionate about supporting companies of all sizes in meeting today's and tomorrow's material handling challenges. We recognize that our industry is essential-and often critical-to everyday life and society as a whole.From our headquarters in Mjölby (Sweden) and Willebroek (Belgium), to our sales companies across Europe and our factories in France, Italy, and Sweden, you can be part of an extraordinary journey. Together, we are moving the world towards easier, more sustainable solutions.The PositionAt Toyota Material Handling Europe, we are now looking for a structured and proactive Project Coordinator Manager to join our strong team within Service & Logistics department. We have a very active role in all development projects around the R&D centers in Europe and in this role, you will manage the complete lifecycle of the products - from concept and development through industrialization and production launch until the usage of our products at our customer sites, all from an aftermarket perspective.Together with your colleagues you will provide valuable input to ensure that aftermarket requirements are captured, and you will follow up on key activities to secure successful project outcomes. You will work in cross-functional project teams where you will play a central role in ensuring that all spare parts data and information are accurate, complete, and available throughout the project lifecycle.You will report to the Manager of Parts Project CoordinationYour responsibilityParticipate as a core team member in product development projects, representing the Service & Logistics function and ensuring requirements and activities are identified, coordinated, and followed up.Collaborate closely with multiple departments across Toyota Material Handling, including Project Management, Product Management, R&D, Purchasing, Production, Order Management, and Aftermarket.Manage spare parts related activities together with key suppliers, including external truck manufacturers producing products under Toyota brands (OEM).Keep the organization informed and engaged regarding project status, milestones, and ongoing activities.Follow the Engineering Change process in development projects, ensuring aftermarket requirements are validated and implemented in ERP systems.Ensure all spare parts are accurately documented in Spare Parts Catalogues and available for ordering through ERP systems (SAP).Work cross-functionally to continuously improve processes, ways of working, and collaboration across departments.Ensure compliance with TMHE policies, guidelines, and requirements.Your ProfileExcellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build strong relationships at all levels of the organization.Well organized and detail oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured and efficient manner.Proactive and driven, with a continuous improvement mindset and a passion for developing both processes and ways of working.Experience working in cross-functional teams and collaborating across larger organizations.Experience or knowledge of Toyota Material Handling products is considered an advantage.Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.Experience working with systems such as SAP, Enovia, and the Microsoft Office suite.A degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or equivalent professional experience.Our OfferAt Toyota Material Handling Europe, we're more than a global leader in a fast-paced industry-we're a collaborative team driven by innovation, continuous growth, and creating real value for our customers. Our diverse and international environment offers a workplace where your ideas are valued, and your contributions can make a meaningful impact. This position is based in Mjölby, Sweden, with the opportunity to work in a hybrid arrangement, combining on-site and remote work.We offer a competitive benefits package, including an annual bonus and flexible working arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance. You'll have clear goals, strong support from senior leadership, and excellent opportunities for professional growth and career development. We foster an environment where you can build a rewarding career while contributing to meaningful work that helps shape the future of our industry.Your Application Submit your application in English no later than the 6th of December. Applications only accepted through our recruitment system. We screen continuously, so do not miss out and send in your application today!For more information, please contactTalent Acquisition Specialist Patrik Schultzén at patrik.schultzen@toyota-industries.euManager of Parts Project Coordination Per Franzén at per.franzen@toyota-industries.eu

jobs.title: Brænder du for at arbejde med børn i alderen 0-3 år?
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at arbejde med børn i alderen 0-3 år?

... så er Louisegården måske det rigtige match. Vi prioriterer høj faglighed, samarbejde, fleksibilitet, overblik og humor højt. Alt sammen for at skabe gode, sunde og konstruktive arbejdsfællesskaber, til gavn for børnene.

Om stillingen:

o   Vuggestuen søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld uddannet pædagog.

o   Stillingen er på 35 - 37 timer om ugen, med opstart snarest muligt. Andet kan også aftales.

o   Hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt fællesskab, hvor nærvær, leg og udvikling inden for nærmeste udviklingszone, går hånd i hånd.

Vi søger dig som:

o   er handlekraftig og forstår både værdien af en organiseret aktivitetsstruktur, samtidig med at du har øje for at følge børnenes spor og initiativer i de planlagte aktiviteter.

o   er engageret og kan arbejde selvstændigt, samt i tæt samarbejde med kollegaer og ledelse.

o   har humor, er imødekommende, positiv og gerne iderig

o   kan være en tydelig voksen, som har situationsfornemmelse og tør sætte egne grænser

o   formår at bevare overblikket i stressede situationer

o   vil arbejde mod fælles værdier, visioner og mål

o   har realistiske udviklingsområder for øje.

o   er rummelig og anerkendende i forhold til både børn, kollegaer og forældre.

o   Ønsker at arbejde databaseret med bl.a. KIDS (kvalitet i danske daginstitutioner) som ramme for vores faglige udvikling.

 

Vi kan tilbyde:

o   et skønt børnehus, som arbejder relationelt med afsæt i Marte Meo kommunikationsprincipper

o   en fantastisk børnegruppe

o   et udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor struktur, refleksion og evaluering over egen og andres pædagogiske praksis er i fokus

o   rig mulighed for at præge det pædagogiske arbejdet.

o   visionære kollegaer og en engageret forældregruppe

o   gode indendørs- og udendørsfaciliteter

o   En synlig, tydelig ledelse der arbejder tæt på praksis og som bakker op om ideer og projekter.

o   høj grad af inddragelse og løbende dialog.

o   en stor personalegruppe hvor der er mulighed for at sparre og samarbejde på tværs af stuer.

o   Gratis personaleparkering

 

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Skriv til os: louisegaarden@diakonissen.dk

Du er også hjertelig velkommen til at kigge forbi til en uforpligtende rundvisning og en faglig dialog – vi viser gerne Louisegården frem og fortæller mere om vores hverdag.

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

jobs.title: Market Development Specialist
jobs.description: Are you a commercially driven professional who enjoys building business relationships, identifying market opportunities and turning insights into business growth?EPD International, a wholly owned subsidiary of IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute, is looking for a Market Development Specialist (parental leave cover) to join our market team and contribute to our continued international growth. We operate the International EPD System, helping businesses communicate their products’ environmental impact through independently verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs).As sustainability, digitalization and regulatory developments create new business opportunities, you will combine B2B sales and stakeholder engagement with strategic market analysis and business development in a rapidly evolving industry. About the roleAs Market Development Specialist, you will play an important role in strengthening our market position, developing commercial relationships and identifying new business opportunities. You will investigate market potential, understand customer needs and industry developments, and build a clear view of where our efforts can have the greatest impact. Working closely with the Market Team, CEO and colleagues across the organisation, you will translate your findings into recommendations and targeted market development initiatives.  This experienced individual contributor role has no direct sales targets or people management responsibilities. You will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to influence market priorities, combining analytical work with external engagement and hands-on implementation. What you will do The role combines two equally important areas:Market Analysis & Business Development    Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities and potential growth areas.    Develop business strategies and commercial models for new and existing services.    Support the development and alignment of commercial agreements, partnership frameworks and related documentation in collaboration with relevant internal experts.    Identify and develop new opportunities for collaboration with strategic partners.    Translate market insights into concrete business recommendations and actionable initiatives.Sales & Stakeholder Relations    Drive B2B sales activities, from identifying potential customers and partners to developing opportunities and closing deals.    Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including manufacturers, LCA consultancies, industry organisations and technology providers.    Identify customer needs and translate them into commercial opportunities.    Develop strategic collaborations that strengthen our market presence and generate long-term business value.    Represent EPD International in customer meetings and industry events. What you bringWe are looking for a commercially minded and analytical professional who enjoys combining relationship-building with strategic thinking and hands-on execution. We believe you have:    At least +3 years professional experience in business development, market analysis or commercial strategy.    Proven experience in B2B sales and market development, preferably in an international environment.    A demonstrated ability to build relationships, identify opportunities and generate business results.    The ability to move from analysis to implementation and take ownership of projects from initial investigation through delivery and follow-up.     Experience working with business models, partnerships or commercial agreements.    Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, both written and spoken.    A relevant university degree in business, marketing, economics, engineering or a related field. It is an advantage if you also have:    Experience in sustainability, environmental services, construction products or related industries.    Knowledge of LCAs, EPDs or environmental product information.    Experience with digital services, data platforms, APIs or subscription-based business models.    Experience working with international partner networks. Why EPD InternationalWe work independently to help organisations worldwide publish third-party verified decision-grade environmental data, guided by a vision of transparent, credible and comparable information for everyone to support decisions that benefit the planet. You will help shape our market priorities and contribute to the wider use of credible environmental information. Working at EPD International you will create green positive impact in an international context, you will have the opportunity to turn market understanding into initiatives that make a tangible difference to the reach and adoption of the International EPD System. Interested in helping us identify and develop our next market opportunities? We welcome your application.About the jobLocation: Stockholm Company: EPD International (part of IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute) Reports to: Chief Operating Officer (COO), EPD International Employment type: Fixed-term parental leave cover, with the possibility of an extension Duration: Ideally from 1 February to 31 December 2027.

jobs.description: Vitec BidTheatre builds software and solutions for data-driven online marketing. Our platform enables media agencies, brands and other marketing professionals to manage and deliver programmatic advertising campaigns.We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our small engineering team in Stockholm. The position offers a high degree of independence, technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the continued development of our platform.About the roleAs a member of our engineering team, you will work across our technology stack, developing and maintaining the applications and services that power our advertising platform.A key part of your role will be taking the lead in the continued development of BidTheatre Studio, our web application used by clients and internal teams to manage digital advertising campaigns. You will have significant influence over frontend architecture, technical decisions and development practices.Beyond the frontend, you will also be actively involved in developing and maintaining our backend systems, including APIs, business logic and data processing. We are looking for someone with solid experience in both frontend and backend development who is comfortable taking responsibility across the entire application stack.Our frontend uses React, TypeScript and Redux. Our backend is primarily Java-based, with technologies such as SQL, Redis, Aerospike, Kafka and Spark supporting our data-intensive platform.We embrace modern development practices, including AI-assisted coding, and encourage experimentation with tools that improve productivity and code quality.We believe you are an experienced and versatile developer who enjoys understanding how systems work as a whole. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks, making technical decisions and working independently, while collaborating closely with your colleagues.Requirements    5+ years of professional software development experience    Strong experience with React, TypeScript and modern frontend development    Solid professional experience in backend development using Java or comparable technologies such as C#/.NET or Kotlin    Ability and willingness to work with Java-based backend systems    Good understanding of SQL and relational databases    Experience developing and maintaining larger web applications    Good understanding of software architecture, performance and maintainability    Ability to independently drive technical decisions and development    Experience with Git, testing and modern development practices    Good written and spoken English skillsNice to have    Experience with Redux Toolkit, RTK Query or Redux Saga    Experience with distributed or high-volume systems    Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar    Interest in UX/UI design    Experience with ad tech or programmatic advertising    Degree in Computer Science    Fluency in SwedishWhat we offerYou will be part of a small, experienced engineering team where your contributions make a real difference. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work, influence technical decisions and contribute across different parts of a complex platform.Our systems handle large volumes of data and real-time transactions, offering a broad range of technical challenges in a profitable and established software business.Application: The application deadline is 13th of December 2026. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Andreas Green at Andreas.Green@vitecsoftware.com.Location: The position is based at our office in Stockholm.Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.About Vitec BidTheatreBidTheatre DSP is a programmatic marketing platform built for media agencies, advertisers and integrators. With BidTheatre, marketers get unified and efficient access to the fragmented media landscape with banner, video, audio, native, CTV, and digital out of home (DOOH) advertising. The platform can be used to launch awareness building or conversion driving advertising campaigns, target niche audiences and gain marketing insights. BidTheatre is an independent and close partner that puts transparency and innovation in the forefront. BidTheatre has offices in Stockholm and Oslo and has been part of Vitec Software Group since 2024 Read more at bidtheatre.com.About Vitec Software GroupVitec is a leading provider of Vertical Software and has its origin and headquarters in Umeå, Sweden. Our products have been developed to meet specific needs within various niche markets in society. The expertise of our employees, combined with our shared corporate culture and business model, enable continuous improvement and innovation. We grow through the successes of our business units, as well as through acquisitions. Everything we do is based on a long-term perspective. Because we are to rely on – today and tomorrow. Vitec has 1,870 employees, is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and had net sales of SEK 3,633 million in 2025. Read more at vitecsoftware.com.

DescriptionÀ ce poste, vous rejoindrez une équipe dédiée chargée d'améliorer les processus d'entreprise et administratifs au sein du portefeuille Global Solutions. Cela inclut la gestion de sociétés holding non réglementées situées au Luxembourg. Votre contribution sera essentielle au bon fonctionnement de ces entités, et vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la facilitation du transfert de connaissances, l'intégration des nouveaux membres de l'équipe et la garantie de la continuité en cas d'absence des dirigeants.• Vous superviserez la collecte des signatures pour les documents juridiques relatifs à l'administration de l'entreprise, notamment les assemblées générales et les réunions du conseil d'administration, les approbations des comptes annuels, les opérations de financement, les distributions, les transferts d'actions et les modifications des statuts.• Vous assurez la coordination et la fourniture des documents relatifs à la procédure « Know Your Customer » (KYC) aux parties internes et externes, en garantissant la conformité et le soutien aux opérations de l'entreprise.• Vous tenez à jour les registres légaux, en veillant à ce que les dossiers de l'entreprise, tant physiques qu'électroniques, soient tenus à jour et accessibles.• Vous assurerez la conservation et la gestion des registres des actionnaires et/ou des détenteurs d'obligations, en veillant à ce que des registres exacts soient tenus de manière cohérente.• Vous préparerez et coordonnerez les dépôts relatifs à la société, à la propriété effective et aux comptes annuels auprès du Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS) du Luxembourg et du Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE).• Vous participez à la mise en place et à la gestion de structures de capital-investissement, immobilières, d'infrastructures et de dette, en collaboration avec l'équipe Corporate.• Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes internes, les équipes internationales, les représentants juridiques externes et les notaires au Luxembourg afin d'accompagner diverses opérations d'entreprise.Soutien et coordination de l'équipe :• Vous accompagnez l'intégration et la formation des nouveaux membres de l'équipe, en facilitant leur intégration harmonieuse au sein de l'équipe.• Vous partagez activement vos connaissances et apportez votre aide à vos collègues dans le cadre de tâches opérationnelles et administratives, selon les besoins.• Vous assurez le remplacement du responsable de l'équipe de soutien opérationnel, en veillant à ce que les opérations quotidiennes se poursuivent sans heurts en son absence. Cela implique notamment de contribuer à la répartition de la charge de travail, à la hiérarchisation des priorités et à la remontée des problèmes opérationnels.• Vous participez à la collecte, à l'analyse et à la présentation des données opérationnelles, contribuant ainsi au suivi de la charge de travail, à l'établissement de rapports et aux initiatives d'amélioration des processus.Nos valeurs :L'intégrité, l'excellence, le respect et le travail d'équipe guident toutes vos actions dans le cadre de ce poste. Votre profil• Possède au moins 3 ans d'expérience pertinente dans un poste similaire au sein du secteur financier.• Fait preuve d'une capacité à gérer efficacement diverses responsabilités tout en réagissant avec agilité face à des défis imprévus.• Adopte une approche proactive et pragmatique, et s'attache tout particulièrement à trouver des solutions.• Fait preuve de capacités organisationnelles exceptionnelles et d'un grand souci du détail.• Maîtrise la gestion des tâches administratives courantes, en garantissant précision et exactitude en toutes circonstances.• Fait preuve d'une forte volonté d'épanouissement personnel et de développement professionnel dans un environnement multiculturel au rythme soutenu.• Travaille en collaboration et est disposé à aider les membres de l'équipe en cas de besoin.• Possède de solides compétences en communication et en relations interpersonnelles pour faciliter des interactions efficaces.• Maîtrise l'anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral ; la connaissance du français ou de l'allemand est un atout.• Possède une solide maîtrise pratique d'Excel, ce qui est considéré comme un atout.• La compréhension de la réglementation des sociétés luxembourgeoises serait considérée comme un atout précieux.Offre• Indication du salaire mensuel: € 4501 - € 6000 • Une culture d'entreprise qui valorise la contribution de chacun, vous permettant d'avoir un impact significatif sur l'organisation.• Un environnement de travail international et diversifié qui rassemble des professionnels qualifiés issus d'horizons et de cultures variés.• Une philosophie fondée sur l'intégrité, l'excellence, le respect et le travail d'équipe.• Des rémunérations compétitives et des avantages sociaux attractifs qui témoignent de notre engagement en faveur de la santé et du bien-être de nos collaborateurs.• Une attention particulière portée au maintien d'un équilibre sain entre vie professionnelle et vie privée, vous permettant d'exceller tant dans votre carrière que dans votre vie personnelle.• La possibilité d'évoluer dans un environnement financier dynamique et stimulant tout en bénéficiant de la flexibilité d'une petite structure.• Un environnement collaboratif qui favorise le développement continu, l'inclusion et l'encouragement mutuel entre les membres de l'équipe.• Un engagement en faveur du développement durable et une participation active aux initiatives visant à améliorer la vie de la communauté.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant - Cross Border Fund Distribution Services (m/f)
jobs.description: Job Title:  (Senior) Consultant - Cross Border Fund Distribution Services Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting Job Function:  Investment Management & Regulatory Level of Experience:  Experienced Contract Type:  Open-term Req ID:  14299 Job Description:  Your future teamOnsiteFull time Join Deloitte Luxembourg's Distribution Advisory Services team and support the cross-border registration and ongoing regulatory obligations of UCITS and AIFs. We help global asset managers, management companies and investment funds implement their international marketing plans through reliable operational delivery and practical regulatory guidance. Our work focuses on supporting regulatory requirements for marketing funds, rather than fund sales or capital-raising activities. As part of Deloitte luxembourg's Investment Management & Regulatory practice, you will combine project coordination, accurate document handling and client communication with applied regulatory analysis. At Consultant level, you will deliver defined activities with guidance. At Senior Consultant level, you will independently manage assigned projects or workstreams, resolve routine issues and support colleagues. Your level will be determined based on your experience and demonstrated capabilities. Key areas we cover:• Cross-border distribution operations: Coordinate registrations, notifications and post-registration updates through well-executed project management, accurate documentation and timely follow-up.• Cross-border distribution regulatory support: Identify, interpret and monitor the requirements applicable to the international marketing of investment funds.• Marketing compliance: Review promotional materials against applicable EU and local regulatory requirements.• Investment compliance: Assess asset eligibility and identify applicable investment restrictions. Support management companies with questions on investment compliance requirements and market practices.The advantages of joining us 1. Develop a fund-distribution specialismBuild practical knowledge of cross-border fund registration and regulation through client assignments, training and career development opportunities.2. Grow your client and project responsibilitiesWork with international asset managers and develop your ability to coordinate projects and take increasing ownership of client work.3. Combine technical knowledge with practical deliveryApply regulatory requirements to real client projects and work with tools and technology that support effective service delivery.4. Work in a collaborative environmentJoin a multicultural team where knowledge sharing and your contribution matter. The role is onsite and full time, with flexibility in working hours.5. Contribute beyond client workParticipate in sustainability initiatives and community service alongside your professional development.How you'll contribute to our success Coordinate Cross-Border Fund Registration & Post-Registration Projects:• Coordinate fund registrations and notifications across Europe and other markets, collecting and checking the required documentation and following up with clients and relevant stakeholders.• Support regulatory approval processes and ongoing post-registration obligations. Maintain accurate registration records and track deadlines, dependencies, document updates and outstanding actions.Develop & Apply Regulatory Expertise:• Develop your understanding of the local and international distribution requirements applicable to UCITS and AIFs, and apply that knowledge to client projects.• Monitor and analyse regulatory developments, assess their relevance to client activities and help prepare clear, practical guidance, seeking technical review where needed.Client Service Management:• Maintain regular client communication, provide accurate status updates and clarify the information and actions needed to progress projects.• Participate in client calls and meetings, taking the lead on assigned projects as your experience allows. Resolve routine delivery issues and escalate complex questions or risks promptly.Stakeholder Interaction:• Liaise with regulatory authorities, clients' legal advisers and colleagues to coordinate submissions, clarify requirements and keep projects moving.Your skills • A Master's degree in law, finance, economics, business administration or another relevant field.• Typically 2–4 years of relevant experience in the investment fund industry, asset management, fund distribution, regulatory advisory or a related consulting environment. Appointment at Consultant or Senior Consultant level will depend on your experience and demonstrated capabilities.• A working understanding of investment funds, including UCITS and AIFs, and an interest in developing cross-border distribution expertise.• Experience coordinating tasks or projects, handling documentation accurately and following up with clients or other stakeholders.• Fluency in written and spoken English, with clear professional drafting and communication skills.• Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and organisation, with the ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and flag issues early.• A collaborative approach and willingness to take responsibility for assigned work. For Senior Consultant appointment, demonstrated ability to manage assigned projects or workstreams independently and handle routine client issues. Preferred capabilities• Direct experience with cross-border fund registrations, notifications or post-registration obligations, and familiarity with European or other local distribution requirements.• Professional French language skills.• For Senior Consultant candidates, experience sharing technical knowledge or supporting colleagues. Formal supervisory experience is not required for Consultant appointment.Interested? Please submit your resume in EnglishGet to know more about Deloitte on our LinkedIn page (#DeloitteLU), Instagram page, YouTube page or website.With more than 2,600 employees and 98 nationalities, Deloitte Luxembourg is one of the Grand Duchy's largest, strongest and oldest professional services firms. For more than 75 years, our talented teams have been serving clients in various industries delivering high added-value offerings to national and international clients in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. Deloitte Luxembourg is part of the global Deloitte network. Deloitte provides leading professional services to nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500® and thousands of private companies. Our people deliver measurable and lasting results that help reinforce public trust in capital markets and enable clients to transform and thrive. Building on its 180+-year history, Deloitte spans more than 150 countries and territories. Learn how Deloitte's over 470,000 people worldwide work together every day to make an impact that matters at www.deloitte.com.

IT hardware; maintenance and support; telecommunications; cloud or hosting services; IT professional or managed services.• Good understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, including requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, goods or service receipt and invoice matching.• Ability to understand commercial IT models such as subscriptions, licences, maintenance, consumption-based services and professional-services engagements.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spend, pricing, contract and purchasing data.• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewals and operational priorities simultaneously.• Collaborative and service-oriented approach when working with IT, Finance, Legal, Information Security and business stakeholders.‎Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. jobs.description: Description des tâches:LUXUAV is an innovative technology company headquartered in Luxembourg, shaping next-generation airspace security for defence, civil, firefighting and police missions.We build a fully integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) ecosystem that connects mission systems across ground, air, and stratosphere into one coherent governmental and commercial architecture.Job Title: Production ManagerReports to: Chief Operating OfficerRole overview:The Production Manager is responsible for leading the company's production operations, ensuring the safe, efficient and timely manufacture of high-quality unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The role manages the production team, oversees daily manufacturing activities, and works closely with Engineering, Industrialisation and Quality to deliver products that meet customer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.The Production Manager is accountable for production planning, workforce management, productivity, quality, continuous improvement and operational performance while fostering a positive and engaged team culture.Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Operations• Lead and manage all daily production activities to ensure safe, efficient andon-time delivery of products.• Develop and execute production schedules and targets.• Monitor production progress and adjust resources to meet changing priorities.• Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality and safety standards.• Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput.• Ensure effective utilisation of labour, equipment, and production resources.Team Leadership• Lead, coach, develop and motivate the production team.• Manage workforce planning, shift allocation and daily work assignments.• Manage performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.• Manage day-to-day employee relations issues within the production team, partnering with HR on formal or complex cases.• Identify training and development needs to enhance team capability.• Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.Quality• Ensure products are manufactured in accordance with quality requirements; and approved engineering drawings, specifications, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and work instructions developed by the R&D team.• Work closely with the Quality Manager to resolve production quality issues.• Promote a "right first time" approach throughout production.• Ensure production teams understand and comply with quality procedures.• Support non-conformance investigations and implement corrective actions.Production Planning & Performance• Ensure production plan is aligned to meet sales plan and/or customer delivery deadlines.• Ensure production plan and corresponding timely materials procurement requests are factored into the procurement plan.• Monitor production KPIs including output, efficiency, labour utilisation, schedule adherence, rework and productivity.• Analyse production performance and recommend improvements.• Prepare production reports for management.• Support capacity planning and future production growth.Health, Safety & Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.• Ensure employees follow safe working practices and company procedures.• Participate in risk assessments and incident investigations.• Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment.Continuous Improvement• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within production (e.g. 5S program implementation).• Improve production workflows, layouts and processes.• Reduce waste, rework and production downtime.• Support Lean manufacturing and other operational excellence initiatives.• Encourage employee suggestions for operational improvements.Inventory & Materials• Work closely with Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure material availability.• Monitor inventory accuracy within the production area.• Ensure appropriate handling and storage of components and finished products.• Minimise material waste and production losses.Cross-functional Collaboration• Collaborate with Engineering and Industrialisation to introduce new products into production.• Support prototype, pilot and low-rate initial production (LRIP) builds.• Provide manufacturing feedback to improve product design and manufacturability.• Support production readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.Equipment & Facilities• Ensure production equipment is maintained and available.• Report equipment issues and coordinate maintenance activities.• Recommend investments in tools, equipment, and production capability.Qualifications & ExperienceMust have• Bachelor's degree or vocational qualification in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will also be considered.• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.• Previous experience leading production teams.• Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production planning.• Understanding of quality management systems and manufacturing quality principles.• Familiarity with health and safety requirements within manufacturing.• Strong leadership and people management skills.• Excellent organisational and planning abilities.• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.• Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret production data.• Free criminal record no. 3Nice to have• Experience within electronics, aerospace, defence, automotive, or other high- technology manufacturing environments is advantageous.• Experience introducing new products into production is desirable.• Experience using ERP or manufacturing planning systems is advantageous.• National from a NATO member country or one of the following NATO Indo- Pacific partners: Australia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand or Ukraine.

jobs.description: Office & administration officer f/hChez SD Worx, vous évoluez dans un environnement où l'esprit d'équipe, la confiance et le sens du travail sont au cœur de notre quotidien.Ici, chacun a la place de s'épanouir : nous vous accompagnons avec des formations et des opportunités d'évolution, toujours adaptées à vos ambitions.Nous croyons au travail hybride et réfléchissions avec vous à ce dont vous avez besoin pour vous sentir bien, au travail comme en dehors. électroniques.• Assurer le suivi administratif des déclarations et formalités diverses.• Réaliser diverses commandes administratives et assurer le suivi des fournisseurs.Facilities & gestion du bâtiment• Assurer la gestion des fournitures de bureau et le suivi des stocks.• Coordonner les commandes liées à la vie du bureau (eau, consommables, matériel de bureau, imprimantes, etc.).• Superviser les demandes d'intervention, les incidents et les opérations de maintenance du bâtiment.• Assurer le suivi des travaux et des prestataires externes.• Participer à la recherche de nouveaux fournisseurs et au suivi des devis (services de nettoyage, catering, paniers de fruits, etc.).• Assurer le suivi des bornes de recharge et des équipements liés au parking.Onboarding & Offboarding• Coordonner l'arrivée des nouveaux collaborateurs en lien avec les équipes RH.• Préparer et suivre l'ensemble des éléments nécessaires à l'intégration : matériel informatique, badges, accès parking, vous permettant d'accueillir et d'accompagner des visiteurs internationaux.• Une connaissance de la plateforme MyGuichet constitue un véritable atout.• Une première expérience dans la gestion administrative d'un site ou dans un environnement de services est appréciée.• Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques et les applications bureautiques courantes.Compétences et qualités réactivité.• Proactivité et force de proposition pour améliorer les processus existants.• Fiabilité, discrétion et sens des responsabilités.Qu'avons-nous à vous offrir ?• Un salaire basé sur votre expérience et vos réalisations• 29 jours de congés par an (26 + 3 offerts par SD Worx)• Des chèque-repas (13,5 € / jour travaillé, 2,80 € à charge de l'employé)• Un plan de pension d'entreprise• Un jobs.title: Senior toxicologist and risk assessor PhD (m/f/x)
jobs.description: Senior toxicologist and risk assessor PhD (M/F/X) Ref° 200Type de contrat : CDD 1 anLe Laboratoire national de santé (LNS) recherche actuellement un(e) toxicologue pour rejoindre le département de Protection de la santé, dans le cadre d'un contrat à durée déterminée (CDD) à temps plein d'une durée d'un an.Description de l'offre d'emploiA propos du Département Protection de la santéLe Département Protection de la santé du LNS soutient la santé publique et les soins de santé pour les problématiques causées ou aggravées par l'environnement. Nos principaux partenaires sont les hôpitaux, les ministères et les services de santé au travail au Luxembourg.Le Département est composé de deux services :Service de l'Hygiène de l'environnement et de la surveillance biologique humaine (EnvirOH) (laboratoire)Service de l'Expertise médicale et de l'intelligence des données (MEDI)ResponsabilitésNous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) hautement motivé(e), titulaire d'un doctorat (PhD) en toxicologie, en santé environnementale et en évaluation de la sécurité des substances chimiques.La personne retenue travaillera dans le cadre du programme PARC, afin de contribuer à l'évaluation des effets sur la santé et à l'évaluation intégrée des risques, tout en apportant son soutien au Département en qualité de responsable scientifique de projets.Le/la candidat(e) sera directement rattaché(e) au responsable du Département et aura pour principales missions :Participer à différentes activités et réunions dans le cadre de programmes scientifiques internationaux destinés à soutenir l'élaboration des politiques publiques (science-policy), notamment le programme PARC.Contribuer aux activités générales de gestion de projets au sein du Département, notamment dans le cadre des programmes PARC et EIRENE.Assurer la gestion scientifique du projet PARC portant sur l'élaboration de valeurs guides pour la qualité de l'air intérieur fondées sur des critères sanitaires, en collaboration avec différents partenaires européens, afin de garantir sa bonne exécution scientifique, le respect des étapes clés et la remise des livrables, ainsi que la gestion des rapports techniques et des tâches connexes.Élaborer des valeurs guides sanitaires pour les polluants présents dans l'air intérieur, sur la base de données toxicologiques et/ou épidémiologiques.Définir des valeurs guides sanitaires pour le biomonitoring humain (Human Biomonitoring - HBM), sur la base de données toxicologiques et/ou épidémiologiques, notamment dans le cadre de l'évaluation des substances per- et polyfluoroalkylées (PFAS).Collaborer avec des partenaires nationaux et internationaux au sein du réseau PARC.Assurer la diffusion et la valorisation des résultats au moyen de présentations lors de conférences nationales et internationales, de réunions avec les parties prenantes, ainsi que de publications dans des revues scientifiques à comité de lecture.Participer aux réunions de projet et contribuer aux activités de diffusion des résultats ainsi qu'à l'élaboration de rapports pertinents pour l'orientation des politiques publiques.Réaliser des évaluations des risques pour la santé humaine à partir de données de biomonitoring humain et de données relatives à l'exposition aux polluants de l'air intérieur, concernant la population générale et les travailleurs, sur la base des données recueillies dans le contexte national et dans le cadre d'initiatives scientifiques et institutionnelles telles que HBM4EU et PARC.Cette liste de missions n'est pas exhaustive. Les fonctions pourront évoluer en fonction des besoins spécifiques du Département et du programme PARC.ProfilDoctorat (PhD) en toxicologie, sciences de l'environnement, sciences biomédicales, sciences de la vie, biotechnologie ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.Au moins deux années d'expérience professionnelle pertinente.Expérience avérée en matière de publications scientifiques internationales dans des revues à comité de lecture, dans les domaines de la toxicologie environnementale, professionnelle et/ou médicale.Expérience dans l'évaluation des risques pour la santé humaine dans un contexte réglementaire, notamment en matière de caractérisation des dangers et de détermination de valeurs de référence sanitaires.Expérience dans l'évaluation des risques chimiques et de l'exposition aux substances chimiques sur la base de données de surveillance, y compris les données de biomonitoring humain.Expérience confirmée en matière de mise en réseau et de capacité à obtenir des résultats au sein de grands consortiums internationaux.Expérience en gestion de projets et en collaboration au sein de consortiums internationaux.Excellentes compétences en communication et en pédagogie.Solides capacités organisationnelles et analytiques, ainsi qu'une méthode de travail structurée.Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en contribuant efficacement au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires.Capacité à recueillir et à synthétiser les informations nécessaires dans le cadre des activités professionnelles, afin d'assurer le reporting et les échanges avec la direction ainsi qu'avec les services de soutien.Maîtrise professionnelle complète de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, exigée. Une bonne maîtrise du français et/ou de l'allemand, à l'oral comme à l'écrit, constitue un atoutComment postuler ?Si vous correspondez au profil ci-dessus et que vous souhaitez postuler, veuillez soumettre votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) via notre site web. Votre candidature sera traitée de manière confidentielle.Lors des dernières étapes du processus de recrutement, le candidat retenu sera invité à fournir des documents justificatifs tels que des copies des diplômes et des certificats de travail. Un extrait de casier judiciaire officiel (bulletin n° 3 ainsi que le bulletin n° 4 pour les postes de chauffeur) sera également demandé à des fins de consultation.

jobs.description: The European Institute of Public Administration (EIPA) was created in 1981 on the occasion of the first European Council held in Maastricht and is supported by the EU Member States and the European Commission. jobs.title: SENIOR SCIENTIST IN AGENTIC AI FOR ENVIRONMENTAL DIGITAL TWINS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

jobs.title: RF Systems Architect
jobs.description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

jobs.title: SpinDrive: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Lapinlahdenkatu 16, 00180 Helsinki**Application deadline:** 3.12.2026Are you a Mechanical Engineer ready to take ownership of design projects and develop energy-efficient technology for high-speed rotating machinery? Join SpinDrive!**What will you be doing?**SpinDrive is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join its growing mechanical design team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design and develop mechanical components for active magnetic bearing systems used in high-speed rotating machinery, such as compressors, turbines, and electric motors. You will also be responsible for integrating these systems into customers' equipment, ensuring that the designs meet their technical requirements.You will typically work on several projects at different stages, from initial design to prototyping and production support. You will collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and control engineers, as well as suppliers and manufacturing partners. As part of a small team, you will have considerable ownership of your designs and the opportunity to see how they perform in practice.**Main tasks:**- Designing and integrating mechanical components for active magnetic bearing systems, including rotors, stators, bearing housings, backup bearings, and sensor mounts. - Creating and maintaining 3D CAD models, manufacturing drawings, and technical documentation in product data management (PDM) systems. - Performing mechanical calculations and analyses, including tolerance stack-ups, interference fits, structural integrity, and thermal behaviour. - Supporting rotordynamic analysis, balancing requirements, prototype testing, manufacturing, assembly, and troubleshooting. - Collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure designs meet technical requirements and project objectives. **What makes you a great fit?**We are looking for a hands-on mechanical engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges and turning engineering concepts into manufacturable solutions. You have already gained relevant experience in mechanical design and are familiar with rotating machinery.You have strong analytical skills, pay close attention to detail, and can manage your work effectively and independently while enjoying collaboration with colleagues from different technical backgrounds. Above all, you are motivated to deepen your expertise in mechanical engineering and contribute to the development of innovative industrial technology.**We require you to have:**- A bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field - Hands-on experience in mechanical design, preferably involving rotating machinery - Proficiency in 3D CAD software, such as Autodesk Inventor or SolidWorks, and experience preparing manufacturing drawings - Solid knowledge of mechanical design principles, machine elements, and tolerance analysis (including GD&T) - Good English communication skills **We consider as an asset:**- Experience designing high-speed rotating machinery or components for turbomachinery - Understanding of rotordynamics, vibration, balancing, or active magnetic bearing systems - Experience with finite element analysis (FEA) and structural or thermal simulations - Knowledge of design for manufacturing and assembly (DFM/DFA), manufacturing processes, or prototype testing **SpinDrive offers you:**- The opportunity to own mechanical designs from concept to manufacturing and see your engineering decisions become real products - A chance to deepen your expertise in advanced rotating machinery and active magnetic bearing technology alongside experienced engineers - Meaningful work developing energy-efficient industrial solutions that help customers reduce friction, maintenance needs, and environmental impact - A growing international cleantech environment where your ideas can influence products, processes, and your future career opportunities - Flexible hybrid working arrangements and the opportunity to participate in the company's growth through a stock option program **Practicalities:**This is a permanent, full-time position in which you will be employed directly by SpinDrive. Start time in the role is as soon as possible in early 2027. The role will be located in Helsinki, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 4000-5500 €/month (gross), depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually. In addition to your salary, the compensation package includes stock options, allowing you to share in the benefits of SpinDrives growth.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja Kankaanpäähän
jobs.description: Lähihoitaja, tule osaksi Kankaanpään Alinaa vakituiseen, kokoaikaiseen työhön!Kotipalvelumme tuovat helpotusta arkeen. Autamme ikääntyneitä ja muita apua tarvitsevia elämään itsenäisesti ja turvallisesti omassa kodissaan, tarjoten kotihoitoa, apua arjen askareissa, kotisairaanhoitoa ja ennen kaikkea läsnäoloa. Perheille olemme luotettava tukiverkko, kun arjessa tarvitaan tukea. Olemme palvelleet asiakkaitamme Satakunnan alueella vuodesta 2023.**Työnkuvaus**Työnkuva kohdentuu lähinnä asiakkaamme henkilökohtaiseen avustamiseen koulumaailmassa, mutta myös muihin tehtäviin kotihoidossa. Työ on vakituinen ja töitä on tarjolla kokoaikaisesti. Työtä tehdään meillä kahdessa vuorossa ja pitää sisällään myös viikonloppuvuoroja.Työ käynnistyy sopimuksen mukaan.**Mitä toivomme sinulta**- Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja lääkelupien teoriaosuuden ajantasaisuutta - Hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista - B-ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta - Positiivista ja itsenäisesti toimeen tarttuvaa otetta asiakastyöhön - Kykyä toimia tiimin jäsenenä - Tuntemus diabeteksesta ja tukiviittomista katsotaan eduksi. **Miksi sinun kannattaa hakea osaksi Kankaanpään Alinaa?**- Pääset tekemään oman osaamisesi mukaista työtä ja kehittämään osaamistasi työskentelyn kautta. - Saat laadukkaan ja kattavan perehdytyksen työhösi sekä monipuolisen asiakaskunnan. - Työtyytyväisyys Alinassa on huippuluokkaa: työtyytyväisyyden keskiarvo oli 4,3/5 vuonna 2025. Työkyky koettiin hyväksi 8,6/10 ja stressitaso matalaksi 2,2/5. Mikäli tämä voisi olla seuraava työpaikkasi, täytä hakemus ja hae työpaikkaa tiimistämme. Työhön valitulta henkilöltä tarkistetaan rikosrekisteri ennen palkkausta.Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa **täältä**.Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.Alina on osa **Norlandiaa**, joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing solutions for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager you will build a deep understanding of the end-to-end solutions (hardware and software) across all of Underwater Security (our OptiBarrier and OptiArray product lines and our software platform), and of the markets and customers they serve. You turn that understanding into clear positioning, compelling value propositions and go-to-market plans that help our sales teams win.

Optics11 is in its scale-up phase, and product marketing in Underwater Security is starting from a basic level. You will build the product marketing function from the ground up: you set up the frameworks, processes and tools it needs, while delivering tangible commercial results along the way. You start as an individual contributor, with the opportunity to grow a small product marketing team over time.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our solutions Product Managers for hardware and software, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Application Engineering, Customer Projects and R&D teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might analyze a competitor’s new seabed monitoring system, sharpen the value proposition for an anti-submarine warfare (ASW) tender, work on the launch of a new software release, train the sales team on a new product narrative, or help prepare a customer demo for a tradeshow such as UDT or Euronaval. You will own how our products are positioned, launched and sold in the market, support pricing decisions, and make sure your market insights support Optics11 product decision making.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have evolved the foundations of product marketing in Underwater Security: clearly defined target segments and buyer personas, a positioning and messaging framework per product line, a competitive intelligence baseline, a repeatable launch process and a first sales enablement toolkit. Your work will sharpen our market focus, improve our win rate and help Optics11 scale its solutions commercially in demanding, high-stakes markets. 

Responsibilities:

  • Build the product marketing function by setting up the frameworks, processes, templates and tools for positioning, launches, competitive intelligence, sales enablement and product marketing analytics, tracking pipeline contribution and win rates, and scaling them as the organization grows.

  • Define target markets and commercialization plans by analyzing market size, trends, buying contexts and customer needs across mission profiles such as anti-submarine warfare (ASW), intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) and critical underwater infrastructure (CUI) protection, prioritizing segments and use cases with Product Management and Business Development, and defining go-to-market approaches, channels and partnerships per segment (e.g. with prime contractors and system integrators).

  • Lead competitive intelligence and market monitoring by tracking competitors, technologies, programs and tenders, running win/loss analyses, and sharing actionable insights with Product Management to shape strategy, roadmap and business cases.

  • Own product positioning, messaging and value propositions by developing clear, differentiated propositions per product line and segment, and translating technical capabilities into operational and commercial value for defense partners and clients.

  • Support Product Management on pricing and packaging by providing market, competitor and customer insights for pricing decisions on products and end-to-end solutions, and aligning price positioning with Sales.

  • Plan and execute product launches by introducing a launch process scaled to the size of each release, coordinating launch readiness across Product, Sales and Support, and providing product messaging, content and launch input to the Marketing team.

  • Enable sales and ensure commercial readiness by creating sales narratives, pitch decks, battlecards, objection handling and training, preparing customer demos, collateral and tender input with Tech Sales & Bid Management and Application Engineering, and supporting Sales, Business Development and Marketing in key opportunities, tenders and trade shows.


Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in marketing, business or engineering.

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing for technical B2B or B2G solutions, preferably combining hardware and software (platform) products in defense or another industrial high-tech / high-compliance environment with long, complex sales cycles such as tenders and partner-led sales.

  • Proven experience building product marketing from the ground up in a scale-up: hands-on, pragmatic and entrepreneurial, setting up processes, frameworks and tools with limited resources while delivering results.

  • Demonstrable experience in defining value propositions, positioning and go-to-market plans, and executing them through launches and sales enablement.

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technology and translate it into clear, credible customer value.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, capable of presenting to technical, commercial and executive audiences.

  • Proficiency in CRM and marketing automation tools such as HubSpot, and in analytics for funnel and performance reporting.

  • Willingness to travel, including to customers and international trade shows; driver’s license B (or international equivalent).

  • Ability to pass a background / security screening by the Dutch AIVD/MIVD, as you will be working with clients in the defense industry.

Nice to Have :

  • Experience in ASW, ISR or CUI-related defense technology markets, or with underwater acoustics, is a big plus.

  • Experience with defense procurement, tenders and export-controlled products.

  • Understanding of pricing and packaging for hardware, software and recurring-revenue (license or subscription) models.

  • Experience working with prime contractors and system integrators.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Jira Product Discovery, Confluence, Miro, PowerBI.

  • Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Screening

You will work with clients in the defense and security sectors. Obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD, the Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service, is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. We will explain the process and guide you through the applicable requirements.

More than 10,000 churches across Europe work with ChurchDesk, and together with Hagru we’re now growing fast in the Netherlands. Our Groningen team is at the heart of that growth, and we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it.

Is this you?

You love talking to people, you’re curious, and you want a job where you learn fast and see the results of your work. You don’t need years of sales experience. We’ll teach you how to sell.   • Present with confidence: You present ChurchDesk to church councils, staff and volunteers, online and in person.

  • Build relationships: You become a trusted partner in the Dutch church landscape and build relationships that last.

  • A degree (or soon one) in any field, for example business, communication, theology or social sciences, or first work experience in a people-facing role.

  • First sales or customer experience is a plus, for example from a student job, an internship or a study association, but it’s not a must.

  • You’re outgoing, enjoy talking to new people and don’t give up easily.

  • You’re structured, take ownership and like working towards clear goals.

  • Fluent Dutch and good English, plus strong communication skills in conversations and in writing.

  • A connection to church life, whether through your own church, volunteering or a student association, is a real plus.

What We Offer

  • A great start to your career: Training in consultative selling and a dedicated coach who helps you grow.

  • Open feedback culture: We’re transparent, supportive and learn from each other.
